tire_microplastic_abrasion.transformation: Preserve method, particle-size range, tire and road composition, traffic activity, and atmospheric or runoff pathway.
tire_microplastic_abrasion.uncertainty: Emission factors and measurement methods vary substantially across vehicle, tire, road, and weather conditions.
tire_microplastic_abrasion.failure_behavior: Do not equate all non-exhaust dust with tire microplastics without chemical or method-specific attribution.

combined_sewer_overflow.metric_name: Combined sewer overflow event and volume
combined_sewer_overflow.unit: overflow events, duration, and volume per reporting period
combined_sewer_overflow.geography: named CSO outfall, sewer shed, municipality, or reporting jurisdiction
combined_sewer_overflow.cadence: event-based monitoring with annual permit reporting
combined_sewer_overflow.transformation: Retain outfall identifier, rainfall, receiving water, duration, volume, treatment status, and monitoring method.
combined_sewer_overflow.uncertainty: Event volume and duration may be estimated; monitoring coverage and rainfall attribution vary.
combined_sewer_overflow.threshold_provenance: EPA NPDES CSO program and permit reporting.
combined_sewer_overflow.failure_behavior: Do not infer a CSO event from urban rainfall alone without a combined-sewer boundary and overflow or hydraulic evidence.

coral_bleaching.metric_name: Coral bleaching severity and thermal stress
coral_bleaching.unit: percent coral colonies bleached, bleaching alert level, or degree-heating-weeks
coral_bleaching.geography: named reef, ecoregion, or satellite grid cell
coral_bleaching.cadence: daily thermal monitoring plus seasonal field validation
coral_bleaching.transformation: Retain coral taxon, survey method, depth, heat-stress metric, exposure duration, and local water-quality context.
coral_bleaching.uncertainty: Satellite heat-stress products require field validation; susceptibility differs by species, acclimation, depth, and local stressors.
coral_bleaching.threshold_provenance: NOAA Coral Reef Watch Degree Heating Week and Bleaching HotSpot products.
coral_bleaching.failure_behavior: Do not infer bleaching from a warm anomaly alone without duration, reef location, and field or validated heat-stress context.

semiconductor_fabrication_process_operat.unit: wafer starts, tool-hours, or gas input mass per reporting period
semiconductor_fabrication_process_operat.geography: named fab, process line, or reporting jurisdiction
semiconductor_fabrication_process_operat.transformation: Retain process subtype, input gases, utilization, by-products, tool type, and abatement configuration.
semiconductor_fabrication_process_operat.uncertainty: Gas utilization, by-product formation, and process recipes vary across fabs and tools.
semiconductor_fabrication_process_operat.threshold_provenance: EPA Subpart I electronics-manufacturing reporting methods.
semiconductor_fabrication_process_operat.failure_behavior: Do not infer F-gas use or emissions from fab floor area, chip output, or electricity consumption alone.

semiconductor_f_gas_emissions.unit: tonnes gas or metric tonnes CO2e per reporting period
semiconductor_f_gas_emissions.geography: named fab, process line, or reporting jurisdiction
semiconductor_f_gas_emissions.cadence: annual facility reporting or process measurement
semiconductor_f_gas_emissions.transformation: Retain input and by-product gas, global-warming-potential basis, utilization or stack-test method, and abatement destruction/removal efficiency.
semiconductor_f_gas_emissions.uncertainty: Default utilization rates and abatement performance can diverge from measured facility conditions.
semiconductor_f_gas_emissions.threshold_provenance: EPA Subpart I annual emissions calculation.
semiconductor_f_gas_emissions.failure_behavior: Do not use gas purchase mass as emitted mass without utilization, by-product, and abatement evidence.

blast_furnace_ironmaking_operation.unit: tonnes hot metal per reporting period
blast_furnace_ironmaking_operation.geography: named furnace, plant, or reporting jurisdiction
blast_furnace_ironmaking_operation.transformation: Retain burden, flux, coke rate, furnace technology, production output, and reporting boundary.
blast_furnace_ironmaking_operation.uncertainty: Material balance, co-product allocation, and reporting coverage vary.
blast_furnace_ironmaking_operation.failure_behavior: Do not infer furnace activity from crude-steel demand alone.

blast_furnace_industrial_slag.unit: tonnes generated, processed, reused, stockpiled, or disposed per reporting period with slag type stated
blast_furnace_industrial_slag.geography: named blast furnace, steel plant, processing facility, market, or reporting jurisdiction
blast_furnace_industrial_slag.cadence: monthly production with annual material-flow summaries
blast_furnace_industrial_slag.transformation: Retain furnace and slag type, iron or steel output, wet or dry basis, processing, chemistry where measured, encapsulated or unencapsulated use, destination, stock change, and uncertainty.
blast_furnace_industrial_slag.uncertainty: Slag classification, moisture, internal recycling, stockpiles, co-product accounting, sales timing, and facility coverage affect totals.
blast_furnace_industrial_slag.threshold_provenance: Use a declared mass-balance and product or waste classification for the named furnace route.
blast_furnace_industrial_slag.failure_behavior: Do not treat all ferrous slag as blast-furnace slag, all generation as disposal, or infer toxicity without chemistry and exposure evidence.

alpine_snowpack_declines.metric_name: Alpine snow water equivalent and disappearance timing
alpine_snowpack_declines.unit: millimetres snow-water equivalent, snow-covered area, or days to disappearance
alpine_snowpack_declines.geography: named mountain basin, elevation band, or observing grid cell
alpine_snowpack_declines.transformation: Retain elevation, precipitation phase, temperature, snow-water-equivalent method, albedo, and seasonal baseline.
alpine_snowpack_declines.uncertainty: Gauge sparsity, terrain interpolation, satellite cloud cover, and changing precipitation phase introduce uncertainty.
alpine_snowpack_declines.threshold_provenance: Snow-course, remote-sensing, and basin water-balance monitoring.
alpine_snowpack_declines.failure_behavior: Do not infer alpine snowpack decline from a single warm day or regional annual temperature alone.

anaerobic_manure_lagoon_operation.unit: animal units, volatile solids, nitrogen or sulfur mass, and days retention per reporting period
anaerobic_manure_lagoon_operation.transformation: Retain animal species, loading, liquid volume, temperature, retention, agitation, cover, and treatment conditions.
anaerobic_manure_lagoon_operation.uncertainty: Manure composition, loading records, and hydraulic retention vary.
anaerobic_manure_lagoon_operation.failure_behavior: Do not infer lagoon operation from regional livestock counts.

manure_lagoon_odors.metric_name: Manure lagoon odor or associated gas emission
manure_lagoon_odors.unit: odor units, ammonia, hydrogen sulfide, or volatile-compound flux per area and reporting period
manure_lagoon_odors.cadence: campaign measurement, continuous monitor, or management-period inventory
manure_lagoon_odors.transformation: Preserve sampling method, wind and weather, gas species, lagoon conditions, source area, and receptor distance.
manure_lagoon_odors.uncertainty: Odor perception, sampling methods, weather transport, and lagoon management vary.
manure_lagoon_odors.failure_behavior: Do not treat animal count or odor complaint volume as measured lagoon emissions.

lithium_brine_evaporation_operation.metric_name: Lithium brine extraction and pond activity
lithium_brine_evaporation_operation.unit: cubic metres brine pumped and hectares pond area per reporting period
lithium_brine_evaporation_operation.geography: named salar, operation, or extraction field
lithium_brine_evaporation_operation.cadence: monthly to annual operator or regulator reporting
lithium_brine_evaporation_operation.transformation: Retain well field, brine chemistry, pumping, pond area, evaporation, reinjection, and basin water context.
lithium_brine_evaporation_operation.uncertainty: Brine hydrogeology, water accounting, and pond imagery interpretation vary.
lithium_brine_evaporation_operation.failure_behavior: Do not infer pumping or water impact from lithium production totals alone.

lithium_extraction_brine_pools.metric_name: Lithium brine evaporation pond extent and volume
lithium_extraction_brine_pools.unit: hectares pond extent and cubic metres brine per reporting period
lithium_extraction_brine_pools.geography: named salar, operation, or extraction field
lithium_extraction_brine_pools.cadence: satellite observation and annual operating report
lithium_extraction_brine_pools.transformation: Preserve imagery date, pond classification, operation boundary, brine volume, and field validation.
lithium_extraction_brine_pools.uncertainty: Pond area does not by itself establish pumping rate or basin water balance.
lithium_extraction_brine_pools.threshold_provenance: USGS Landsat observation of lithium evaporation ponds.
lithium_extraction_brine_pools.failure_behavior: Do not classify all colored ponds as lithium extraction without operation and spectral/context validation.

cattle_stocking_density.unit: animal units or liveweight per hectare and grazing interval
cattle_stocking_density.transformation: Retain animal class, area, interval, and move records.
cattle_stocking_density.uncertainty: Animal weight and usable paddock area vary.
cattle_stocking_density.failure_behavior: Do not substitute regional herd totals.

wet_soil_grazing_exposure.unit: animal-hours on soil above documented moisture threshold
wet_soil_grazing_exposure.transformation: Retain soil moisture/depth, rainfall, soil texture, and access timing.
wet_soil_grazing_exposure.uncertainty: Moisture thresholds vary by soil type.
wet_soil_grazing_exposure.failure_behavior: Do not infer wet exposure from precipitation alone.

repeated_cattle_trampling.unit: animal passes or animal-hours per area and recovery interval
repeated_cattle_trampling.transformation: Retain repeat visits, recovery interval, gate/feed/water concentration, and area.
repeated_cattle_trampling.uncertainty: Pass counts and local concentration vary.
repeated_cattle_trampling.failure_behavior: Do not equate one grazing visit with repeated trampling.

cattle_grazing_overcompaction.unit: bulk density, penetration resistance, or infiltration change against local control
cattle_grazing_overcompaction.cadence: pre/post season or repeated soil survey
cattle_grazing_overcompaction.transformation: Retain soil texture, depth, control location, moisture, grazing history, and instrument method.
cattle_grazing_overcompaction.uncertainty: Natural soil variation and seasonal moisture affect metrics.
cattle_grazing_overcompaction.failure_behavior: Do not label managed grazing as compaction without soil measurements or bounded evidence.

flooded_drinking_water_source_exposure.unit: count of named sources with documented inundation or sanitary-integrity loss
flooded_drinking_water_source_exposure.geography: named utility, well, cistern, or service area
flooded_drinking_water_source_exposure.transformation: Retain flood depth or contact evidence, source type, inspection result, and sampling status.
flooded_drinking_water_source_exposure.uncertainty: Flood contact does not establish pathogen presence.
flooded_drinking_water_source_exposure.failure_behavior: Do not infer contamination from precipitation alone.

untreated_wastewater_contact_exposure.unit: documented exposure incidents or affected persons
untreated_wastewater_contact_exposure.geography: named sewer service area, flood site, or receiving-water access point
untreated_wastewater_contact_exposure.transformation: Retain overflow type, discharge status, contact pathway, and local access restriction.
untreated_wastewater_contact_exposure.uncertainty: Reported contact undercounts exposure and does not establish infection.
untreated_wastewater_contact_exposure.failure_behavior: Do not substitute modeled overflow volume for human contact.

drinking_water_safety_control_failure.unit: documented treatment, pressure, source-protection, or advisory failures
drinking_water_safety_control_failure.transformation: Retain system type, failure mode, advisory, corrective action, and laboratory result.
drinking_water_safety_control_failure.uncertainty: An advisory can be precautionary and may not indicate a confirmed pathogen.
drinking_water_safety_control_failure.failure_behavior: Do not label a routine advisory an outbreak.

private_water_source_monitoring_gap.unit: named private sources lacking a documented test or treatment verification after an incident
private_water_source_monitoring_gap.geography: named well, cistern, or private-water service area
private_water_source_monitoring_gap.transformation: Retain source type, incident exposure, sample collection, laboratory result, and corrective action.
private_water_source_monitoring_gap.uncertainty: Missing records do not prove unsafe water.
private_water_source_monitoring_gap.failure_behavior: Do not treat all private sources as contaminated.

waterborne_pathogen_outbreaks.unit: epidemiologically linked cases with pathogen and exposure-pathway status
waterborne_pathogen_outbreaks.geography: named health jurisdiction or incident area
waterborne_pathogen_outbreaks.transformation: Keep suspected, probable, and confirmed cases separate; retain pathogen, exposure route, laboratory results, and investigation status.
waterborne_pathogen_outbreaks.uncertainty: Case ascertainment, incubation periods, and multiple exposure routes limit attribution.
waterborne_pathogen_outbreaks.threshold_provenance: CDC waterborne disease outbreak investigation toolkit.
waterborne_pathogen_outbreaks.failure_behavior: Keep this as risk only until local epidemiology supports an outbreak determination.

pollinator_pesticide_exposure.unit: active-ingredient concentration, application rate, or exposure event with method
pollinator_pesticide_exposure.geography: named pollinator population, colony system, or monitored landscape
pollinator_pesticide_exposure.transformation: Retain active ingredient, crop, application timing, bloom stage, exposure route, and residue method.
pollinator_pesticide_exposure.uncertainty: Residues and applications do not identify colony-level dose or effect.
pollinator_pesticide_exposure.threshold_provenance: USGS, EPA, and NRCS pollinator-stressor framing.
pollinator_pesticide_exposure.failure_behavior: Do not use pesticide sales as exposure evidence.

pollinator_floral_resource_loss.unit: area, floral richness, bloom continuity, or nesting-resource index
pollinator_floral_resource_loss.geography: named pollinator population, colony system, or monitored landscape
pollinator_floral_resource_loss.transformation: Retain habitat type, plant composition, season, management, and survey method.
pollinator_floral_resource_loss.uncertainty: Resource availability differs by species and season.
pollinator_floral_resource_loss.threshold_provenance: USGS, EPA, and NRCS pollinator-stressor framing.
pollinator_floral_resource_loss.failure_behavior: Do not infer forage loss from a land-cover class alone.

pollinator_pathogen_parasite_pressure.unit: prevalence or load by named agent and sampled population
pollinator_pathogen_parasite_pressure.geography: named pollinator population, colony system, or monitored landscape
pollinator_pathogen_parasite_pressure.transformation: Retain host species, sampling frame, diagnostic method, prevalence, and colony-management context.
pollinator_pathogen_parasite_pressure.uncertainty: Detection does not establish disease severity or population decline.
pollinator_pathogen_parasite_pressure.threshold_provenance: USGS, EPA, and NRCS pollinator-stressor framing.
pollinator_pathogen_parasite_pressure.failure_behavior: Do not treat pathogen presence as collapse.

pollinator_climate_stress.unit: species-relevant temperature, drought, or phenology anomaly
pollinator_climate_stress.geography: named pollinator population, colony system, or monitored landscape
pollinator_climate_stress.transformation: Retain location, life stage, weather window, floral phenology, and baseline period.
pollinator_climate_stress.uncertainty: Weather anomalies may not translate to demographic stress.
pollinator_climate_stress.threshold_provenance: USGS, EPA, and NRCS pollinator-stressor framing.
pollinator_climate_stress.failure_behavior: Do not assign climate causation without a population-specific study.

pollinator_colony_collapse.unit: standardized occupancy, abundance, colony survival, or loss rate
pollinator_colony_collapse.geography: named pollinator population, colony system, or monitored landscape
pollinator_colony_collapse.transformation: Retain species or colony type, survey method, effort, season, and confirmed cause status.
pollinator_colony_collapse.uncertainty: Observed decline can reflect detection, management, or migration changes.
pollinator_colony_collapse.threshold_provenance: USGS, EPA, and NRCS pollinator-stressor framing.
pollinator_colony_collapse.failure_behavior: Do not use the term colony collapse for every pollinator decline.

coal_power_sulfur_emissions.geography: named emitting facility, fleet, corridor, or deposition-monitoring site
coal_power_sulfur_emissions.transformation: Retain unit, fuel sulfur, control configuration, measured versus estimated status, and operating hours.
coal_power_sulfur_emissions.uncertainty: Emission factors and controls vary by unit.
coal_power_sulfur_emissions.threshold_provenance: EPA/USGS acid-deposition precursor and monitoring framing.
coal_power_sulfur_emissions.failure_behavior: Do not infer SO2 from generation alone.

oil_power_sulfur_emissions.geography: named emitting facility, fleet, corridor, or deposition-monitoring site
oil_power_sulfur_emissions.transformation: Retain unit, fuel sulfur, control configuration, measured versus estimated status, and operating hours.
oil_power_sulfur_emissions.uncertainty: Emission factors and controls vary by fuel and unit.
oil_power_sulfur_emissions.threshold_provenance: EPA/USGS acid-deposition precursor and monitoring framing.
oil_power_sulfur_emissions.failure_behavior: Do not merge oil with coal emissions without fuel-specific reporting.

onroad_combustion_nox_emissions.geography: named emitting facility, fleet, corridor, or deposition-monitoring site
onroad_combustion_nox_emissions.transformation: Retain vehicle class, fuel, technology, activity, and measurement or inventory method.
onroad_combustion_nox_emissions.uncertainty: Fleet mix and controls strongly affect emission rates.
onroad_combustion_nox_emissions.threshold_provenance: EPA/USGS acid-deposition precursor and monitoring framing.
onroad_combustion_nox_emissions.failure_behavior: Do not infer NOx from vehicle count alone.

offroad_combustion_nox_emissions.geography: named emitting facility, fleet, corridor, or deposition-monitoring site
offroad_combustion_nox_emissions.transformation: Retain equipment type, engine tier, fuel, operating hours, and measurement or inventory method.
offroad_combustion_nox_emissions.uncertainty: Equipment use and control technology vary.
offroad_combustion_nox_emissions.threshold_provenance: EPA/USGS acid-deposition precursor and monitoring framing.
offroad_combustion_nox_emissions.failure_behavior: Do not use construction area as an NOx proxy.

acid_rain_deposition.unit: sulfate, nitrate, ammonium, hydrogen-ion flux, or precipitation chemistry with method
acid_rain_deposition.geography: named emitting facility, fleet, corridor, or deposition-monitoring site
acid_rain_deposition.transformation: Retain wet/dry mode, analyte, precipitation amount, sampling duration, wind transport context, and monitoring method.
acid_rain_deposition.uncertainty: Deposition varies with chemistry, weather, and transport.
acid_rain_deposition.threshold_provenance: EPA/USGS acid-deposition precursor and monitoring framing.
acid_rain_deposition.failure_behavior: Do not equate precursor emissions at source with deposition at a receptor site.

forest_multiyear_moisture_deficit.unit: species-relevant soil-moisture, vapor-pressure-deficit, or climatic-water-deficit anomaly
forest_multiyear_moisture_deficit.geography: named forest stand, landscape, or host population
forest_multiyear_moisture_deficit.cadence: seasonal to annual field, remote-sensing, or survey interval
forest_multiyear_moisture_deficit.transformation: Retain baseline, depth or model layer, species, and exposure window.
forest_multiyear_moisture_deficit.uncertainty: Water-deficit estimates vary by model and rooting depth.
forest_multiyear_moisture_deficit.threshold_provenance: USGS and US Forest Service forest-disturbance evidence.
forest_multiyear_moisture_deficit.failure_behavior: Do not use annual precipitation alone.

forest_extreme_heat_exposure.unit: degree-days or heat-event duration above species-relevant threshold
forest_extreme_heat_exposure.geography: named forest stand, landscape, or host population
forest_extreme_heat_exposure.cadence: seasonal to annual field, remote-sensing, or survey interval
forest_extreme_heat_exposure.transformation: Retain threshold, season, canopy context, and baseline.
forest_extreme_heat_exposure.threshold_provenance: USGS and US Forest Service forest-disturbance evidence.
forest_extreme_heat_exposure.failure_behavior: Do not treat regional mean temperature as tree injury.

forest_bark_beetle_outbreak_pressure.unit: attacked trees, trap catch, infestation area, or mortality rate by host
forest_bark_beetle_outbreak_pressure.geography: named forest stand, landscape, or host population
forest_bark_beetle_outbreak_pressure.cadence: seasonal to annual field, remote-sensing, or survey interval
forest_bark_beetle_outbreak_pressure.transformation: Retain beetle species, host, survey method, and attack stage.
forest_bark_beetle_outbreak_pressure.uncertainty: Attack pressure varies by host defense and outbreak phase.
forest_bark_beetle_outbreak_pressure.threshold_provenance: USGS and US Forest Service forest-disturbance evidence.
forest_bark_beetle_outbreak_pressure.failure_behavior: Do not infer outbreak from climate alone.

forest_pathogen_disease_pressure.unit: infection prevalence, severity, or mortality by agent and host
forest_pathogen_disease_pressure.geography: named forest stand, landscape, or host population
forest_pathogen_disease_pressure.cadence: seasonal to annual field, remote-sensing, or survey interval
forest_pathogen_disease_pressure.transformation: Retain pathogen, host, diagnostic method, and disease stage.
forest_pathogen_disease_pressure.uncertainty: Detection does not establish population-level dieback.
forest_pathogen_disease_pressure.threshold_provenance: USGS and US Forest Service forest-disturbance evidence.
forest_pathogen_disease_pressure.failure_behavior: Do not label all discoloration disease.

forest_high_severity_fire_injury.unit: burn severity and tree/stand injury relative to pre-fire condition
forest_high_severity_fire_injury.geography: named forest stand, landscape, or host population
forest_high_severity_fire_injury.cadence: seasonal to annual field, remote-sensing, or survey interval
forest_high_severity_fire_injury.transformation: Retain fire perimeter, severity method, species, injury, and post-fire interval.
forest_high_severity_fire_injury.uncertainty: Severity maps do not measure delayed mortality directly.
forest_high_severity_fire_injury.threshold_provenance: USGS and US Forest Service forest-disturbance evidence.
forest_high_severity_fire_injury.failure_behavior: Do not use burned area alone.

forest_overdense_stand_condition.unit: trees, basal area, or competition index per area by forest type
forest_overdense_stand_condition.geography: named forest stand, landscape, or host population
forest_overdense_stand_condition.cadence: seasonal to annual field, remote-sensing, or survey interval
forest_overdense_stand_condition.transformation: Retain species, size class, site quality, and management history.
forest_overdense_stand_condition.uncertainty: Density effects vary by site and species.
forest_overdense_stand_condition.threshold_provenance: USGS and US Forest Service forest-disturbance evidence.
forest_overdense_stand_condition.failure_behavior: Do not apply one density threshold across forest types.

forest_fragmentation_edge_stress.unit: patch size, edge density, distance to edge, or connectivity metric
forest_fragmentation_edge_stress.geography: named forest stand, landscape, or host population
forest_fragmentation_edge_stress.cadence: seasonal to annual field, remote-sensing, or survey interval
forest_fragmentation_edge_stress.transformation: Retain habitat type, edge definition, time period, and disturbance context.
forest_fragmentation_edge_stress.uncertainty: Edge effects differ by region and forest type.
forest_fragmentation_edge_stress.threshold_provenance: USGS and US Forest Service forest-disturbance evidence.
forest_fragmentation_edge_stress.failure_behavior: Do not equate any mapped edge with dieback.

forest_invasive_pest_pressure.unit: occurrence, infestation area, host attack, or damage severity by named pest
forest_invasive_pest_pressure.geography: named forest stand, landscape, or host population
forest_invasive_pest_pressure.cadence: seasonal to annual field, remote-sensing, or survey interval
forest_invasive_pest_pressure.transformation: Retain pest, host, detection method, and management status.
forest_invasive_pest_pressure.uncertainty: Presence may precede or not cause significant mortality.
forest_invasive_pest_pressure.threshold_provenance: USGS and US Forest Service forest-disturbance evidence.
forest_invasive_pest_pressure.failure_behavior: Do not conflate native and invasive pests.

forest_dieback_areas.unit: area with verified canopy mortality or tree mortality rate against local baseline
forest_dieback_areas.geography: named forest stand, landscape, or host population
forest_dieback_areas.cadence: seasonal to annual field, remote-sensing, or survey interval
forest_dieback_areas.transformation: Retain forest type, species, mortality method, baseline, and cause-attribution status.
forest_dieback_areas.uncertainty: Remote canopy change may reflect harvest, fire, or phenology.
forest_dieback_areas.threshold_provenance: USGS and US Forest Service forest-disturbance evidence.
forest_dieback_areas.failure_behavior: Do not call canopy loss dieback without a bounded mortality assessment.

intensive_soil_tillage_disturbance.unit: tillage passes, depth, implement, and timing by field
intensive_soil_tillage_disturbance.geography: named field, soil profile, and management unit
intensive_soil_tillage_disturbance.transformation: Retain soil moisture, depth, residue cover, implement, and crop stage.
intensive_soil_tillage_disturbance.uncertainty: Pass counts do not measure aggregate damage directly.
intensive_soil_tillage_disturbance.threshold_provenance: USDA NRCS and ERS soil-health evidence.
intensive_soil_tillage_disturbance.failure_behavior: Do not classify any planting operation as intensive tillage.

low_crop_rotation_diversity.unit: crop species, cover-crop presence, and continuous-living-root duration
low_crop_rotation_diversity.geography: named field, soil profile, and management unit
low_crop_rotation_diversity.transformation: Retain crop sequence, cover crops, residue, grazing, and field history.
low_crop_rotation_diversity.uncertainty: Crop labels do not fully measure root exudates or microbial food.
low_crop_rotation_diversity.threshold_provenance: USDA NRCS and ERS soil-health evidence.
low_crop_rotation_diversity.failure_behavior: Do not infer soil biology from one season alone.

erosion_driven_topsoil_organic_matter_lo.unit: soil loss and organic-carbon or organic-matter loss by field
erosion_driven_topsoil_organic_matter_lo.geography: named field, soil profile, and management unit
erosion_driven_topsoil_organic_matter_lo.transformation: Retain erosion process, sampling depth, organic matter, cover, slope, and control site.
erosion_driven_topsoil_organic_matter_lo.uncertainty: Erosion estimates and carbon enrichment differ by soil and event.
erosion_driven_topsoil_organic_matter_lo.threshold_provenance: USDA NRCS and ERS soil-health evidence.
erosion_driven_topsoil_organic_matter_lo.failure_behavior: Do not equate bare ground with measured topsoil loss.

agricultural_soil_compaction.unit: bulk density, penetration resistance, porosity, or root restriction by depth
agricultural_soil_compaction.geography: named field, soil profile, and management unit
agricultural_soil_compaction.transformation: Retain moisture, texture, depth, management, and instrument method.
agricultural_soil_compaction.uncertainty: Natural dense layers can resemble management compaction.
agricultural_soil_compaction.threshold_provenance: USDA NRCS and ERS soil-health evidence.
agricultural_soil_compaction.failure_behavior: Do not label compaction without a soil measurement or bounded assessment.

soil_microbial_depletion.unit: microbial biomass, respiration, enzyme activity, or validated diversity index by method
soil_microbial_depletion.geography: named field, soil profile, and management unit
soil_microbial_depletion.transformation: Retain depth, moisture, season, assay, storage, and reference condition.
soil_microbial_depletion.uncertainty: Methods capture different microbial properties and vary seasonally.
soil_microbial_depletion.threshold_provenance: USDA NRCS and ERS soil-health evidence.
soil_microbial_depletion.failure_behavior: Do not infer microbial depletion from yield or organic matter alone.

urban_hydrologic_supply_shortfall.metric_name: Global safely managed drinking-water service gap
urban_hydrologic_supply_shortfall.unit: people and percent of global population
urban_hydrologic_supply_shortfall.geography: global population and WHO/UNICEF reporting regions
urban_hydrologic_supply_shortfall.transformation: Retain service ladder, year, population denominator, urban/rural split, availability and quality dimensions.
urban_hydrologic_supply_shortfall.uncertainty: Country estimates and service dimensions vary.
urban_hydrologic_supply_shortfall.threshold_provenance: USGS water-limitation and EPA utility drought-response guidance.
urban_hydrologic_supply_shortfall.failure_behavior: Do not infer utility rationing, source-specific hydrology or treatment failure from the global gap.

urban_water_demand_peak.unit: volume or flow above baseline by customer class
urban_water_demand_peak.geography: named public-water utility or service area
urban_water_demand_peak.transformation: Keep weather, population, demand class, and supply capacity.
urban_water_demand_peak.uncertainty: Peak demand can be short lived.
urban_water_demand_peak.threshold_provenance: USGS water-limitation and EPA utility drought-response guidance.
urban_water_demand_peak.failure_behavior: Do not treat annual demand as peak stress.

urban_distribution_water_loss.metric_name: Global non-revenue water volume and economic loss
urban_distribution_water_loss.unit: billion cubic metres and USD billion per year
urban_distribution_water_loss.transformation: Keep physical and apparent losses combined unless a validated water balance separates them.
urban_distribution_water_loss.uncertainty: Meter error, illegal use, unbilled authorized consumption and physical leakage all affect non-revenue water.
urban_distribution_water_loss.threshold_provenance: USGS water-limitation and EPA utility drought-response guidance.
urban_distribution_water_loss.failure_behavior: Do not treat all non-revenue water as physical leakage.

urban_source_water_treatment_constraint.metric_name: Global safely managed drinking-water service gap
urban_source_water_treatment_constraint.unit: people and percent of global population
urban_source_water_treatment_constraint.geography: global population and WHO/UNICEF reporting regions
urban_source_water_treatment_constraint.transformation: Retain service ladder, year, availability, accessibility and water-quality dimensions separately.
urban_source_water_treatment_constraint.uncertainty: The global gap combines source, distribution, availability and quality constraints.
urban_source_water_treatment_constraint.threshold_provenance: USGS water-limitation and EPA utility drought-response guidance.
urban_source_water_treatment_constraint.failure_behavior: Do not attribute every service gap to treatment capacity or raw-water quality.

urban_water_rationing_zones.unit: restriction stage, affected connections, and duration
urban_water_rationing_zones.geography: named public-water utility or service area
urban_water_rationing_zones.transformation: Keep legal trigger, supply status, exemption rules, and compliance period.
urban_water_rationing_zones.uncertainty: Policies and restrictions vary by jurisdiction.
urban_water_rationing_zones.threshold_provenance: USGS water-limitation and EPA utility drought-response guidance.
urban_water_rationing_zones.failure_behavior: Do not infer rationing from water limitation without a utility action.

offshore_well_control_loss.unit: well-control status, kick, barrier loss, or shut-in event
offshore_well_control_loss.geography: named offshore facility, well, or lease area
offshore_well_control_loss.cadence: incident, test, inspection, or operating interval
offshore_well_control_loss.transformation: Keep well, depth, barrier status, operations, and incident outcome.
offshore_well_control_loss.uncertainty: Reporting and severity vary by operation.
offshore_well_control_loss.threshold_provenance: BSEE well-control, hurricane, and spill-preparedness evidence.
offshore_well_control_loss.failure_behavior: Do not infer control loss from drilling activity.

offshore_bop_system_failure.unit: failed test, unavailable function, or maintenance finding by BOP subsystem
offshore_bop_system_failure.geography: named offshore facility, well, or lease area
offshore_bop_system_failure.cadence: incident, test, inspection, or operating interval
offshore_bop_system_failure.transformation: Keep test method, subsystem, remediation, and operating context.
offshore_bop_system_failure.uncertainty: A test result may not equal an in-service failure.
offshore_bop_system_failure.threshold_provenance: BSEE well-control, hurricane, and spill-preparedness evidence.
offshore_bop_system_failure.failure_behavior: Do not label all maintenance a BOP failure.

offshore_facility_storm_damage.unit: facility damage, shutdown, mooring or well-securing status by storm
offshore_facility_storm_damage.geography: named offshore facility, well, or lease area
offshore_facility_storm_damage.cadence: incident, test, inspection, or operating interval
offshore_facility_storm_damage.transformation: Keep storm exposure, facility design, damage, and securing actions.
offshore_facility_storm_damage.uncertainty: Storm exposure does not prove damage or spill.
offshore_facility_storm_damage.threshold_provenance: BSEE well-control, hurricane, and spill-preparedness evidence.
offshore_facility_storm_damage.failure_behavior: Do not infer a release from a hurricane track.

offshore_oil_system_integrity_failure.unit: corrosion, fatigue, inspection finding, or mechanical failure by component
offshore_oil_system_integrity_failure.geography: named offshore facility, well, or lease area
offshore_oil_system_integrity_failure.cadence: incident, test, inspection, or operating interval
offshore_oil_system_integrity_failure.transformation: Keep component, inspection method, corrosion mechanism, and repair status.
offshore_oil_system_integrity_failure.uncertainty: Inspection coverage and failure probability vary.
offshore_oil_system_integrity_failure.threshold_provenance: BSEE well-control, hurricane, and spill-preparedness evidence.
offshore_oil_system_integrity_failure.failure_behavior: Do not equate aging with failure.

deepwater_petroleum_spill_risk.unit: documented risk assessment, incident, or loss-of-containment status
deepwater_petroleum_spill_risk.geography: named offshore facility, well, or lease area
deepwater_petroleum_spill_risk.cadence: incident, test, inspection, or operating interval
deepwater_petroleum_spill_risk.transformation: Keep facility, release pathway, volume status, response plan, and investigation status.
deepwater_petroleum_spill_risk.uncertainty: Risk analysis is probabilistic and not a spill prediction.
deepwater_petroleum_spill_risk.threshold_provenance: BSEE well-control, hurricane, and spill-preparedness evidence.
deepwater_petroleum_spill_risk.failure_behavior: Do not present risk as a confirmed release.

wildfire_smoke_pm25_exposure.unit: micrograms per cubic meter with smoke attribution
wildfire_smoke_pm25_exposure.geography: named community, health jurisdiction, or smoke-affected area
wildfire_smoke_pm25_exposure.transformation: Keep monitor, satellite/model method, population weighting, and attribution method.
wildfire_smoke_pm25_exposure.uncertainty: Smoke attribution and local infiltration vary.
wildfire_smoke_pm25_exposure.threshold_provenance: EPA and CDC wildfire-smoke health guidance.
wildfire_smoke_pm25_exposure.failure_behavior: Do not use total PM2.5 as wildfire smoke without attribution.

wildfire_smoke_exposure_duration.unit: hours or days above a stated smoke PM2.5 threshold
wildfire_smoke_exposure_duration.geography: named community, health jurisdiction, or smoke-affected area
wildfire_smoke_exposure_duration.transformation: Keep threshold, gaps, plume attribution, and event definition.
wildfire_smoke_exposure_duration.uncertainty: Duration does not capture individual exposure.
wildfire_smoke_exposure_duration.threshold_provenance: EPA and CDC wildfire-smoke health guidance.
wildfire_smoke_exposure_duration.failure_behavior: Do not infer duration from fire perimeter alone.

smoke_sensitive_population_prevalence.unit: population count or proportion by documented vulnerability category
smoke_sensitive_population_prevalence.geography: named community, health jurisdiction, or smoke-affected area
smoke_sensitive_population_prevalence.transformation: Keep age, clinical, occupational, and data-coverage boundary.
smoke_sensitive_population_prevalence.uncertainty: Population prevalence does not predict individual admission.
smoke_sensitive_population_prevalence.threshold_provenance: EPA and CDC wildfire-smoke health guidance.
smoke_sensitive_population_prevalence.failure_behavior: Do not treat vulnerability as illness.

smoke_protection_access_gap.unit: affected people or facilities lacking documented protective access
smoke_protection_access_gap.geography: named community, health jurisdiction, or smoke-affected area
smoke_protection_access_gap.transformation: Keep filtration, shelter, evacuation, care access, and event timing.
smoke_protection_access_gap.threshold_provenance: EPA and CDC wildfire-smoke health guidance.
smoke_protection_access_gap.failure_behavior: Do not infer lack of protection from income alone.

wildfire_smoke_hospitalization_burden.unit: daily cause-specific admissions or attributable rate with case definition
wildfire_smoke_hospitalization_burden.geography: named community, health jurisdiction, or smoke-affected area
wildfire_smoke_hospitalization_burden.transformation: Keep diagnosis group, population, lag, smoke attribution, and statistical method.
wildfire_smoke_hospitalization_burden.uncertainty: Admissions have multiple causes and exposure attribution is uncertain.
wildfire_smoke_hospitalization_burden.threshold_provenance: EPA and CDC wildfire-smoke health guidance.
wildfire_smoke_hospitalization_burden.failure_behavior: Do not label all respiratory admissions wildfire-caused.

reservoir_inflow_timing_mismatch.unit: days relative to a documented historical or rule-curve reference
reservoir_inflow_timing_mismatch.cadence: daily to seasonal operations and annual capacity review
reservoir_inflow_timing_mismatch.transformation: Keep basin, runoff metric, reference period, rule curve, and flood-control constraint.
reservoir_inflow_timing_mismatch.uncertainty: Natural variability and reference-period choice affect an offset.
reservoir_inflow_timing_mismatch.threshold_provenance: USGS, Bureau of Reclamation, and USACE reservoir hydrology and operations material.
reservoir_inflow_timing_mismatch.failure_behavior: Do not infer mismatch from temperature or snowpack alone.

multi_season_reservoir_inflow_deficit.unit: seasonal volume and percent of documented normal or operating forecast
multi_season_reservoir_inflow_deficit.cadence: daily to seasonal operations and annual capacity review
multi_season_reservoir_inflow_deficit.transformation: Keep inflow gauge, water year, baseline, storage starting condition, and forecast revision.
multi_season_reservoir_inflow_deficit.uncertainty: A dry season can be offset by storage, transfers, or later inflow.
multi_season_reservoir_inflow_deficit.threshold_provenance: USGS, Bureau of Reclamation, and USACE reservoir hydrology and operations material.
multi_season_reservoir_inflow_deficit.failure_behavior: Do not label a single low-flow observation a carryover deficit.

reservoir_sedimentation_capacity_loss.unit: volume or percent capacity lost, with bathymetric survey date
reservoir_sedimentation_capacity_loss.cadence: daily to seasonal operations and annual capacity review
reservoir_sedimentation_capacity_loss.transformation: Keep survey method, datum, original capacity, usable/dead-storage definition, and sediment period.
reservoir_sedimentation_capacity_loss.uncertainty: Survey frequency and datum changes create comparability limits.
reservoir_sedimentation_capacity_loss.threshold_provenance: USGS, Bureau of Reclamation, and USACE reservoir hydrology and operations material.
reservoir_sedimentation_capacity_loss.failure_behavior: Do not estimate capacity loss from watershed erosion alone.

competing_reservoir_release_obligations.unit: documented release volume, rule, entitlement, or unmet objective
competing_reservoir_release_obligations.cadence: daily to seasonal operations and annual capacity review
competing_reservoir_release_obligations.transformation: Keep operating rule, legal/contractual basis, season, forecast, and affected objective.
competing_reservoir_release_obligations.uncertainty: A stated objective may be met through coordination or transfers.
competing_reservoir_release_obligations.threshold_provenance: USGS, Bureau of Reclamation, and USACE reservoir hydrology and operations material.
competing_reservoir_release_obligations.failure_behavior: Do not infer conflict merely because a reservoir is multipurpose.

reservoir_storage_instability.unit: usable storage anomaly, refill reliability, or operating shortfall against a stated rule
reservoir_storage_instability.cadence: daily to seasonal operations and annual capacity review
reservoir_storage_instability.transformation: Keep reservoir, usable-capacity definition, inflow, release, sediment, and rule-curve context.
reservoir_storage_instability.uncertainty: Storage levels combine climate, operations, demands, transfers, and measurement choices.
reservoir_storage_instability.threshold_provenance: USGS, Bureau of Reclamation, and USACE reservoir hydrology and operations material.
reservoir_storage_instability.failure_behavior: Do not use a single reservoir level as a regional water-security conclusion.

population_weighted_pm25_exposure.unit: micrograms per cubic meter, with monitoring or model method
population_weighted_pm25_exposure.geography: named community, health jurisdiction, or exposure-model domain
population_weighted_pm25_exposure.cadence: hourly to annual exposure and health-surveillance interval
population_weighted_pm25_exposure.transformation: Keep monitor/model, averaging period, population weighting, and missingness.
population_weighted_pm25_exposure.uncertainty: Exposure estimates can differ by model and indoor infiltration.
population_weighted_pm25_exposure.threshold_provenance: WHO air-quality guidance and EPA health-effects assessments.
population_weighted_pm25_exposure.failure_behavior: Do not equate concentration with individual dose.

population_weighted_ozone_exposure.unit: ppb or micrograms per cubic meter with averaging period
population_weighted_ozone_exposure.geography: named community, health jurisdiction, or exposure-model domain
population_weighted_ozone_exposure.cadence: hourly to annual exposure and health-surveillance interval
population_weighted_ozone_exposure.transformation: Keep monitor/model, averaging metric, season, population weighting, and missingness.
population_weighted_ozone_exposure.uncertainty: Ozone formation and exposure vary strongly by time and place.
population_weighted_ozone_exposure.threshold_provenance: WHO air-quality guidance and EPA health-effects assessments.
population_weighted_ozone_exposure.failure_behavior: Do not infer ozone exposure from heat alone.

population_weighted_no2_exposure.unit: ppb or micrograms per cubic meter with averaging period
population_weighted_no2_exposure.geography: named community, health jurisdiction, or exposure-model domain
population_weighted_no2_exposure.cadence: hourly to annual exposure and health-surveillance interval
population_weighted_no2_exposure.transformation: Keep monitor/model, averaging metric, population weighting, and local source context.
population_weighted_no2_exposure.uncertainty: NO2 can correlate with co-pollutants and traffic mixtures rather than acting alone.
population_weighted_no2_exposure.threshold_provenance: WHO air-quality guidance and EPA health-effects assessments.
population_weighted_no2_exposure.failure_behavior: Do not assign a health outcome to NO2 alone in a mixed exposure setting.

air_pollution_susceptibility_prevalence.unit: population count or proportion by documented vulnerability category
air_pollution_susceptibility_prevalence.geography: named community, health jurisdiction, or exposure-model domain
air_pollution_susceptibility_prevalence.cadence: hourly to annual exposure and health-surveillance interval
air_pollution_susceptibility_prevalence.transformation: Keep age, clinical, pregnancy, occupation, and data-coverage boundary.
air_pollution_susceptibility_prevalence.uncertainty: Population prevalence does not predict individual illness.
air_pollution_susceptibility_prevalence.threshold_provenance: WHO air-quality guidance and EPA health-effects assessments.
air_pollution_susceptibility_prevalence.failure_behavior: Do not infer disease from demographic status.

air_pollution_health_burden.unit: deaths per 100,000 population, age-standardized, with 95% uncertainty interval
air_pollution_health_burden.geography: named community, health jurisdiction, or exposure-model domain
air_pollution_health_burden.cadence: hourly to annual exposure and health-surveillance interval
air_pollution_health_burden.transformation: Retain country, year, sex, cause aggregate, age standardization, comparative-risk-assessment method, central estimate, and lower and upper interval. Keep ambient-only, household-only, and joint burden separate.
air_pollution_health_burden.uncertainty: Attribution is model-based and depends on exposure surfaces, exposure-response functions, background disease burden, population data, and assessment release.
air_pollution_health_burden.threshold_provenance: WHO air-quality guidance and EPA health-effects assessments.
air_pollution_health_burden.failure_behavior: Retain the last validated WHO release, mark stale, and never infer attributable mortality from concentration alone or replace missing estimates with zero.

warm_rain_on_snow_storm.unit: rainfall amount, temperature or freezing level, and snow-covered area
warm_rain_on_snow_storm.geography: named snow-covered watershed and downstream forecast reach
warm_rain_on_snow_storm.transformation: Keep storm track, elevation, rain/snow partition, and duration.
warm_rain_on_snow_storm.uncertainty: Gauge coverage and freezing-level estimates vary across terrain.
warm_rain_on_snow_storm.threshold_provenance: USGS and NOAA snow, soil-moisture, streamflow, and flood-hazard materials.
warm_rain_on_snow_storm.failure_behavior: Do not infer rain-on-snow from precipitation alone.

snowpack_water_equivalent_load.unit: millimeters or inches of snow water equivalent
snowpack_water_equivalent_load.geography: named snow-covered watershed and downstream forecast reach
snowpack_water_equivalent_load.transformation: Keep station/model, elevation, basin aggregation, and observation date.
snowpack_water_equivalent_load.uncertainty: Snow density and spatial sampling create uncertainty.
snowpack_water_equivalent_load.threshold_provenance: USGS and NOAA snow, soil-moisture, streamflow, and flood-hazard materials.
snowpack_water_equivalent_load.failure_behavior: Do not use snow depth as water equivalent without density context.

antecedent_watershed_saturation.unit: soil moisture, storage deficit, or saturation percentile
antecedent_watershed_saturation.geography: named snow-covered watershed and downstream forecast reach
antecedent_watershed_saturation.transformation: Keep soil depth, model/measurement, antecedent window, and basin.
antecedent_watershed_saturation.uncertainty: Soil properties and model structure alter saturation estimates.
antecedent_watershed_saturation.threshold_provenance: USGS and NOAA snow, soil-moisture, streamflow, and flood-hazard materials.
antecedent_watershed_saturation.failure_behavior: Do not infer saturation from recent rain alone.

rapid_basin_runoff_transmission.unit: documented slope, permeability, drainage, or modeled travel-time indicator
rapid_basin_runoff_transmission.geography: named snow-covered watershed and downstream forecast reach
rapid_basin_runoff_transmission.transformation: Keep basin boundary, land cover, slope, and hydraulic assumption.
rapid_basin_runoff_transmission.uncertainty: Transmission conditions vary within a basin and by storm.
rapid_basin_runoff_transmission.threshold_provenance: USGS and NOAA snow, soil-moisture, streamflow, and flood-hazard materials.
rapid_basin_runoff_transmission.failure_behavior: Do not treat urbanization or slope alone as a flood event.

rain_on_snow_flood_risk.unit: forecasted or observed streamflow/stage probability relative to named threshold
rain_on_snow_flood_risk.geography: named snow-covered watershed and downstream forecast reach
rain_on_snow_flood_risk.transformation: Keep basin, threshold, snow, rain, temperature, soil, and forecast model.
rain_on_snow_flood_risk.uncertainty: Flood risk depends on channel conditions, forecast error, and exposure.
rain_on_snow_flood_risk.threshold_provenance: USGS and NOAA snow, soil-moisture, streamflow, and flood-hazard materials.
rain_on_snow_flood_risk.failure_behavior: Do not treat a rain-on-snow event as a confirmed flood.

surface_water_inflow_deficit.unit: volume, discharge, precipitation, affected-basin count, or percent of documented normal
surface_water_inflow_deficit.geography: global basin assessment or named surface-water body with aggregation retained
surface_water_inflow_deficit.cadence: major UN-Water assessment cycle or daily-to-seasonal water-balance interval
surface_water_inflow_deficit.transformation: Keep basin or water body, inflow source, period, baseline, denominator, and gauge/model method.
surface_water_inflow_deficit.uncertainty: Baselines, basin delineation, satellite coverage and ungauged inflow estimates vary.
surface_water_inflow_deficit.failure_behavior: Do not infer storage loss from regional precipitation alone or classify unassessed basins as unaffected.

surface_water_evaporative_loss.unit: depth or volume per stated interval
surface_water_evaporative_loss.geography: named lake, wetland, river reach, or hydrologically connected surface-water body
surface_water_evaporative_loss.transformation: Keep water-body area, method, meteorology, and interval.
surface_water_evaporative_loss.uncertainty: Area and evaporation estimates change with water level and method.
surface_water_evaporative_loss.failure_behavior: Do not equate hot weather with measured evaporation loss.

surface_water_groundwater_exchange_shift.unit: estimated or measured seepage/recharge volume and direction
surface_water_groundwater_exchange_shift.geography: named lake, wetland, river reach, or hydrologically connected surface-water body
surface_water_groundwater_exchange_shift.transformation: Keep hydraulic gradient, sediments, measurement/model, and period.
surface_water_groundwater_exchange_shift.uncertainty: Exchange is spatially variable and difficult to observe directly.
surface_water_groundwater_exchange_shift.failure_behavior: Do not infer exchange direction from nearby wells alone.

surface_water_withdrawal_pressure.unit: withdrawal or diversion volume relative to inflow/storage
surface_water_withdrawal_pressure.geography: named lake, wetland, river reach, or hydrologically connected surface-water body
surface_water_withdrawal_pressure.transformation: Keep permit, actual withdrawal, return flow, water body, and period.
surface_water_withdrawal_pressure.uncertainty: Reported withdrawals may omit return flow or timing.
surface_water_withdrawal_pressure.failure_behavior: Do not assume permitted volume was withdrawn.

surface_water_storage_instability.unit: water-level, area, volume, affected-basin count, or water-balance anomaly against stated reference
surface_water_storage_instability.geography: global basin assessment or named surface-water body with aggregation retained
surface_water_storage_instability.cadence: major UN-Water assessment cycle or daily-to-seasonal water-balance interval
surface_water_storage_instability.transformation: Keep basin or water body, storage geometry, reference and observation periods, denominator, inflow, outflow, exchange, and observation method.
surface_water_storage_instability.uncertainty: Natural seasonal variability, satellite detection, basin delineation and data gaps constrain inference.
surface_water_storage_instability.failure_behavior: Do not generalize one water body to regional water security or classify unassessed basins as stable.

permafrost_ground_warming.geography: named permafrost profile, lake setting, or infrastructure corridor
permafrost_ground_warming.transformation: Keep depth, sensor, datum, and period.
permafrost_ground_warming.threshold_provenance: USGS and NSIDC talik and permafrost hydrothermal research.
permafrost_ground_warming.failure_behavior: Do not infer talik from air temperature alone.

insulating_snow_cover.unit: snow depth/density and winter thermal gradient
insulating_snow_cover.geography: named permafrost profile, lake setting, or infrastructure corridor
insulating_snow_cover.transformation: Keep snow distribution, density, and ground cover.
insulating_snow_cover.threshold_provenance: USGS and NSIDC talik and permafrost hydrothermal research.
insulating_snow_cover.failure_behavior: Do not use regional snowfall as site insulation.

subsurface_heat_advection.unit: groundwater flow, thermal gradient, or modeled heat flux
subsurface_heat_advection.geography: named permafrost profile, lake setting, or infrastructure corridor
subsurface_heat_advection.transformation: Keep hydrogeology, flow direction, and model assumptions.
subsurface_heat_advection.threshold_provenance: USGS and NSIDC talik and permafrost hydrothermal research.
subsurface_heat_advection.failure_behavior: Do not infer heat advection from wetness alone.

lake_beneath_permafrost_heat.unit: lake depth, duration of open water, and subsurface temperature
lake_beneath_permafrost_heat.geography: named permafrost profile, lake setting, or infrastructure corridor
lake_beneath_permafrost_heat.transformation: Keep lake geometry, ice regime, and profile.
lake_beneath_permafrost_heat.threshold_provenance: USGS and NSIDC talik and permafrost hydrothermal research.
lake_beneath_permafrost_heat.failure_behavior: Do not claim all lakes form taliks.

talik_expansion.unit: unfrozen-zone thickness, area, or duration by method
talik_expansion.geography: named permafrost profile, lake setting, or infrastructure corridor
talik_expansion.transformation: Keep depth, method, site, and monitoring period.
talik_expansion.uncertainty: Taliks can be transient and refreeze.
talik_expansion.threshold_provenance: USGS and NSIDC talik and permafrost hydrothermal research.
talik_expansion.failure_behavior: Do not portray one talik as regional permafrost loss.

ice_rich_coastal_bluff_exposure.unit: site-specific mapped, observed, or modeled value
ice_rich_coastal_bluff_exposure.transformation: Keep site, method, event window, and uncertainty.
ice_rich_coastal_bluff_exposure.uncertainty: Coastal forcing and landform properties vary locally.
ice_rich_coastal_bluff_exposure.failure_behavior: Do not generalize from one coast to the Arctic.

arctic_open_water_season.unit: site-specific mapped, observed, or modeled value
arctic_open_water_season.transformation: Keep site, method, event window, and uncertainty.
arctic_open_water_season.uncertainty: Coastal forcing and landform properties vary locally.
arctic_open_water_season.failure_behavior: Do not generalize from one coast to the Arctic.

arctic_nearshore_wave_energy.unit: site-specific mapped, observed, or modeled value
arctic_nearshore_wave_energy.transformation: Keep site, method, event window, and uncertainty.
arctic_nearshore_wave_energy.uncertainty: Coastal forcing and landform properties vary locally.
arctic_nearshore_wave_energy.failure_behavior: Do not generalize from one coast to the Arctic.

arctic_coastal_storm_water_level.unit: site-specific mapped, observed, or modeled value
arctic_coastal_storm_water_level.transformation: Keep site, method, event window, and uncertainty.
arctic_coastal_storm_water_level.uncertainty: Coastal forcing and landform properties vary locally.
arctic_coastal_storm_water_level.failure_behavior: Do not generalize from one coast to the Arctic.

fracking_produced_water_volume.unit: reported volume, incident count, concentration, or compliance status
fracking_produced_water_volume.geography: named hydraulic-fracturing operation or receiving water
fracking_produced_water_volume.transformation: Keep facility, pathway, volume, chemistry, receiving water, and status.
fracking_produced_water_volume.uncertainty: Reporting and exposure pathways vary by site.
fracking_produced_water_volume.failure_behavior: Do not infer release or contamination from production alone.

fracking_wastewater_containment_failure.unit: reported volume, incident count, concentration, or compliance status
fracking_wastewater_containment_failure.geography: named hydraulic-fracturing operation or receiving water
fracking_wastewater_containment_failure.transformation: Keep facility, pathway, volume, chemistry, receiving water, and status.
fracking_wastewater_containment_failure.uncertainty: Reporting and exposure pathways vary by site.
fracking_wastewater_containment_failure.failure_behavior: Do not infer release or contamination from production alone.

fracking_wastewater_transfer_spill.geography: named hydraulic-fracturing operation or receiving water
fracking_wastewater_transfer_spill.transformation: Keep facility, pathway, volume, chemistry, receiving water, and status.
fracking_wastewater_transfer_spill.uncertainty: Reporting and exposure pathways vary by site.
fracking_wastewater_transfer_spill.failure_behavior: Do not infer release or contamination from production alone.

fracking_wastewater_treatment_discharge_.unit: reported volume, incident count, concentration, or compliance status
fracking_wastewater_treatment_discharge_.geography: named hydraulic-fracturing operation or receiving water
fracking_wastewater_treatment_discharge_.transformation: Keep facility, pathway, volume, chemistry, receiving water, and status.
fracking_wastewater_treatment_discharge_.uncertainty: Reporting and exposure pathways vary by site.
fracking_wastewater_treatment_discharge_.failure_behavior: Do not infer release or contamination from production alone.

fracking_wastewater_lakes.unit: reported volume, incident count, concentration, or compliance status
fracking_wastewater_lakes.geography: named hydraulic-fracturing operation or receiving water
fracking_wastewater_lakes.transformation: Keep facility, pathway, volume, chemistry, receiving water, and status.
fracking_wastewater_lakes.uncertainty: Reporting and exposure pathways vary by site.
fracking_wastewater_lakes.failure_behavior: Do not infer release or contamination from production alone.

coastal_nutrient_loading.unit: site-specific concentration, biomass, oxygen demand, density gradient, or dissolved oxygen value
coastal_nutrient_loading.geography: named estuary, coastal shelf, or marine basin
coastal_nutrient_loading.transformation: Keep station, depth, sampling method, tidal state, season, and uncertainty.
coastal_nutrient_loading.uncertainty: Hypoxia has natural and site-specific drivers; measurements must retain depth and timing.
coastal_nutrient_loading.failure_behavior: Do not infer persistent hypoxia from nutrients, an algal bloom, or stratification alone.

coastal_algal_biomass_pulse.geography: named estuary, coastal shelf, or marine basin
coastal_algal_biomass_pulse.transformation: Keep station, depth, sampling method, tidal state, season, and uncertainty.
coastal_algal_biomass_pulse.uncertainty: Hypoxia has natural and site-specific drivers; measurements must retain depth and timing.
coastal_algal_biomass_pulse.failure_behavior: Do not infer persistent hypoxia from nutrients, an algal bloom, or stratification alone.

coastal_organic_matter_respiration.transformation: Keep station, depth, sampling method, tidal state, season, and uncertainty.

coastal_water_column_stratification.failure_behavior: Do not infer persistent hypoxia from nutrients, an algal bloom, or stratification alone.

anoxic_dead_zones.unit: site-specific concentration, biomass, oxygen demand, density gradient, or dissolved oxygen value
anoxic_dead_zones.geography: named estuary, coastal shelf, or marine basin
anoxic_dead_zones.transformation: Keep station, depth, sampling method, tidal state, season, and uncertainty.
anoxic_dead_zones.uncertainty: Hypoxia has natural and site-specific drivers; measurements must retain depth and timing.
anoxic_dead_zones.failure_behavior: Do not infer persistent hypoxia from nutrients, an algal bloom, or stratification alone.

tundra_summer_warming.unit: site-specific temperature, day count, moisture, thaw depth, shrub cover, height, or biomass
tundra_summer_warming.transformation: Keep taxon, plot or pixel, season, method, and local hydrology.
tundra_summer_warming.uncertainty: Greening and shrub expansion vary by taxon, region, and disturbance history.
tundra_summer_warming.threshold_provenance: NOAA Arctic Report Card tundra-greenness assessments.
tundra_summer_warming.failure_behavior: Do not infer shrub expansion from a regional temperature anomaly or NDVI alone.

tundra_growing_season_lengthening.transformation: Keep taxon, plot or pixel, season, method, and local hydrology.
tundra_growing_season_lengthening.uncertainty: Greening and shrub expansion vary by taxon, region, and disturbance history.
tundra_growing_season_lengthening.threshold_provenance: NOAA Arctic Report Card tundra-greenness assessments.
tundra_growing_season_lengthening.failure_behavior: Do not infer shrub expansion from a regional temperature anomaly or NDVI alone.

tundra_soil_moisture_suitability.failure_behavior: Do not infer shrub expansion from a regional temperature anomaly or NDVI alone.

tundra_active_layer_deepening.transformation: Keep taxon, plot or pixel, season, method, and local hydrology.
tundra_active_layer_deepening.uncertainty: Greening and shrub expansion vary by taxon, region, and disturbance history.
tundra_active_layer_deepening.threshold_provenance: NOAA Arctic Report Card tundra-greenness assessments.
tundra_active_layer_deepening.failure_behavior: Do not infer shrub expansion from a regional temperature anomaly or NDVI alone.

tundra_shrubification_speeds.metric_name: Tundra shrub cover, height, or biomass
tundra_shrubification_speeds.unit: site-specific temperature, day count, moisture, thaw depth, shrub cover, height, or biomass

subsea_cables.threshold_provenance: Use only capacity, topology, status, and incident definitions stated in FCC filings or authoritative operator records.
subsea_cables.failure_behavior: Keep the relationship qualitative and bounded when current system-level capacity, topology, or status cannot be verified.

palm_oil_canopy_clearance.metric_name: Verified forest conversion associated with oil-palm expansion
palm_oil_canopy_clearance.unit: hectares per year, reported with forest baseline, canopy threshold, plantation boundary, and attribution method
palm_oil_canopy_clearance.geography: named plantation, concession, supply shed, subnational jurisdiction, or country
palm_oil_canopy_clearance.transformation: Intersect reviewed oil-palm plantation or probability maps with tree-cover-loss observations, then verify prior land cover and conversion timing; do not equate every tree-cover-loss pixel with deforestation or every loss inside a boundary with oil-palm causation.
palm_oil_canopy_clearance.uncertainty: Plantation and concession boundaries can be incomplete; canopy thresholds, replanting, fire, prior degradation, and temporal lag can change attribution.
palm_oil_canopy_clearance.threshold_provenance: Use the forest definition, canopy threshold, baseline year, plantation-map vintage, and attribution window stated by the underlying study or authoritative monitoring program.
palm_oil_canopy_clearance.failure_behavior: Keep the record in research track and report observed tree-cover loss without causal attribution when prior forest, plantation expansion, or conversion timing cannot be verified.

agricultural_soil_carbon_venting.unit: tonnes of organic carbon per hectare for a stated depth, equivalent-soil-mass method, baseline, and interval
agricultural_soil_carbon_venting.geography: named cropland field, sampling frame, soil map unit, or reporting jurisdiction
agricultural_soil_carbon_venting.cadence: baseline and repeat sampling, normally multi-year
agricultural_soil_carbon_venting.transformation: Retain sampling depth, bulk density, equivalent soil mass, rock fragments, laboratory method, land use, management history, spatial design, and uncertainty.
agricultural_soil_carbon_venting.uncertainty: Spatial heterogeneity, bulk-density change, sampling depth, laboratory method, and short monitoring intervals can dominate observed stock change.
agricultural_soil_carbon_venting.threshold_provenance: Use the named monitoring protocol and confidence interval; the informal venting wording does not define a flux threshold.
agricultural_soil_carbon_venting.failure_behavior: Do not infer stock loss from tillage, crop type, or modeled emission factors without a declared stock-change or flux method.

grassland_soil_carbon_losses.unit: tonnes of organic carbon per hectare for a stated depth, equivalent-soil-mass method, baseline, and interval
grassland_soil_carbon_losses.geography: named pasture, rangeland, grassland sampling frame, soil map unit, or reporting jurisdiction
grassland_soil_carbon_losses.cadence: baseline and repeat sampling, normally multi-year
grassland_soil_carbon_losses.transformation: Retain sampling depth, bulk density, equivalent soil mass, vegetation, grazing and fire history, climate, spatial design, laboratory method, and uncertainty.
grassland_soil_carbon_losses.uncertainty: Strong spatial variability, vegetation change, erosion or deposition, bulk density, grazing history, and sampling interval affect stock-change estimates.
grassland_soil_carbon_losses.threshold_provenance: Use the named monitoring protocol, land-use stratum, and confidence interval; no universal loss threshold is implied.
grassland_soil_carbon_losses.failure_behavior: Do not infer soil-carbon loss from grazing intensity, woody cover, or modeled sequestration potential without comparable stock observations.

cold_chain_refrigerant_leaks.unit: kilograms refrigerant emitted or tonnes CO2e per reporting period
cold_chain_refrigerant_leaks.geography: named refrigerated transport fleet, cold store, warehouse, retail estate, or cold-chain reporting boundary
cold_chain_refrigerant_leaks.transformation: Use mass-balance or verified service data; retain equipment class, refrigerant species, charge, recovery, route or facility boundary, and global-warming-potential basis.
cold_chain_refrigerant_leaks.uncertainty: Leaks may be unobserved; recharge is an imperfect proxy without recovery records.
cold_chain_refrigerant_leaks.threshold_provenance: Montreal Protocol and facility refrigerant accounting.
cold_chain_refrigerant_leaks.failure_behavior: Do not infer leakage from refrigerated throughput, electricity consumption, or equipment count without charge, service, recovery, and stock-change data.

internet_exchange_load.unit: gigabits or terabits per second with peak, percentile, or interval-average method stated
internet_exchange_load.geography: named internet exchange point, switching fabric, metro, or member-facing port set
internet_exchange_load.cadence: five-minute to daily observations with monthly and annual summaries
internet_exchange_load.transformation: Retain direction, aggregation interval, peak or percentile method, member coverage, port capacity, exchange identity, and missing-observation handling.
internet_exchange_load.uncertainty: Private interconnection, cache traffic, sampling intervals, asymmetric flows, and incomplete member coverage limit interpretation.
internet_exchange_load.threshold_provenance: Use the named exchange traffic series and declared capacity boundary; no universal congestion threshold is implied.
internet_exchange_load.failure_behavior: Do not infer total internet demand, user traffic, or congestion from a single exchange peak without routing and coverage context.

data_center_backup_diesel_emissions.unit: litres of fuel, operating hours, and kilograms or tonnes of pollutant per test, outage, or reporting period
data_center_backup_diesel_emissions.geography: named data-center campus, generator fleet, air-quality district, or reporting jurisdiction
data_center_backup_diesel_emissions.cadence: per test or outage event with monthly or annual inventory
data_center_backup_diesel_emissions.transformation: Retain generator technology, fuel, rated and actual load, operating hours, test versus outage status, pollutant, emission factor or measurement method, and facility boundary.
data_center_backup_diesel_emissions.uncertainty: Rare operation, test cycles, generator age, aftertreatment, load, and incomplete event logs affect estimated emissions.
data_center_backup_diesel_emissions.threshold_provenance: Apply facility permits, engine certification data, or a named inventory method; backup capacity alone is not an emission quantity.
data_center_backup_diesel_emissions.failure_behavior: Do not count installed generator capacity as emitted pollution, and do not mix grid-electricity emissions with onsite generation.

data_center_cooling_water_demand.unit: cubic metres withdrawn and consumed per reporting period, with litres per kilowatt-hour or WUE reported separately
data_center_cooling_water_demand.geography: named data-center campus, utility service territory, watershed, or reporting jurisdiction
data_center_cooling_water_demand.cadence: monthly with annual review and seasonal context
data_center_cooling_water_demand.transformation: Separate withdrawal from consumption; retain cooling technology, climate zone, water source, reuse, facility energy, WUE boundary, and whether water use is direct or electricity-supply related.
data_center_cooling_water_demand.uncertainty: Cooling design, weather, workload, metering boundary, blowdown, reuse, and operator disclosure coverage materially affect estimates.
data_center_cooling_water_demand.threshold_provenance: Use facility WUE and basin-specific water accounting; no universal water-stress threshold is implied.
data_center_cooling_water_demand.failure_behavior: Do not infer water use from electricity consumption alone or combine withdrawal, consumption, and indirect supply-chain water.

arctic_shipping_expansion.unit: unique ships, voyages, distance sailed, or days present by vessel class, route boundary, and reporting period
arctic_shipping_expansion.geography: Arctic Polar Code area, exclusive economic zone, or named Arctic route
arctic_shipping_expansion.transformation: Aggregate quality-controlled AIS observations within a declared Arctic boundary; retain vessel class, flag, route, coverage, and duplicated-message handling.
arctic_shipping_expansion.uncertainty: AIS carriage requirements, reception coverage, identity changes, route boundaries, and small-vessel omissions affect activity counts.
arctic_shipping_expansion.threshold_provenance: Compare like vessel classes, boundaries, and seasons against a fixed baseline; expansion is an observed activity trend rather than a universal threshold.
arctic_shipping_expansion.failure_behavior: Do not interpret missing AIS coverage as zero traffic; retain the last comparable period and mark coverage limitations.

aerosol_scattering_index.metric_name: Satellite aerosol optical depth or ultraviolet aerosol index
aerosol_scattering_index.unit: dimensionless retrieval reported with instrument, wavelength pair, algorithm version, cloud screening, and aerosol type sensitivity
aerosol_scattering_index.geography: satellite pixel, gridded region, atmospheric layer where retrieval geometry supports it, or named aggregation
aerosol_scattering_index.cadence: per overpass with monthly or seasonal aggregation
aerosol_scattering_index.transformation: Retain the native retrieval and quality flags; aggregate only comparable instruments and algorithms; do not interpret the index as aerosol mass, scattering alone, or radiative forcing without an explicit retrieval model.
aerosol_scattering_index.uncertainty: Clouds, surface reflectance, aerosol height, particle type, absorption, wavelength, and algorithm assumptions affect retrieval and interpretation.
aerosol_scattering_index.threshold_provenance: Use instrument-product quality guidance and a fixed regional baseline; no universal causal threshold is implied.
aerosol_scattering_index.failure_behavior: Preserve the prior reviewed observation and mark retrieval coverage insufficient when quality screening or comparable sampling fails.

tropospheric_warming_speeds.unit: kelvin per decade with atmospheric layer, latitude band, baseline, dataset version, and confidence interval
tropospheric_warming_speeds.geography: global or named latitude band and pressure layer
tropospheric_warming_speeds.cadence: monthly observations with annual trend review
tropospheric_warming_speeds.transformation: Use homogenized radiosonde or documented satellite layer-average records; estimate trends over a declared interval and retain structural uncertainty across observing systems.
tropospheric_warming_speeds.uncertainty: Instrument changes, orbital drift, radiosonde coverage, homogenization, layer weighting, and trend-window choice affect estimates.
tropospheric_warming_speeds.threshold_provenance: Trend significance and confidence intervals come from the named dataset and analysis window; this metric does not replace surface-temperature observations.
tropospheric_warming_speeds.failure_behavior: Do not publish a trend when temporal coverage, homogenization metadata, or cross-system comparability is insufficient.

deep_ocean_heat_sinks.metric_name: Ocean heat-content anomaly by depth range
deep_ocean_heat_sinks.unit: zettajoules or joules relative to a stated baseline, depth range, basin, and averaging interval
deep_ocean_heat_sinks.geography: global ocean or named basin and hemisphere
deep_ocean_heat_sinks.cadence: quarterly with annual and pentadal products
deep_ocean_heat_sinks.transformation: Use the NOAA climate-data-record depth layers and documented anomaly baseline; retain observational coverage and uncertainty, and do not sum overlapping depth products.
deep_ocean_heat_sinks.uncertainty: Sparse historical subsurface sampling, instrument transitions, mapping methods, and depth coverage affect the anomaly estimate.
deep_ocean_heat_sinks.threshold_provenance: Depth range, baseline, uncertainty, and aggregation follow the named climate data record rather than a universal heat-uptake threshold.
deep_ocean_heat_sinks.failure_behavior: Keep the last reviewed value and flag coverage or revision status instead of filling missing periods with zero.

sea_ice_extent_deficits.unit: square kilometers and percent anomaly using a stated concentration threshold, hemisphere, month, and baseline
sea_ice_extent_deficits.geography: Arctic, Antarctic, or named sea-ice region
sea_ice_extent_deficits.cadence: daily with monthly and seasonal review
sea_ice_extent_deficits.transformation: Apply the declared concentration threshold, normally 15 percent for Sea Ice Index products, then compare like calendar periods against a fixed climatology.
sea_ice_extent_deficits.uncertainty: Sensor changes, weather effects, coastal masks, melt ponds, concentration retrievals, and threshold choice affect extent.
sea_ice_extent_deficits.threshold_provenance: Concentration threshold and climatological baseline follow the named NSIDC product.
sea_ice_extent_deficits.failure_behavior: Do not substitute area, thickness, or age for extent; mark missing or non-comparable retrievals explicitly.

arctic_sea_ice_thinning.metric_name: Arctic sea-ice thickness or age distribution
arctic_sea_ice_thinning.unit: meters of thickness or percent area by age class, reported separately with method and season
arctic_sea_ice_thinning.geography: Arctic basin or named sea-ice region
arctic_sea_ice_thinning.transformation: Retain thickness and age as separate variables, normalize only within a documented product, and compare the same season and geographic mask.
arctic_sea_ice_thinning.uncertainty: Altimetry assumptions, snow loading, radar freeboard, motion, age classification, and seasonal coverage affect estimates.
arctic_sea_ice_thinning.threshold_provenance: Age and thickness categories follow the named NSIDC or WMO product definitions.
arctic_sea_ice_thinning.failure_behavior: Do not infer thinning from extent alone; publish no trend when method or seasonal coverage is not comparable.

ice_sheet_thinning_speeds.unit: meters per year with grounded or floating mask, sensor, correction method, and uncertainty stated
ice_sheet_thinning_speeds.geography: named Greenland or Antarctic drainage basin, ice shelf, or gridded observation domain
ice_sheet_thinning_speeds.transformation: Estimate elevation change only from comparable radar or laser altimetry products; retain firn, snowfall, bedrock, slope, and grounded-versus-floating corrections before relating change to mass.
ice_sheet_thinning_speeds.uncertainty: Surface mass balance, firn compaction, bedrock motion, steep terrain, sensor transitions, and spatial sampling affect thinning estimates.
ice_sheet_thinning_speeds.threshold_provenance: Use the named mission product and drainage-basin confidence interval; thinning rate is an observation dimension, not a separate system threshold.
ice_sheet_thinning_speeds.failure_behavior: Do not infer mass loss directly from uncorrected elevation change, and do not combine grounded ice with floating shelf observations.
