data_center_heat_rejection.unit: megawatts thermal or megawatt-hours thermal per interval with facility and cooling boundary stated
data_center_heat_rejection.geography: named data-center facility, campus, cooling plant, or district-energy interface
data_center_heat_rejection.cadence: hourly to monthly with annual review
data_center_heat_rejection.transformation: Derive rejected heat from metered IT and facility loads plus cooling-system performance; retain PUE, cooling type, ambient conditions, recoverable temperature grade, and heat-reuse boundary.
data_center_heat_rejection.uncertainty: Metering boundaries, part-load efficiency, weather, economizer operation, liquid versus air cooling, and recoverable heat temperature affect estimates.
data_center_heat_rejection.threshold_provenance: Use facility energy balance and equipment performance; electricity use alone is not a complete rejected-heat measurement.
data_center_heat_rejection.failure_behavior: Do not count nameplate IT capacity as continuous heat output or assume all rejected heat is technically or economically recoverable.

mobile_tower_backup_power.metric_name: Mobile-site backup energy capacity and runtime
mobile_tower_backup_power.unit: kilowatt-hours, kilowatts, and hours of supported load by technology and site
mobile_tower_backup_power.geography: named radio base station, telecom site portfolio, or service territory
mobile_tower_backup_power.cadence: asset inventory with event-level discharge and annual review
mobile_tower_backup_power.transformation: Retain storage or generator technology, usable capacity, site load, state of charge, grid availability, outage duration, maintenance state, and whether operation is backup or grid service.
mobile_tower_backup_power.uncertainty: Battery degradation, temperature, load variation, generator fuel availability, maintenance, and incomplete outage logs affect actual runtime.
mobile_tower_backup_power.threshold_provenance: Apply the named reliability requirement and measured site load; installed capacity alone does not prove resilience.
mobile_tower_backup_power.failure_behavior: Do not treat a battery or generator inventory as emitted pollution, delivered runtime, or reliable service without operational event data.

semiconductor_fab_water_demand.metric_name: Semiconductor-fab water withdrawal, consumption, and reuse
semiconductor_fab_water_demand.unit: cubic meters per period and liters per wafer or product unit, with ultrapure-water production reported separately
semiconductor_fab_water_demand.geography: named fabrication facility, industrial park, watershed, or reporting jurisdiction
semiconductor_fab_water_demand.transformation: Separate withdrawal, consumption, discharge, ultrapure-water production, cooling, process rinsing, and reclaimed water; retain wafer mix, production volume, facility boundary, and basin context.
semiconductor_fab_water_demand.uncertainty: Product mix, process node, yield, ultrapure-water recovery, cooling technology, reuse accounting, and corporate reporting boundaries affect intensity.
semiconductor_fab_water_demand.threshold_provenance: Use metered facility water balances and basin-specific scarcity context; no universal liters-per-chip threshold is implied.
semiconductor_fab_water_demand.failure_behavior: Do not infer water demand from fab floor area, revenue, or chip count without process, production, and facility-boundary data.

supermarket_food_waste_dump.unit: tonnes and kilograms per capita or unit of sales by retail subsector and reporting period
supermarket_food_waste_dump.geography: named retailer, retail subsector, city, or country
supermarket_food_waste_dump.transformation: Apply the Food Waste Index retail boundary; retain edible and inedible fractions where available, destination, measurement method, sales denominator, subsector coverage, and uncertainty.
supermarket_food_waste_dump.uncertainty: Inventory records, waste composition studies, informal retail, destination reporting, sales denominators, and subsector coverage affect estimates.
supermarket_food_waste_dump.threshold_provenance: Follow SDG 12.3.1(b) and the named retail measurement method; supermarket discards are one sector slice of food waste.
supermarket_food_waste_dump.failure_behavior: Do not equate unsold inventory with waste unless its destination is known, and do not extrapolate one chain to national retail without coverage weights.

deep_well_water_table_drops.unit: meters or feet of water level or hydraulic head relative to a named datum and seasonal baseline
deep_well_water_table_drops.geography: named monitoring well, confined aquifer, well network, or groundwater basin
deep_well_water_table_drops.cadence: hourly to monthly with seasonal and annual trend review
deep_well_water_table_drops.transformation: Retain well construction, screened interval, aquifer, datum, measurement status, pumping condition, and seasonal baseline; aggregate only comparable wells and head definitions.
deep_well_water_table_drops.uncertainty: Local pumping, barometric effects, well construction, datum errors, sparse networks, seasonal recharge, and provisional observations affect interpretation.
deep_well_water_table_drops.threshold_provenance: Use well- and aquifer-specific historical percentiles and trend intervals; depth alone is not a universal depletion threshold.
deep_well_water_table_drops.failure_behavior: Do not interpret a single pumped-well drawdown as basin-wide depletion or replace missing observations with stable conditions.

beekeeping_colony_loss_rates.unit: standardized occupancy, abundance, colony survival, or loss rate
beekeeping_colony_loss_rates.geography: named pollinator population, colony system, or monitored landscape
beekeeping_colony_loss_rates.transformation: Retain species or colony type, survey method, effort, season, and confirmed cause status.
beekeeping_colony_loss_rates.uncertainty: Observed decline can reflect detection, management, or migration changes.
beekeeping_colony_loss_rates.threshold_provenance: USGS, EPA, and NRCS pollinator-stressor framing.
beekeeping_colony_loss_rates.failure_behavior: Do not use the term colony collapse for every pollinator decline.

ground_level_ozone_triggers.unit: parts per billion by precursor species plus temperature, solar radiation, wind, and mixing variables
ground_level_ozone_triggers.geography: named Photochemical Assessment Monitoring Station, airshed, or model domain
ground_level_ozone_triggers.cadence: hourly with episode and seasonal summaries
ground_level_ozone_triggers.transformation: Retain individual VOC species, NOx and NOy, instrument, QA status, meteorology, monitor siting, and chemical-regime analysis; never collapse inputs into an undocumented trigger score.
ground_level_ozone_triggers.uncertainty: Nonlinear chemistry, transport, monitor siting, unmeasured radicals, emissions timing, and boundary-layer evolution limit causal interpretation.
ground_level_ozone_triggers.threshold_provenance: Use EPA PAMS and the named photochemical model or diagnostic method; there is no universal precursor trigger threshold.
ground_level_ozone_triggers.failure_behavior: Do not infer ambient ozone concentration or response to controls from precursor observations alone.

red_list_extinction_rates.unit: dimensionless index from 0 to 1 with taxonomic group, region, assessment set, confidence interval, and interval stated
red_list_extinction_rates.geography: global, country, or region using range-weighted assessed taxa
red_list_extinction_rates.transformation: Use genuine category changes rather than raw threatened-species counts; retain taxonomic coverage, range weights, Data Deficient treatment, assessment timing, and confidence intervals.
red_list_extinction_rates.uncertainty: Incomplete taxonomic coverage, reassessment timing, Data Deficient species, range weighting, and knowledge-driven category changes affect interpretation.
red_list_extinction_rates.threshold_provenance: Follow the IUCN Red List Index method; index direction reflects aggregate extinction-risk change for covered taxa.
red_list_extinction_rates.failure_behavior: Do not treat growth in the number of assessed or threatened species as an extinction-rate trend.

canopy_cover_losses.unit: hectares per year with canopy-height threshold, baseline cover threshold, resolution, and cause classification stated
canopy_cover_losses.geography: global grid, country, administrative region, concession, or mapped forest area
canopy_cover_losses.transformation: Retain baseline canopy threshold, tree height, pixel resolution, primary-forest or plantation mask, fire attribution, permanence assumptions, and algorithm version.
canopy_cover_losses.uncertainty: Cloud and smoke, plantation harvest, natural disturbance, temporary loss, canopy threshold, small clearings, and algorithm change affect estimates.
canopy_cover_losses.threshold_provenance: Use the named UMD/GLAD or official monitoring product definition; tree-cover loss is not automatically deforestation.
canopy_cover_losses.failure_behavior: Do not label all detected loss as permanent natural-forest conversion, and do not compare products with incompatible definitions without a crosswalk.

famine_relief_resource_strains.unit: US dollars required, received, and unfunded plus people planned, reached, or cut from assistance and ration percentage
famine_relief_resource_strains.geography: named humanitarian operation, appeal, country response, or global programme
famine_relief_resource_strains.cadence: monthly or appeal revision with annual synthesis
famine_relief_resource_strains.transformation: Retain appeal boundary, requirement, contributions, forecast resources, people targeted and reached, assistance modality, ration size, IPC phase, access constraints, currency year, and reporting cut-off.
famine_relief_resource_strains.uncertainty: Changing needs, donor pledges versus receipts, exchange rates, access restrictions, beneficiary deduplication, reprioritization, and appeal revisions affect the gap and reach estimates.
famine_relief_resource_strains.threshold_provenance: Use the named WFP operation, appeal, or resource forecast; famine classification remains a separate IPC evidence process.
famine_relief_resource_strains.failure_behavior: Do not infer famine from an assistance funding gap, combine unlike appeals, or treat requested funds, pledged funds, and received funds as interchangeable.

hydroelectric_reservoir_silt.unit: cubic meters of deposited sediment and usable storage lost, with bathymetric survey date, elevation-area-capacity curve, and intake elevation
hydroelectric_reservoir_silt.geography: named hydropower reservoir, contributing basin, and power intake
hydroelectric_reservoir_silt.cadence: post-event or multi-year bathymetric survey with annual sediment and operations review
hydroelectric_reservoir_silt.transformation: Retain survey method and datum, original and current capacity curves, usable and dead storage, sediment density, inflow load, trap efficiency, intake elevation, dredging or flushing, and hydropower operating boundary.
hydroelectric_reservoir_silt.uncertainty: Bathymetric coverage, datum changes, sediment density, consolidation, delta migration, unmeasured event loads, and operational sediment removal affect capacity-loss estimates.
hydroelectric_reservoir_silt.threshold_provenance: Use reservoir-specific repeat surveys and operating or intake limits; suspended sediment alone is not a storage-loss quantity.
hydroelectric_reservoir_silt.failure_behavior: Do not infer deposited volume from upstream erosion or turbidity alone, and do not treat an operating shortfall as the cause of sediment deposition.

brine_discharge_siltation.metric_name: Desalination concentrate discharge and receiving-water exposure
brine_discharge_siltation.unit: cubic meters per day plus salinity, temperature, dissolved oxygen, and chemical concentration at the outfall and reference stations
brine_discharge_siltation.geography: named desalination plant, marine outfall, mixing zone, and receiving habitat
brine_discharge_siltation.cadence: continuous plant-flow record with event, monthly, and seasonal receiving-water monitoring
brine_discharge_siltation.transformation: Retain product-water and concentrate flow, feed and effluent salinity, temperature, treatment chemicals, diffuser design, depth, currents, reference stations, dilution, seabed exposure, and permit boundary.
brine_discharge_siltation.uncertainty: Tides, currents, stratification, diffuser performance, production changes, co-discharged cooling water, sensor placement, and background salinity affect plume estimates.
brine_discharge_siltation.threshold_provenance: Use the discharge permit and site-specific ecological assessment; dense concentrate is not sediment and no universal plume threshold is implied.
brine_discharge_siltation.failure_behavior: Do not call a dense saline plume siltation, infer impact from plant capacity alone, or attribute receiving-water acidification without carbonate chemistry and source analysis.

haze_density_index.unit: deciviews, inverse megametres of light extinction, or visual range with method and humidity correction stated
haze_density_index.geography: named monitoring site, airshed, city, park, or wilderness area
haze_density_index.cadence: hourly or daily observation with seasonal and annual summaries
haze_density_index.transformation: Retain the optical method, particulate composition, relative humidity, meteorology, site elevation, visual-range convention, and missing-observation handling.
haze_density_index.uncertainty: Humidity, cloud, fog, instrument geometry, aerosol composition, and spatial representativeness alter the relationship between particle mass and visibility.
haze_density_index.threshold_provenance: Use EPA visibility-monitoring definitions and the named programme baseline; the generated density wording has no universal threshold.
haze_density_index.failure_behavior: Do not infer PM2.5 mass, pollutant source, or health burden from visibility alone.

global_dimming_factor.unit: watts per square metre per decade or percent change per decade with all-sky or clear-sky basis stated
global_dimming_factor.geography: named radiation station, gridded region, or global observing product
global_dimming_factor.cadence: daily observations aggregated to monthly, annual, and multi-decadal trends
global_dimming_factor.transformation: Retain surface irradiance variable, all-sky or clear-sky basis, cloud observations, aerosol optical properties, station continuity, calibration, and trend interval.
global_dimming_factor.uncertainty: Cloud variability, station moves, calibration drift, aerosol composition, volcanic events, and sparse historical coverage affect attribution and trend magnitude.
global_dimming_factor.threshold_provenance: Report the observed radiation trend and attribution method; no universal dimming factor is implied.
global_dimming_factor.failure_behavior: Do not attribute a radiation trend to aerosols without separating cloud and other radiative influences.

fugitive_dust_plumes.metric_name: Fugitive particulate emission and ambient increment
fugitive_dust_plumes.unit: kilograms or tonnes of PM10 and PM2.5 per activity unit plus micrograms per cubic metre at named receptors
fugitive_dust_plumes.geography: named road, field, construction site, quarry, stockpile, facility, or affected airshed
fugitive_dust_plumes.cadence: event or activity estimate with hourly ambient observations and annual inventory
fugitive_dust_plumes.transformation: Separate PM10 from PM2.5; retain activity, material silt and moisture, wind, control practice, emission factor or measurement method, background concentration, and receptor location.
fugitive_dust_plumes.uncertainty: Emission factors vary with surface condition, moisture, vehicle activity, wind, control efficiency, and the fraction reaching a receptor.
fugitive_dust_plumes.threshold_provenance: Use a named inventory method and applicable ambient-air standard; visible dust is not a quantitative concentration threshold.
fugitive_dust_plumes.failure_behavior: Do not equate a visible plume with a measured PM2.5 exposure or assign a source without dispersion and background analysis.

wildfire_smoke_columns.unit: aerosol optical depth at stated wavelength or milligrams per square metre of vertically integrated smoke
wildfire_smoke_columns.geography: named satellite pixel, forecast grid, fire plume, or affected region
wildfire_smoke_columns.cadence: sub-daily satellite or forecast cycle with event and seasonal summaries
wildfire_smoke_columns.transformation: Retain instrument or model, wavelength, retrieval quality flags, cloud mask, plume attribution, vertical distribution, observation geometry, and validation source.
wildfire_smoke_columns.uncertainty: Clouds, bright surfaces, thick-plume retrieval failure, aerosol type, vertical profile, and model injection height affect column estimates.
wildfire_smoke_columns.threshold_provenance: Use the named satellite or smoke-model product and its quality flags; column loading has no universal surface-exposure threshold.
wildfire_smoke_columns.failure_behavior: Do not infer ground-level PM2.5, personal exposure, or health effect from column loading without vertical and surface observations.

smog_density_peak.unit: parts per billion with averaging period, monitor method, quality status, and applicable standard stated
smog_density_peak.geography: named regulatory monitor, city, airshed, or gridded model domain
smog_density_peak.cadence: hourly observation with daily maximum and seasonal summaries
smog_density_peak.transformation: Retain averaging time, monitor method and siting, QA status, meteorology, precursor regime, spatial coverage, and whether the value is observed or modelled.
smog_density_peak.uncertainty: Monitor placement, vertical mixing, transport, cloud, temperature, precursor chemistry, and missing hours affect episode peaks.
smog_density_peak.threshold_provenance: Use the applicable ozone standard and averaging convention; the informal density wording does not define a concentration.
smog_density_peak.failure_behavior: Do not use a visual haze score as ozone concentration or mix particulate, ozone, and historical smoke-fog definitions of smog.

industrial_flaring_outflow.unit: million cubic metres of gas flared per year and cubic metres per unit of oil or gas production
industrial_flaring_outflow.geography: named flare site, upstream field, facility, company portfolio, or country
industrial_flaring_outflow.cadence: annual satellite estimate with site-level detections where available
industrial_flaring_outflow.transformation: Retain satellite sensor and calibration, flare location, facility class, observed radiant heat, estimated gas volume, production denominator, metadata match, and uncertainty.
industrial_flaring_outflow.uncertainty: Cloud, intermittent operation, small-flare detection limits, calibration, facility metadata, non-flare hot sources, and unlit venting affect estimates.
industrial_flaring_outflow.threshold_provenance: Use the named Global Gas Flaring Tracker method; a detected hot source is not automatically a flare volume or pollutant inventory.
industrial_flaring_outflow.failure_behavior: Do not convert flare heat directly to methane leakage, carbon dioxide, or local health exposure without combustion-efficiency and emissions data.

automotive_brake_dust_particulates.unit: milligrams per vehicle-kilometre or kilograms per reporting period, separately for PM10 and PM2.5
automotive_brake_dust_particulates.geography: named vehicle class, brake system, test cycle, fleet, road corridor, or emissions-inventory jurisdiction
automotive_brake_dust_particulates.cadence: test-cycle measurement with annual inventory aggregation
automotive_brake_dust_particulates.transformation: Retain pad and rotor composition, vehicle class, braking cycle, speed, temperature, wear mass, airborne fraction, particle-size cut, sampling method, and fleet activity.
automotive_brake_dust_particulates.uncertainty: Brake formulation, regenerative braking, driving cycle, particle resuspension, sampling losses, and fleet composition cause large variation.
automotive_brake_dust_particulates.threshold_provenance: Use a named test method or emissions-inventory factor; visible wheel dust is not an ambient concentration.
automotive_brake_dust_particulates.failure_behavior: Do not treat total wear mass as airborne PM2.5 or infer population exposure without dispersion and receptor data.

cloud_feedback_hotspots.unit: watts per square metre for shortwave, longwave, and net top-of-atmosphere flux differences with baseline stated
cloud_feedback_hotspots.geography: named satellite grid, cloud regime, latitude band, or analysis region
cloud_feedback_hotspots.cadence: monthly climate data record with seasonal and multi-year anomaly review
cloud_feedback_hotspots.transformation: Retain all-sky and clear-sky fluxes, shortwave and longwave components, cloud regime, spatial mask, baseline, instrument edition, and uncertainty.
cloud_feedback_hotspots.uncertainty: Sampling, clear-sky identification, cloud masking, retrieval assumptions, regional circulation, and short records affect anomaly and feedback inference.
cloud_feedback_hotspots.threshold_provenance: Use CERES cloud-radiative-effect definitions and an explicitly declared baseline; no universal hotspot threshold is implied.
cloud_feedback_hotspots.failure_behavior: Do not call a regional flux anomaly a feedback without relating it to temperature change and separating forcing, circulation, and cloud-regime effects.

electrical_grid_load_sinks.unit: megawatts, percentile of annual hourly demand, and share of load in a stated subregion or customer class
electrical_grid_load_sinks.geography: named balancing authority, utility, subregion, or interconnection
electrical_grid_load_sinks.cadence: hourly observation with daily, seasonal, and annual peak summaries
electrical_grid_load_sinks.transformation: Retain balancing-authority boundary, demand definition, interchange treatment, timezone, missing hours, customer or subregional share, weather, and peak-period convention.
electrical_grid_load_sinks.uncertainty: Boundary changes, embedded generation, behind-the-meter resources, demand response, interchange accounting, and missing intervals affect concentration estimates.
electrical_grid_load_sinks.threshold_provenance: Use the named balancing-authority series and declared peak or concentration statistic; no generic load-sink threshold is implied.
electrical_grid_load_sinks.failure_behavior: Do not infer grid stress from load alone without available capacity, reserves, interchange, outages, and operating conditions.

wildfire_scorched_earth.unit: hectares and percent of mapped fire perimeter by named ecological or vegetation burn-severity class
wildfire_scorched_earth.geography: named mapped fire perimeter, state, ecoregion, or MTBS reporting domain
wildfire_scorched_earth.cadence: post-fire mapping with annual trend aggregation
wildfire_scorched_earth.transformation: Retain fire perimeter, fire type, pre- and post-fire imagery, index and threshold method, vegetation class, unmapped pixels, delayed mortality assessment, and mapped-fire size threshold.
wildfire_scorched_earth.uncertainty: Cloud, smoke, imagery timing, vegetation type, classification threshold, delayed mortality, and omission of smaller fires affect area and severity estimates.
wildfire_scorched_earth.threshold_provenance: Use MTBS, RAVG, BAER, or another named field-calibrated classification; the generated scorched-earth phrase has no scientific threshold.
wildfire_scorched_earth.failure_behavior: Do not treat every burned pixel as high severity or infer long-term ecosystem conversion from an immediate burn-severity map.

subtropical_jet_drag.unit: degrees latitude, metres per second, and standardized anomaly relative to a named seasonal climatology and pressure level
subtropical_jet_drag.geography: named ocean basin, hemisphere, longitude sector, or reanalysis domain
subtropical_jet_drag.cadence: daily or monthly fields with seasonal index summaries
subtropical_jet_drag.transformation: Retain pressure level, wind component, jet-core definition, longitude sector, season, climatology, reanalysis or observation product, smoothing, and uncertainty.
subtropical_jet_drag.uncertainty: Jet identification method, reanalysis changes, seasonal migration, ENSO phase, stratospheric influence, and longitude averaging affect position and strength.
subtropical_jet_drag.threshold_provenance: Use a named circulation index or reproducible jet-core method; the informal drag wording has no physical threshold.
subtropical_jet_drag.failure_behavior: Do not infer a long-term forced shift from one season, conflate subtropical and polar jets, or treat position and strength as interchangeable.

telecom_corridor_congestion.unit: traffic intensity, utilization percent, unsuccessful-call percent, packet loss, latency, or blocked demand with protocol and interval stated
telecom_corridor_congestion.geography: named route, exchange, switching domain, backbone segment, or operator network
telecom_corridor_congestion.cadence: sub-hourly operations data with daily, monthly, and annual summaries
telecom_corridor_congestion.transformation: Retain route and capacity boundary, traffic direction, measurement interval, service and protocol, busy-hour method, failure cause, rerouting, maintenance, and missing data.
telecom_corridor_congestion.uncertainty: Private interconnection, adaptive routing, caching, measurement sampling, capacity upgrades, planned maintenance, and incomplete operator coverage affect apparent congestion.
telecom_corridor_congestion.threshold_provenance: Use the operator service-level objective or ITU traffic-engineering method; no universal corridor threshold is implied.
telecom_corridor_congestion.failure_behavior: Do not infer physical backbone scarcity from a traffic peak without available capacity, routing, service quality, and failure-cause evidence.

water_aquifer_conflict_zones.unit: aquifer area and population under an operational arrangement plus normalized withdrawal, level, quality, dependency, and cooperation indicators
water_aquifer_conflict_zones.geography: named transboundary aquifer and participating countries or subnational jurisdictions
water_aquifer_conflict_zones.cadence: annual hydrological update with multi-year governance review
water_aquifer_conflict_zones.transformation: Retain aquifer boundary, hydraulic connectivity, withdrawals, levels, quality, dependent users and ecosystems, agreement coverage, data-sharing status, institutions, and indicator definitions.
water_aquifer_conflict_zones.uncertainty: Sparse groundwater observations, uncertain boundaries and connectivity, undisclosed abstractions, political reporting differences, and informal cooperation limit comparisons.
water_aquifer_conflict_zones.threshold_provenance: Use a named UNESCO or basin-specific governance and hydrogeological assessment; no map cell is labelled conflict from scarcity alone.
water_aquifer_conflict_zones.failure_behavior: Do not infer violent conflict from shared-aquifer stress, lack of an agreement, or cross-border drawdown without event and political evidence.

atmospheric_humidity.unit: specific humidity in grams per kilogram or relative humidity in percent, with variable, height, dataset, and baseline stated
atmospheric_humidity.geography: named station, grid cell, region, or global aggregation
atmospheric_humidity.cadence: hourly observations with monthly and annual climate summaries
atmospheric_humidity.transformation: Retain the humidity variable, observing height, temperature context, instrument or reanalysis product, quality flags, spatial weighting, and climatological baseline.
atmospheric_humidity.uncertainty: Instrument changes, sparse station coverage, reanalysis assumptions, temperature dependence, and mixing specific with relative humidity can materially alter interpretation.
atmospheric_humidity.threshold_provenance: Use the named NOAA climate record or another documented humidity product and its declared baseline; no universal amplification threshold is implied.
atmospheric_humidity.failure_behavior: Do not treat relative and specific humidity as interchangeable or infer a causal moisture feedback from a single observation.

oceanic_thermal_expansion.unit: millimetres of sea-level-equivalent change with depth range, temperature and salinity product, baseline, and uncertainty stated
oceanic_thermal_expansion.geography: global ocean or named basin with complete sampling boundary
oceanic_thermal_expansion.transformation: Derive density-related height change from documented temperature and salinity profiles; retain depth coverage, mapping method, baseline, mass-versus-steric separation, and uncertainty.
oceanic_thermal_expansion.uncertainty: Uneven ocean sampling, deep-ocean coverage, salinity, mapping, and regional circulation affect steric-height estimates.
oceanic_thermal_expansion.threshold_provenance: Use a named steric-height product and comparable baseline; the contribution varies by period and region.
oceanic_thermal_expansion.failure_behavior: Do not assign all sea-level change to warming water or combine steric height with added ocean mass.

synthetic_fertilizer_n2o_outflow.unit: kilograms or tonnes of N2O-N or N2O per field, hectare, inventory sector, and reporting period, with conversion basis stated
synthetic_fertilizer_n2o_outflow.geography: named field, farm system, inventory jurisdiction, or reporting region
synthetic_fertilizer_n2o_outflow.cadence: seasonal management record with annual inventory
synthetic_fertilizer_n2o_outflow.transformation: Retain fertilizer type and amount, application timing and method, soil and weather context, direct versus indirect pathway, measurement or emission-factor tier, N2O-N conversion, and uncertainty.
synthetic_fertilizer_n2o_outflow.uncertainty: Soil moisture, temperature, nitrogen form, crop uptake, timing, indirect losses, episodic fluxes, and inventory factors create large spatial and temporal uncertainty.
synthetic_fertilizer_n2o_outflow.threshold_provenance: Apply a named chamber, model, or inventory protocol; fertilizer application alone is not an observed emission.
synthetic_fertilizer_n2o_outflow.failure_behavior: Do not convert fertilizer mass directly to N2O without a declared method, and do not mix N2O-N with N2O mass.

natural_gas_flaring_stacks.unit: million cubic metres flared and tonnes of combustion products per facility, field, jurisdiction, and period
natural_gas_flaring_stacks.geography: named oil or gas asset, producing basin, or reporting jurisdiction
natural_gas_flaring_stacks.cadence: monthly with annual satellite or operator reconciliation
natural_gas_flaring_stacks.transformation: Retain flare location, gas volume, measurement or satellite method, gas composition, combustion efficiency assumption, operating status, and reporting boundary.
natural_gas_flaring_stacks.uncertainty: Satellite detection limits, cloud cover, intermittent operation, gas composition, combustion efficiency, and operator reporting affect volume and emissions estimates.
natural_gas_flaring_stacks.threshold_provenance: Use the World Bank flare-volume method or a documented operator inventory; the presence of a stack is not an emission quantity.
natural_gas_flaring_stacks.failure_behavior: Do not infer methane destruction efficiency or pollutant output from flare detection alone.

refinery_waste_flaring.unit: standard cubic metres of gas and tonnes of combustion products per flare, refinery, and reporting period
refinery_waste_flaring.cadence: event and monthly operations data with annual inventory
refinery_waste_flaring.transformation: Separate routine, maintenance, startup, shutdown, and emergency flaring; retain gas composition, flow measurement, destruction efficiency assumption, duration, and facility boundary.
refinery_waste_flaring.uncertainty: Unmetered streams, variable gas composition, combustion efficiency, short events, and inconsistent reporting cause material uncertainty.
refinery_waste_flaring.threshold_provenance: Use facility monitoring and a declared inventory protocol; the informal waste wording does not define a chemical stream.
refinery_waste_flaring.failure_behavior: Do not equate flare duration with gas volume or treat all refinery waste as flared gas.

urban_heat_dome_stagnation.unit: degrees Celsius urban-minus-rural temperature difference with wind speed or ventilation indicator reported separately
urban_heat_dome_stagnation.geography: named urban area and explicit rural reference or intra-urban comparison
urban_heat_dome_stagnation.cadence: hourly observations with event, seasonal, and annual summaries
urban_heat_dome_stagnation.transformation: Retain surface-versus-air temperature, sensor or satellite product, local time, weather, urban form, vegetation, anthropogenic heat, reference-site definition, and ventilation metric.
urban_heat_dome_stagnation.uncertainty: Reference-site choice, land cover, sensor height, cloud, wind, season, surface emissivity, and urban geometry affect the contrast.
urban_heat_dome_stagnation.threshold_provenance: Use an EPA-aligned heat-island measurement design; dome and stagnation are not interchangeable scientific thresholds.
urban_heat_dome_stagnation.failure_behavior: Do not create a second causal node by combining heat-island intensity with stagnant weather; preserve both measurements and their distinct mechanisms.

aero_acoustic_jet_noise_plumes.unit: A-weighted decibels using a declared event or cumulative metric such as SEL, LAmax, Lden, or DNL
aero_acoustic_jet_noise_plumes.geography: named receptor, flight corridor, airport contour, or exposed population
aero_acoustic_jet_noise_plumes.cadence: per operation with daily, annual-average-day, or multi-year contour summaries
aero_acoustic_jet_noise_plumes.transformation: Retain aircraft type, operation count, flight track and altitude, day or night weighting, receptor location, acoustic model or monitor, weather, averaging period, and uncertainty.
aero_acoustic_jet_noise_plumes.uncertainty: Fleet mix, flight path, thrust, altitude, terrain, weather, building insulation, monitor placement, and modeled-versus-observed exposure affect estimates.
aero_acoustic_jet_noise_plumes.threshold_provenance: Use the named FAA or WHO exposure metric and assessment boundary; different acoustic metrics are not interchangeable.
aero_acoustic_jet_noise_plumes.failure_behavior: Do not infer exposure from passenger demand alone or convert a single-event level into a cumulative community metric.

polar_vortex_instabilities.unit: zonal-mean wind speed, geopotential height, temperature anomaly, displacement, split classification, or sudden-warming event status with pressure level stated
polar_vortex_instabilities.geography: Northern or Southern Hemisphere polar stratosphere with declared latitude and pressure domain
polar_vortex_instabilities.cadence: daily during the cold season with seasonal event synthesis
polar_vortex_instabilities.transformation: Retain hemisphere, pressure level, latitude, wind and temperature fields, reanalysis or forecast system, sudden-warming definition, event onset, displacement or split classification, and uncertainty.
polar_vortex_instabilities.uncertainty: Metric choice, pressure level, model analysis, planetary-wave activity, season, and short forecast horizon affect state classification and downstream interpretation.
polar_vortex_instabilities.threshold_provenance: Use a documented sudden-stratospheric-warming or vortex-strength definition; the informal instability wording has no universal threshold.
polar_vortex_instabilities.failure_behavior: Do not equate the stratospheric vortex with the Arctic Oscillation or infer surface weather at a location from a disruption alone.

stratospheric_aerosols.unit: dimensionless optical depth or inverse-kilometre extinction coefficient with wavelength, altitude, retrieval, and aerosol type stated
stratospheric_aerosols.geography: satellite limb profile, lidar column, latitude band, or global stratospheric aggregation
stratospheric_aerosols.cadence: per overpass or profile with monthly and event summaries
stratospheric_aerosols.transformation: Retain altitude, tropopause definition, wavelength, extinction or optical-depth variable, retrieval version, aerosol typing, cloud screening, volcanic or smoke event context, and uncertainty.
stratospheric_aerosols.uncertainty: Retrieval geometry, particle size and composition, cloud contamination, tropopause definition, sparse profiles, and separation of smoke from sulfate affect loading and forcing estimates.
stratospheric_aerosols.threshold_provenance: Use the named satellite or lidar product and event-relative climatology; loading alone does not determine radiative sign or magnitude.
stratospheric_aerosols.failure_behavior: Do not treat all aerosols as sulfate, infer surface particulate exposure, or convert optical depth directly to temperature change.

thermal_inversion_events.unit: degrees Celsius temperature increase over a stated vertical depth, with inversion-base height, top height, duration, and mixing height
thermal_inversion_events.geography: named sounding, profiler, valley, airshed, or model column
thermal_inversion_events.cadence: hourly profile or sounding with event-duration summaries
thermal_inversion_events.transformation: Retain surface-based versus elevated class, temperature profile, inversion depth and strength, wind, mixing height, terrain, cloud, snow cover, sounding or model method, and pollutant observations separately.
thermal_inversion_events.uncertainty: Sparse vertical sampling, complex terrain, profiler resolution, local drainage flow, cloud, wind, and the timing of inversion breakup affect classification and exposure interpretation.
thermal_inversion_events.threshold_provenance: Use a declared vertical-profile definition and local air-quality method; there is no universal event-strength threshold.
thermal_inversion_events.failure_behavior: Do not infer an inversion from pollutant concentration alone or treat the meteorological layer as an emitted pollutant.

edge_compute_load_pocket.unit: kilowatts or megawatts with interval energy and peak demand reported separately
edge_compute_load_pocket.geography: named edge facility, metro, feeder, or service territory
edge_compute_load_pocket.cadence: sub-hourly with monthly peak and energy summaries
edge_compute_load_pocket.transformation: Retain facility boundary, IT versus total load, peak and average demand, utilization, power-usage effectiveness, grid region, and missing intervals.
edge_compute_load_pocket.uncertainty: Operator coverage, shared facilities, workload migration, metering boundary, utilization, and cooling load limit comparability.
edge_compute_load_pocket.threshold_provenance: Use metered facility demand and the serving-grid capacity boundary; the informal pocket wording has no threshold.
edge_compute_load_pocket.failure_behavior: Do not infer congestion or emissions from installed compute capacity alone.

gpu_training_cluster.metric_name: AI training-cluster compute and energy use
gpu_training_cluster.unit: accelerator-hours, kilowatt-hours, and peak kilowatts with hardware, workload, and facility boundary stated
gpu_training_cluster.geography: named training cluster or data-center campus
gpu_training_cluster.cadence: per training run with monthly facility reconciliation
gpu_training_cluster.transformation: Retain accelerator model and count, utilization, run duration, measured facility energy where available, allocation method, cooling overhead, grid region, and uncertainty.
gpu_training_cluster.uncertainty: Undisclosed utilization, shared infrastructure, model parallelism, hardware efficiency, failed runs, and facility allocation materially affect estimates.
gpu_training_cluster.threshold_provenance: Use measured accelerator and facility records; cluster size alone is not energy use.
gpu_training_cluster.failure_behavior: Do not convert parameter count, chip count, or compute operations directly into facility electricity without a documented hardware and utilization model.

cloud_compute_grid_bottlenecks.unit: megawatts requested, available, delayed, curtailed, or awaiting upgrade with queue and network boundary stated
cloud_compute_grid_bottlenecks.geography: named interconnection point, balancing area, utility territory, or transmission region
cloud_compute_grid_bottlenecks.cadence: queue-event updates with quarterly or annual reconciliation
cloud_compute_grid_bottlenecks.transformation: Retain requested capacity, queue status, study stage, required network upgrades, expected service date, withdrawals, serving region, and whether the constraint is generation, transmission, distribution, or equipment.
cloud_compute_grid_bottlenecks.uncertainty: Speculative requests, duplicate queues, withdrawals, confidential load forecasts, upgrade timing, and changing capacity plans inflate or obscure apparent bottlenecks.
cloud_compute_grid_bottlenecks.threshold_provenance: Use the utility or system-operator queue and documented network study; a request is not connected load.
cloud_compute_grid_bottlenecks.failure_behavior: Do not count all queued megawatts as demand or attribute a delay to the grid without the stated study cause.

cloud_region_expansion.unit: facility count, commissioned megawatts, or square metres with provider and service boundary stated
cloud_region_expansion.geography: named cloud region, metro, country, or utility territory
cloud_region_expansion.transformation: Retain provider definition, facility and campus identities, commissioned versus announced status, IT and total power capacity, colocated capacity, geography, and duplicate handling.
cloud_region_expansion.uncertainty: Provider region labels, leased capacity, undisclosed facilities, announcements, phased commissioning, and shared campuses limit counts.
cloud_region_expansion.threshold_provenance: Use commissioned capacity or a documented facility inventory; an announced region is not operating capacity.
cloud_region_expansion.failure_behavior: Do not infer electricity, water, or emissions from region count alone.

dense_rack_power_demand.metric_name: Rack power density and peak demand
dense_rack_power_demand.unit: kilowatts per rack with peak, average, utilization, and measurement boundary stated
dense_rack_power_demand.geography: named rack row, data hall, or facility
dense_rack_power_demand.cadence: sub-hourly telemetry with monthly engineering summaries
dense_rack_power_demand.transformation: Retain rack population, metered IT load, peak window, utilization, hardware class, redundancy, data-hall boundary, and cooling configuration.
dense_rack_power_demand.uncertainty: Nameplate ratings, stranded capacity, bursty workloads, shared power distribution, sensor coverage, and incomplete rack population affect estimates.
dense_rack_power_demand.threshold_provenance: Use metered rack demand and the facility design limit; nameplate capacity is not observed load.
dense_rack_power_demand.failure_behavior: Do not multiply rack count by nameplate rating to claim facility demand.

cooling_tower_evaporation.unit: cubic metres consumed with withdrawal, blowdown, cycles of concentration, and heat rejection stated separately
cooling_tower_evaporation.geography: named data-center cooling plant, campus, and water source
cooling_tower_evaporation.cadence: hourly or daily metering with monthly water balance
cooling_tower_evaporation.transformation: Separate makeup, evaporation, blowdown, drift, reuse, and discharge; retain weather, cooling load, water source, meter coverage, and facility boundary.
cooling_tower_evaporation.uncertainty: Unmetered makeup, blowdown estimates, drift, changing cycles of concentration, weather, reuse, and shared plants affect the water balance.
cooling_tower_evaporation.threshold_provenance: Use a metered plant water balance; withdrawal is not equivalent to consumption.
cooling_tower_evaporation.failure_behavior: Do not infer evaporation from electricity use or cooling-tower presence alone.

liquid_cooling_loop_demand.metric_name: Liquid-cooling loop thermal and pumping load
liquid_cooling_loop_demand.unit: kilowatts of heat removed, litres per minute, pressure differential, and pumping kilowatt-hours reported separately
liquid_cooling_loop_demand.geography: named rack, data hall, loop, or facility
liquid_cooling_loop_demand.cadence: sub-minute controls data with monthly energy reconciliation
liquid_cooling_loop_demand.transformation: Retain loop boundary, coolant, flow, supply and return temperature, pressure, pump energy, rejected heat, workload, and whether water is recirculated or consumed.
liquid_cooling_loop_demand.uncertainty: Sensor calibration, shared loops, variable flow, heat recovery, secondary circuits, and incomplete pump metering affect estimates.
liquid_cooling_loop_demand.threshold_provenance: Use measured loop heat balance and design limits; coolant flow is not water consumption.
liquid_cooling_loop_demand.failure_behavior: Do not equate circulating volume with withdrawal or infer total facility cooling energy from one loop.

server_hall_airflow_loss.unit: cubic metres per second, pressure, fan kilowatt-hours, and temperature-rise metrics with containment boundary stated
server_hall_airflow_loss.geography: named data hall, aisle, rack row, or cooling zone
server_hall_airflow_loss.cadence: sub-minute building telemetry with monthly commissioning review
server_hall_airflow_loss.transformation: Retain delivered and bypass airflow, fan power, supply and return temperatures, containment state, rack load, sensor layout, control set points, and facility boundary.
server_hall_airflow_loss.uncertainty: Sensor placement, recirculation, leakage, transient workload, control changes, and incomplete zone coverage affect inferred efficiency.
server_hall_airflow_loss.threshold_provenance: Use a documented commissioning or facility-control method; the informal loss wording has no universal threshold.
server_hall_airflow_loss.failure_behavior: Do not infer thermal failure or wasted energy from airflow volume without heat load and pressure context.

ups_battery_hall.metric_name: Data-center UPS storage capacity and conversion losses
ups_battery_hall.unit: megawatts, megawatt-hours, efficiency percent, and outage runtime with topology stated
ups_battery_hall.geography: named UPS plant, data hall, or facility
ups_battery_hall.cadence: continuous status with monthly test and annual capacity review
ups_battery_hall.transformation: Retain topology, rated and usable capacity, state of charge or health, conversion efficiency, redundancy, test conditions, facility load, chemistry, and replacement status.
ups_battery_hall.uncertainty: Nameplate versus usable capacity, degradation, redundancy, partial loading, temperature, test frequency, and undisclosed topology affect runtime and loss estimates.
ups_battery_hall.threshold_provenance: Use manufacturer and facility test criteria; room presence is not reliability or stored energy.
ups_battery_hall.failure_behavior: Do not infer outage resilience from installed battery count or nameplate capacity alone.

substation_upgrade_delay.unit: months between planned and actual milestone with capacity, scope, cause, and project status stated
substation_upgrade_delay.geography: named substation, utility project, or transmission region
substation_upgrade_delay.cadence: project milestone with quarterly portfolio summaries
substation_upgrade_delay.transformation: Retain baseline schedule, current milestone, capacity increment, permitting, procurement, construction, outage coordination, cost, cause code, and cancellation or completion status.
substation_upgrade_delay.uncertainty: Rebaselining, scope changes, confidential procurement, dependencies, canceled projects, and inconsistent cause codes affect portfolio comparisons.
substation_upgrade_delay.threshold_provenance: Use the approved baseline and documented milestone change; a long lead time is not necessarily a delay.
substation_upgrade_delay.failure_behavior: Do not infer the cause or count canceled capacity as delayed without project-status evidence.

transmission_congestion_hotspots.unit: hours constrained, megawatt-hours curtailed, price separation, or congestion cost with market and constraint stated
transmission_congestion_hotspots.geography: named transmission constraint, interface, balancing area, or market region
transmission_congestion_hotspots.cadence: five-minute or hourly market operations with monthly and annual summaries
transmission_congestion_hotspots.transformation: Retain constraint identity, direction, binding interval, available and scheduled flow, outage state, price or curtailment method, market boundary, and topology changes.
transmission_congestion_hotspots.uncertainty: Market rules, redispatch, outages, topology, generation offers, load, counter-trading, and constraint renaming affect apparent congestion.
transmission_congestion_hotspots.threshold_provenance: Use the system operator constraint and market method; geographic concentration alone is not congestion.
transmission_congestion_hotspots.failure_behavior: Do not infer physical scarcity from price separation without constraint, outage, and market context.

land_ocean_warming_contrast.unit: degrees Celsius with land mask, ocean mask, dataset, spatial weighting, and baseline stated
land_ocean_warming_contrast.geography: global or named latitude band with explicit land and ocean domains
land_ocean_warming_contrast.cadence: monthly with annual and multi-decadal trend summaries
land_ocean_warming_contrast.transformation: Compute like-for-like surface-temperature anomalies using a fixed baseline, masks, area weighting, coverage handling, and dataset version; retain each component separately.
land_ocean_warming_contrast.uncertainty: Coverage, sea-surface versus near-surface air temperature, masks, Arctic interpolation, baseline, and short-term variability affect the contrast.
land_ocean_warming_contrast.threshold_provenance: Use a named temperature analysis and fixed baseline; the contrast is descriptive and has no universal causal threshold.
land_ocean_warming_contrast.failure_behavior: Do not substitute the contrast for global mean temperature or infer local impacts from the global difference.

atlantic_salinity_contrast_shift.unit: practical salinity units or grams per kilogram with locations, depths, climatology, and gradient definition stated
atlantic_salinity_contrast_shift.geography: named Atlantic sections, water masses, basins, or latitude-depth domains
atlantic_salinity_contrast_shift.cadence: profile or cruise observations with monthly to decadal synthesis
atlantic_salinity_contrast_shift.transformation: Retain temperature, pressure or depth, instrument, quality flags, section endpoints, water-mass definition, objective mapping, and climatological baseline.
atlantic_salinity_contrast_shift.uncertainty: Sparse sampling, moving fronts, mesoscale eddies, water-mass shifts, calibration, and endpoint selection affect the contrast.
atlantic_salinity_contrast_shift.threshold_provenance: Use NOAA World Ocean Database or a named section climatology; no universal contrast threshold is implied.
atlantic_salinity_contrast_shift.failure_behavior: Do not infer overturning strength or freshwater cause from a salinity contrast alone.

benthic_layer_warming.unit: degrees Celsius with depth, distance above seabed, instrument, dataset, and baseline stated
benthic_layer_warming.geography: named station, transect, shelf, basin, or bottom-water mass
benthic_layer_warming.cadence: profile or mooring observations with seasonal to decadal synthesis
benthic_layer_warming.transformation: Retain seabed depth, sensor height, temperature scale, salinity, water mass, instrument, calibration, sampling coverage, and baseline; distinguish local temperature from vertically integrated heat content.
benthic_layer_warming.uncertainty: Sparse deep observations, boundary currents, tides, sensor placement, water-mass movement, and interpolation affect trends.
benthic_layer_warming.threshold_provenance: Use a named bottom-temperature record or depth-resolved climatology; no global benthic threshold is implied.
benthic_layer_warming.failure_behavior: Do not infer seafloor heat flux, ecosystem impact, or basin heat content from one bottom-temperature series.

boreal_peat_defrosting.unit: active-layer thickness, ground temperature, thawed area, subsidence, or carbon-stock change with method stated
boreal_peat_defrosting.geography: named boreal peatland, permafrost plateau, bog, or monitoring network
boreal_peat_defrosting.cadence: seasonal ground observations with annual to multi-year synthesis
boreal_peat_defrosting.transformation: Retain ground temperature, active-layer method, peat depth, ice content, hydrology, landform transition, mapped area, carbon method, and baseline.
boreal_peat_defrosting.uncertainty: Peat and ice heterogeneity, hydrologic change, fire, subsidence, vegetation succession, sparse sites, and chronosequence assumptions affect interpretation.
boreal_peat_defrosting.threshold_provenance: Use a named permafrost or peatland protocol; thaw, carbon loss, and post-thaw recovery are separate quantities.
boreal_peat_defrosting.failure_behavior: Do not infer atmospheric emissions from thawed area or peat temperature without carbon-flux evidence.

frost_heave_soil_anomalies.unit: millimetres or centimetres of vertical displacement with freezing depth, soil moisture, and observation method stated
frost_heave_soil_anomalies.geography: named soil plot, road segment, foundation, or frozen-ground monitoring site
frost_heave_soil_anomalies.transformation: Retain displacement, freezing depth, soil texture, water supply, segregated-ice evidence, temperature, load, drainage, instrument, and whether ground is seasonal or permafrost.
frost_heave_soil_anomalies.uncertainty: Soil heterogeneity, water migration, drainage, load, snow insulation, sensor stability, and seasonal refreezing affect displacement.
frost_heave_soil_anomalies.threshold_provenance: Use a site-specific geotechnical or frozen-ground method; anomaly requires a declared baseline.
frost_heave_soil_anomalies.failure_behavior: Do not treat frost heave as proof of permafrost thaw or infer infrastructure damage from displacement alone.

high_latitude_runoff_influx.unit: cubic kilometres per period or cubic metres per second with gauge network and baseline stated
high_latitude_runoff_influx.geography: named Arctic river, gauged watershed, or declared pan-Arctic aggregation
high_latitude_runoff_influx.cadence: daily gauge data with monthly, seasonal, and annual summaries
high_latitude_runoff_influx.transformation: Retain gauge and basin identities, coverage period, discharge method, ice effects, missing data, regulated flow, aggregation, freshet timing, and baseline.
high_latitude_runoff_influx.uncertainty: Gauge coverage, ice conditions, rating curves, reservoir operations, missing months, ungauged basins, and differing baselines affect totals.
high_latitude_runoff_influx.threshold_provenance: Use the named NOAA Arctic Report Card river set and reference period; high influx has no universal threshold.
high_latitude_runoff_influx.failure_behavior: Do not infer Arctic Ocean salinity, circulation, or cause from discharge alone.

oceanic_carbon_sink_saturation.unit: petagrams of carbon stored or air-sea carbon flux per atmospheric CO2 increment, with inventory period and method stated
oceanic_carbon_sink_saturation.geography: global ocean or named basin with repeat hydrography or flux-product coverage
oceanic_carbon_sink_saturation.cadence: annual flux estimates with decadal inventory comparison
oceanic_carbon_sink_saturation.transformation: Retain dissolved inorganic carbon observations, anthropogenic-carbon method, air-sea flux product, atmospheric forcing, circulation context, uncertainty, and comparison period.
oceanic_carbon_sink_saturation.uncertainty: Sparse repeat sections, natural variability, circulation, buffer chemistry, biological processes, gas exchange, and mapping affect sensitivity estimates.
oceanic_carbon_sink_saturation.threshold_provenance: Use a named repeat-hydrography or air-sea flux analysis; saturation is not a binary state.
oceanic_carbon_sink_saturation.failure_behavior: Do not infer zero uptake, permanence, or a future trend from one decade or basin.

permafrost_carbon_leaching.unit: milligrams carbon per litre, grams carbon per square metre, or mass flux per watershed and period with fraction stated
permafrost_carbon_leaching.geography: named permafrost soil profile, thaw feature, stream, lake, or watershed
permafrost_carbon_leaching.cadence: event and seasonal sampling with annual synthesis
permafrost_carbon_leaching.transformation: Retain active-layer depth, soil horizon and age, dissolved fraction, concentration, discharge, flux method, biodegradability protocol, season, hydrologic connectivity, and uncertainty.
permafrost_carbon_leaching.uncertainty: Source age, hydrologic routing, residence time, microbial processing, discharge, filtration, season, and sparse sampling affect concentration and flux.
permafrost_carbon_leaching.threshold_provenance: Use a named DOC method and paired hydrology; concentration alone is not export.
permafrost_carbon_leaching.failure_behavior: Do not infer atmospheric release from mobilized dissolved carbon without downstream fate and gas-flux evidence.

pingo_explosions.unit: feature count, diameter, height, surface displacement, collapse area, or documented rupture status
pingo_explosions.geography: named pingo or mapped permafrost landscape
pingo_explosions.cadence: event observations with annual or multi-year repeat mapping
pingo_explosions.transformation: Retain feature identity, closed- or open-system class, morphology, ground-ice and water evidence, pressure evidence, imagery dates, field confirmation, and event classification.
pingo_explosions.uncertainty: Sparse field confirmation, image resolution, seasonal snow, feature misclassification, unknown subsurface pressure, and erosion affect event interpretation.
pingo_explosions.threshold_provenance: Use field-confirmed morphology and a documented rupture or collapse definition; the generated explosion wording is not assumed.
pingo_explosions.failure_behavior: Do not label a crater, collapsed mound, or remote-sensing change as an explosion without event and pressure evidence.

salinity_declines.unit: practical salinity units or grams per kilogram with depth, dataset, and climatological baseline stated
salinity_declines.geography: named station, grid, section, basin, or water mass
salinity_declines.cadence: profile or satellite observation with monthly to decadal synthesis
salinity_declines.transformation: Retain depth, temperature, instrument, quality flags, mapping, sampling coverage, freshwater terms, water-mass context, and fixed baseline.
salinity_declines.uncertainty: Sampling coverage, satellite surface-only retrieval, precipitation, evaporation, runoff, ice, advection, mixing, and water-mass movement affect anomalies.
salinity_declines.threshold_provenance: Use a named NOAA salinity product and fixed baseline; decline is region-, depth-, and period-specific.
salinity_declines.failure_behavior: Do not generalize one regional anomaly to the global ocean or attribute it to a single freshwater source.

subsea_permafrost_decay.metric_name: Subsea permafrost thermal and thaw state
subsea_permafrost_decay.unit: ground temperature, frozen-layer thickness, talik thickness, thaw depth, or mapped area with depth and method stated
subsea_permafrost_decay.geography: named Arctic shelf borehole, transect, or geophysical survey area
subsea_permafrost_decay.cadence: campaign or borehole observations with multi-year synthesis
subsea_permafrost_decay.transformation: Retain seabed depth, sediment profile, temperature, salinity, ground-ice evidence, borehole or geophysical method, talik definition, gas observations separately, survey coverage, and uncertainty.
subsea_permafrost_decay.uncertainty: Sparse boreholes, saline freezing point, sediment properties, inherited thermal history, geophysical inversion, and separation of geological gas sources limit estimates.
subsea_permafrost_decay.threshold_provenance: Use a named borehole or geophysical thaw-state definition; decay is not a standardized binary threshold.
subsea_permafrost_decay.failure_behavior: Do not infer methane release or climate forcing from mapped subsea permafrost condition alone.

confined_pig_farm_effluent.unit: cubic metres discharged and kilograms of nitrogen, phosphorus, organic matter, sediment, pathogen indicator, or named contaminant per period
confined_pig_farm_effluent.geography: named animal feeding operation, outfall, field application area, or receiving watershed
confined_pig_farm_effluent.cadence: event and permit monitoring with monthly or annual load summaries
confined_pig_farm_effluent.transformation: Retain facility and animal class, wastewater volume, analyte, concentration, load, discharge or land-application pathway, storm context, permit status, method, and uncertainty.
confined_pig_farm_effluent.uncertainty: Intermittent releases, stormwater, storage, land application, sampling, animal population, and unmonitored pathways affect loads.
confined_pig_farm_effluent.threshold_provenance: Use the applicable permit, nutrient plan, or water-quality method; confinement alone is not a discharge.
confined_pig_farm_effluent.failure_behavior: Do not infer receiving-water impact from facility size or manure generation without pathway and load evidence.

drip_irrigation_siltation.unit: emitter flow reduction percent, clog count, suspended solids, turbidity, or maintenance interval with system boundary stated
drip_irrigation_siltation.geography: named irrigation block, filtration train, or farm
drip_irrigation_siltation.cadence: irrigation-event monitoring with seasonal maintenance summary
drip_irrigation_siltation.transformation: Retain source-water sediment, filtration, emitter geometry, pressure, flow uniformity, flushing, chemical treatment, irrigated area, and maintenance state.
drip_irrigation_siltation.uncertainty: Emitter design, biological and chemical fouling, pressure variation, sampling location, filtration, and maintenance confound sediment attribution.
drip_irrigation_siltation.threshold_provenance: Use the manufacturer or irrigation-performance method; siltation is not inferred from water source alone.
drip_irrigation_siltation.failure_behavior: Do not equate sediment presence with system inefficiency without measured flow or clogging.

flood_irrigation_evaporation.unit: cubic metres or millimetres of water per irrigated area and event with water-balance method stated
flood_irrigation_evaporation.geography: named field, irrigation district, or scheme
flood_irrigation_evaporation.transformation: Separate delivery, application, runoff, deep percolation, soil storage, crop evapotranspiration, and non-beneficial evaporation; retain weather, crop, soil, method, and uncertainty.
flood_irrigation_evaporation.uncertainty: Field inflow, soil storage, return flow, weather, crop use, seepage, deep percolation, and water-balance closure affect estimates.
flood_irrigation_evaporation.threshold_provenance: Use a declared field water balance; application efficiency and basin water consumption are different quantities.
flood_irrigation_evaporation.failure_behavior: Do not label all applied water not measured at the field outlet as evaporation.

industrial_feedlot_feed_conveyors.unit: tonnes of feed delivered per animal-place or production period with facility boundary stated
industrial_feedlot_feed_conveyors.geography: named animal feeding operation or production system
industrial_feedlot_feed_conveyors.cadence: daily operations data with monthly and annual summaries
industrial_feedlot_feed_conveyors.transformation: Retain animal class, head count, feed composition, dry matter, throughput, losses, energy use where measured, production output, and facility boundary.
industrial_feedlot_feed_conveyors.uncertainty: Feed moisture, inventory, waste, shared equipment, ration changes, animal turnover, and incomplete facility records affect throughput.
industrial_feedlot_feed_conveyors.threshold_provenance: Use measured feed records and animal-place definitions; equipment presence is not production intensity.
industrial_feedlot_feed_conveyors.failure_behavior: Do not infer emissions, welfare, or environmental release from conveyor capacity alone.

agricultural_silt_runoff_plumes.unit: milligrams per litre, tonnes per event, or tonnes per hectare with particle fraction and method stated
agricultural_silt_runoff_plumes.geography: named field, drainage outlet, stream reach, or watershed
agricultural_silt_runoff_plumes.cadence: storm-event sampling with seasonal and annual load summaries
agricultural_silt_runoff_plumes.transformation: Retain rainfall or irrigation, runoff volume, suspended and bed material, soil source evidence, land management, slope, conservation practices, sampling coverage, and load method.
agricultural_silt_runoff_plumes.uncertainty: Event timing, rating curves, channel erosion, bank sources, deposition, sampling gaps, and particle-size methods affect source attribution and load.
agricultural_silt_runoff_plumes.threshold_provenance: Use a field or watershed sediment method; turbidity alone is not agricultural soil loss.
agricultural_silt_runoff_plumes.failure_behavior: Do not attribute a downstream plume to cropland without source and transport evidence.

dairy_herd_methane_belches.unit: kilograms of methane per animal, herd, or unit of milk per reporting period with inventory tier stated
dairy_herd_methane_belches.geography: named herd, production system, inventory jurisdiction, or reporting region
dairy_herd_methane_belches.transformation: Retain animal class and count, intake, diet, milk output, measurement or inventory tier, emission factor, manure emissions separately, allocation, and uncertainty.
dairy_herd_methane_belches.uncertainty: Diet, intake, productivity, breed, animal state, measurement method, herd structure, and inventory factors affect estimates.
dairy_herd_methane_belches.threshold_provenance: Use a named chamber, tracer, model, or inventory tier; animal count alone is not observed methane.
dairy_herd_methane_belches.failure_behavior: Do not combine enteric and manure methane or apply a generic factor without animal and diet context.

soil_organic_matter_depletion.unit: tonnes of organic matter or carbon per hectare for a stated depth, equivalent-soil-mass basis, and interval
soil_organic_matter_depletion.geography: named field, soil map unit, land-use stratum, or reporting jurisdiction
soil_organic_matter_depletion.cadence: baseline and repeat sampling, normally multi-year
soil_organic_matter_depletion.transformation: Retain depth, bulk density, equivalent soil mass, rock fragments, laboratory method, carbon-to-organic-matter conversion, land use, management, erosion or deposition, and uncertainty.
soil_organic_matter_depletion.uncertainty: Spatial heterogeneity, bulk density, sampling depth, laboratory method, conversion factors, and short intervals affect stock-change estimates.
soil_organic_matter_depletion.threshold_provenance: Use a named soil monitoring protocol and confidence interval; concentration change is not necessarily stock change.
soil_organic_matter_depletion.failure_behavior: Do not infer depletion from management practice or one concentration sample.

tractor_compacted_subsoils.unit: bulk density, penetration resistance, porosity, or load history with depth, soil water, and method stated
tractor_compacted_subsoils.geography: named agricultural field, management zone, or soil map unit
tractor_compacted_subsoils.cadence: pre- and post-operation or seasonal soil assessment
tractor_compacted_subsoils.transformation: Retain depth, soil texture, water content, bulk density or resistance method, axle load, tire pressure, traffic pattern, crop, tillage, baseline, and uncertainty.
tractor_compacted_subsoils.uncertainty: Soil water, texture, stones, root channels, sampling depth, instrument, prior traffic, and natural density variation affect measurements.
tractor_compacted_subsoils.threshold_provenance: Use soil- and crop-specific physical thresholds; tractor presence is not compaction.
tractor_compacted_subsoils.failure_behavior: Do not infer root restriction or yield loss from machinery activity without measured soil condition.

dryland_salinization_cracks.metric_name: Dryland soil salinity and surface condition
dryland_salinization_cracks.unit: electrical conductivity, exchangeable sodium percentage, salt mass, or mapped affected area with sampling depth stated
dryland_salinization_cracks.geography: named dryland field, soil unit, irrigation district, or mapped assessment area
dryland_salinization_cracks.transformation: Retain soil depth, paste or extract method, conductivity, sodium metric, moisture, groundwater, irrigation and drainage, land cover, crack mapping separately, and baseline.
dryland_salinization_cracks.uncertainty: Soil moisture, sampling depth, texture, salt composition, seasonal wetting, groundwater, remote-sensing calibration, and spatial heterogeneity affect estimates.
dryland_salinization_cracks.threshold_provenance: Use the FAO or local soil-salinity class and method; visible cracks are not a salinity measurement.
dryland_salinization_cracks.failure_behavior: Do not infer salinity from cracking or aridity without soil chemistry.

hillside_cropland_terracing_failure.unit: breach count, affected length, elevation loss, runoff volume, or sediment load with design and event stated
hillside_cropland_terracing_failure.geography: named terraced field, hillslope, or drainage unit
hillside_cropland_terracing_failure.cadence: storm-event inspection with seasonal and annual condition review
hillside_cropland_terracing_failure.transformation: Retain terrace type and design, slope, breach or overtopping evidence, rainfall, maintenance, runoff, erosion and sediment observations, imagery, and uncertainty.
hillside_cropland_terracing_failure.uncertainty: Incomplete inspections, pre-existing erosion, extreme rainfall, design differences, maintenance, and downstream channel sources affect failure and sediment attribution.
hillside_cropland_terracing_failure.threshold_provenance: Use the conservation-practice design and documented breach or loss-of-function criteria.
hillside_cropland_terracing_failure.failure_behavior: Do not infer failure from hillside erosion or sediment downstream without terrace-condition evidence.

vegetational_windbreak_removals.unit: metres or hectares removed with porosity, height, orientation, field boundary, and date stated
vegetational_windbreak_removals.geography: named farm, field boundary, shelterbelt, or agricultural landscape
vegetational_windbreak_removals.transformation: Retain mapped line or area, vegetation type, height and porosity where available, removal versus mortality, field orientation, wind and soil context, imagery dates, and uncertainty.
vegetational_windbreak_removals.uncertainty: Image resolution, seasonal foliage, pruning, mortality, replanting, wind direction, soil cover, and incomplete historical mapping affect interpretation.
vegetational_windbreak_removals.threshold_provenance: Use mapped repeat observations and an NRCS-aligned windbreak boundary; loss does not itself quantify erosion.
vegetational_windbreak_removals.failure_behavior: Do not infer soil loss or evapotranspiration change from removal area without field observations.

cane_field_burning_smoke.unit: grams PM2.5 per kilogram dry biomass, tonnes per event, or micrograms per cubic metre at receptors with method stated
cane_field_burning_smoke.geography: named burn, field, airshed, monitor, or exposed community
cane_field_burning_smoke.cadence: burn event with seasonal emissions and exposure summaries
cane_field_burning_smoke.transformation: Retain burned area and biomass, fuel moisture, combustion completeness, emission factor or measurement, plume transport, monitor, background, meteorology, receptor population, and uncertainty.
cane_field_burning_smoke.uncertainty: Fuel load and moisture, combustion phase, emission factor, plume rise, wind, atmospheric mixing, background smoke, and monitor coverage affect estimates.
cane_field_burning_smoke.threshold_provenance: Use a named agricultural-burning emission method and applicable PM air-quality standard; smoke visibility is not PM2.5.
cane_field_burning_smoke.failure_behavior: Do not infer receptor exposure from burned area or satellite fire detection alone.

rock_phosphate_reserves_runout.unit: million tonnes with ore grade, reserve or resource classification, country, and reporting year stated
rock_phosphate_reserves_runout.geography: named mine, country, or global commodity balance
rock_phosphate_reserves_runout.transformation: Retain reserve versus resource class, ore grade, recovery, production, trade, price, data revision, country reporting basis, and uncertainty; calculate static life only as production-conditioned context.
rock_phosphate_reserves_runout.uncertainty: Exploration, prices, technology, reserve reclassification, reporting quality, recovery, substitution, recycling, and future demand make exhaustion dates unstable.
rock_phosphate_reserves_runout.threshold_provenance: Use USGS reserve and resource definitions; runout is not a defensible fixed date.
rock_phosphate_reserves_runout.failure_behavior: Do not divide current reserves by one year of production and present the result as a forecast of physical exhaustion.

horticulture_peat_extraction.unit: cubic metres or tonnes extracted and hectares disturbed with peat depth and reporting boundary stated
horticulture_peat_extraction.geography: named peat extraction site, country, or commodity reporting jurisdiction
horticulture_peat_extraction.transformation: Retain extraction volume and mass, moisture basis, affected area, peat depth, drainage, post-extraction condition, restoration, product use, reporting coverage, and uncertainty.
horticulture_peat_extraction.uncertainty: Moisture content, informal extraction, stockpiles, site boundaries, peat depth, drainage extent, restoration status, and trade affect estimates.
horticulture_peat_extraction.threshold_provenance: Use a named peatland inventory and commodity method; extraction volume does not directly equal carbon emissions.
horticulture_peat_extraction.failure_behavior: Do not infer total peatland degradation or greenhouse-gas release from product volume alone.

soy_plantation_encroachments.unit: hectares of newly established soy overlapping a declared forest-loss or conversion baseline
soy_plantation_encroachments.geography: named property, municipality, biome, country, or supply-shed assessment
soy_plantation_encroachments.transformation: Retain soy map, forest definition, baseline, conversion date, plantation and natural-forest distinction, spatial resolution, direct versus indirect attribution, property or supply boundary, and uncertainty.
soy_plantation_encroachments.uncertainty: Crop-map errors, rotation, prior clearing, indirect displacement, plantation forests, cloud cover, baseline choice, and supply-chain traceability affect attribution.
soy_plantation_encroachments.threshold_provenance: Use spatial overlap with an explicit conversion cutoff and forest definition; expansion alone is not deforestation.
soy_plantation_encroachments.failure_behavior: Do not attribute forest loss to soy without temporal and spatial overlap or treat all tree-cover loss as natural-forest conversion.

coal_fly_ash_lagoons.unit: tonnes or cubic metres of residuals, hectares, liquid elevation, storage capacity, and named contaminant concentration reported separately
coal_fly_ash_lagoons.geography: named coal-combustion residual unit and its groundwater or surface-water monitoring network
coal_fly_ash_lagoons.cadence: inspection event with quarterly or annual monitoring summaries
coal_fly_ash_lagoons.transformation: Retain unit type, active or legacy status, residual class, geometry, water level, liner, structural condition, sample medium, analyte, detection limit, and permit context.
coal_fly_ash_lagoons.uncertainty: Historical deposits, unit boundaries, groundwater direction, background chemistry, moisture, density, and incomplete legacy records affect estimates.
coal_fly_ash_lagoons.threshold_provenance: Use the applicable CCR rule, permit, engineering inspection, and groundwater method.
coal_fly_ash_lagoons.failure_behavior: Do not infer a release from stored volume alone or call every ash or runoff pond a regulated CCR surface impoundment.

biomass_incinerator_fallout.unit: kilograms of named pollutant per megajoule, tonne of dry fuel, or reporting period with stack and ambient measurements separated
biomass_incinerator_fallout.geography: named boiler, incinerator, facility, airshed, or receptor network
biomass_incinerator_fallout.cadence: continuous or test-run stack monitoring with annual inventory summaries
biomass_incinerator_fallout.transformation: Retain fuel type, moisture and heating value, boiler design, load, control device, stack method, pollutant size fraction, test condition, and uncertainty.
biomass_incinerator_fallout.uncertainty: Fuel moisture and composition, combustion conditions, controls, load, ash reinjection, and emission-factor representativeness affect estimates.
biomass_incinerator_fallout.threshold_provenance: Use source tests or the declared AP-42 factor and rating; fuel mass alone is not an ambient concentration.
biomass_incinerator_fallout.failure_behavior: Do not label all biomass combustion as fallout or infer receptor exposure without plume and monitoring evidence.

fossil_gas_compressor_output.unit: kilograms of methane per hour and tonnes CO2-equivalent per reporting period with vented, fugitive, and exhaust sources separated
fossil_gas_compressor_output.geography: named compressor, station, pipeline segment, storage field, or reporting basin
fossil_gas_compressor_output.cadence: survey event or continuous monitoring with annual inventory summaries
fossil_gas_compressor_output.transformation: Retain compressor type, seal, operating mode, component, detection and quantification method, gas composition, repair status, duration, and uncertainty.
fossil_gas_compressor_output.uncertainty: Intermittency, inaccessible components, detection limits, gas composition, operating state, and super-emitter duration affect totals.
fossil_gas_compressor_output.threshold_provenance: Use measured component or exhaust rates and documented operating time; installed horsepower is not an emission.
fossil_gas_compressor_output.failure_behavior: Do not combine combustion exhaust, intentional vents, and equipment leaks or infer annual emissions from one screening observation.

gas_pipeline_leak_points.unit: leak count by grade and kilograms of methane per hour where quantified
gas_pipeline_leak_points.geography: named pipeline segment, distribution system, facility, survey corridor, or reporting jurisdiction
gas_pipeline_leak_points.cadence: survey event with repair and annual inventory follow-up
gas_pipeline_leak_points.transformation: Retain asset class, leak grade, detection method, localization, methane rate, gas composition, repair and verification status, survey coverage, and uncertainty.
