gas_pipeline_leak_points.uncertainty: Detection threshold, access, wind, intermittency, asset records, survey coverage, and unquantified leaks affect counts and emissions.
gas_pipeline_leak_points.threshold_provenance: Use the operator or regulator leak-grading and quantification method.
gas_pipeline_leak_points.failure_behavior: Do not equate a detected point with an annual emission total or treat every methane enhancement as a pipeline leak.

glass_furnace_combustion_sinks.unit: tonnes of each gas and kilograms CO2-equivalent per tonne of glass with process and combustion emissions separated
glass_furnace_combustion_sinks.geography: named continuous glass-melting furnace, facility, product class, or reporting jurisdiction
glass_furnace_combustion_sinks.cadence: continuous operations with annual regulatory reporting
glass_furnace_combustion_sinks.transformation: Retain glass type, furnace, raw carbonates, fuel, cullet share, production, process CO2, combustion CO2, CH4, N2O, method, GWP basis, and uncertainty.
glass_furnace_combustion_sinks.uncertainty: Raw-material carbonate content, cullet share, fuel and heat input, production allocation, missing data, and GWP basis affect results.
glass_furnace_combustion_sinks.threshold_provenance: Use the GHGRP applicability and calculation provisions for the named source category.
glass_furnace_combustion_sinks.failure_behavior: Do not call emissions a sink or combine process decomposition with fuel combustion.

paper_mill_effluent_streams.unit: cubic metres and kilograms of named pollutant per day or tonne of product
paper_mill_effluent_streams.geography: named mill, outfall, receiving water, treatment works, or permit jurisdiction
paper_mill_effluent_streams.cadence: permit sample or continuous flow with monthly and annual load summaries
paper_mill_effluent_streams.transformation: Retain mill subcategory, process, direct or indirect discharge, flow, analyte, concentration, load, treatment, outfall, method, permit limit, and uncertainty.
paper_mill_effluent_streams.uncertainty: Production mix, batch releases, treatment performance, flow estimation, detection limits, and unmonitored pollutants affect loads.
paper_mill_effluent_streams.threshold_provenance: Use the applicable 40 CFR Part 430 subcategory and permit.
paper_mill_effluent_streams.failure_behavior: Do not infer receiving-water impairment from mill production or one concentration without flow, pathway, background, and exposure context.

textile_factory_toxic_dyes.unit: cubic metres and kilograms of named pollutant per day or per thousand kilograms of product
textile_factory_toxic_dyes.geography: named textile mill, process line, outfall, treatment works, or permit jurisdiction
textile_factory_toxic_dyes.cadence: permit sample with monthly and annual load summaries
textile_factory_toxic_dyes.transformation: Retain mill subcategory, fibre, process, dye or pollutant identity, flow, concentration, load, direct or indirect pathway, treatment, permit basis, and uncertainty.
textile_factory_toxic_dyes.uncertainty: Product mix, proprietary chemicals, batch discharges, colour proxies, treatment, sampling, and unreported compounds affect interpretation.
textile_factory_toxic_dyes.threshold_provenance: Use the applicable 40 CFR Part 410 subcategory, analyte method, and permit.
textile_factory_toxic_dyes.failure_behavior: Do not label all colour as toxicity, all dyes as the same chemical, or infer ecosystem harm without exposure evidence.

construction_concrete_debris.unit: tonnes generated, recovered, recycled, reused, landfilled, or stockpiled per reporting period
construction_concrete_debris.geography: named project, facility, municipality, state, or national material-flow boundary
construction_concrete_debris.cadence: project closeout with annual facility or jurisdiction summaries
construction_concrete_debris.transformation: Retain material class, source activity, mass method, contamination, destination, recovery definition, recycled aggregate output, stock change, and uncertainty.
construction_concrete_debris.uncertainty: Mixed loads, volume-to-mass conversion, informal reuse, double counting, stockpiles, and facility coverage affect totals.
construction_concrete_debris.threshold_provenance: Use a declared construction-and-demolition material definition and mass-balance boundary.
construction_concrete_debris.failure_behavior: Do not treat all debris as concrete, all received material as landfilled, or infer avoided extraction without substitution evidence.

aluminum_smelter_slurry_ponds.unit: tonnes dry residue, cubic metres slurry, hectares, pH, salinity, and named contaminant concentration reported separately
aluminum_smelter_slurry_ponds.geography: named alumina refinery residue impoundment and monitoring network
aluminum_smelter_slurry_ponds.cadence: monthly operations with annual inventory and inspection summaries
aluminum_smelter_slurry_ponds.transformation: Retain refinery process, ore, solids and moisture basis, slurry volume, area, liner, water balance, pH, salinity, radionuclide or metal analyte, sample medium, reuse, and uncertainty.
aluminum_smelter_slurry_ponds.uncertainty: Moisture, density, ore composition, legacy deposits, impoundment geometry, seepage, and incomplete inventories affect estimates.
aluminum_smelter_slurry_ponds.threshold_provenance: Use site waste records, engineering surveys, and named chemical or radiological methods.
aluminum_smelter_slurry_ponds.failure_behavior: Do not call bauxite-refinery residue a smelter output or infer release and exposure from stored mass alone.

uranium_mill_tailings.unit: tonnes or cubic metres, hectares, water level, radon flux, and named radionuclide or contaminant concentration reported separately
uranium_mill_tailings.geography: named uranium production or legacy tailings facility and surveillance boundary
uranium_mill_tailings.cadence: routine inspection with periodic environmental monitoring and post-closure surveillance
uranium_mill_tailings.transformation: Retain operational status, waste mass and geometry, cover, embankment, water controls, inspection findings, sample medium, radionuclide, method, detection limit, maintenance, and uncertainty.
uranium_mill_tailings.uncertainty: Historical records, heterogeneous residues, moisture, radon variability, groundwater transport, background radiation, and survey coverage affect interpretation.
uranium_mill_tailings.threshold_provenance: Use the applicable national licence plus the IAEA graded monitoring and surveillance framework.
uranium_mill_tailings.failure_behavior: Do not infer migration, dose, structural failure, or exposure from tailings presence alone.

fluorinated_gas_exhaust.unit: kilograms of each gas and tonnes CO2-equivalent per reporting period with GWP basis stated
fluorinated_gas_exhaust.geography: named facility, equipment population, industrial sector, or inventory jurisdiction
fluorinated_gas_exhaust.cadence: event or mass-balance accounting with annual regulatory reporting
fluorinated_gas_exhaust.transformation: Retain gas species, source process, production, charge or throughput, destruction, capture, leak or vent pathway, mass method, GWP version, reporting boundary, and uncertainty.
fluorinated_gas_exhaust.uncertainty: Species identification, inventories, destruction efficiency, equipment stocks, imports and exports, leakage timing, and GWP basis affect totals.
fluorinated_gas_exhaust.threshold_provenance: Use the applicable GHGRP subpart or inventory method for the named species and source.
fluorinated_gas_exhaust.failure_behavior: Do not treat fluorinated gases as one substance, report concentration as emissions, or combine mass and CO2-equivalent without the GWP basis.

heavy_fuel_oil_combustion.unit: tonnes of fuel and kilograms of each pollutant per voyage or operating period with sulphur mass fraction stated
heavy_fuel_oil_combustion.geography: named vessel, fleet, port call, route, or emission-control area
heavy_fuel_oil_combustion.cadence: voyage and bunker record with annual fleet summaries
heavy_fuel_oil_combustion.transformation: Retain fuel type, sulphur content, mass consumed, engine or boiler, load, operating mode, emission-control area, scrubber status, pollutant method, and uncertainty.
heavy_fuel_oil_combustion.uncertainty: Fuel sampling, consumption allocation, engine load, auxiliary use, scrubber performance, and operating location affect estimates.
heavy_fuel_oil_combustion.threshold_provenance: Use MARPOL Annex VI fuel-sulphur limits and a declared pollutant calculation method.
heavy_fuel_oil_combustion.failure_behavior: Do not infer SOx or particulate emissions from a heavy-fuel label without sulphur, consumption, engine and control data.

industrial_boiler_ash_sites.unit: tonnes of fly ash, bottom ash, boiler slag, or control residual generated, recovered, stored, or disposed per reporting period
industrial_boiler_ash_sites.geography: named industrial boiler, facility, storage unit, disposal site, or reporting jurisdiction
industrial_boiler_ash_sites.cadence: monthly operations with annual material-flow and inspection summaries
industrial_boiler_ash_sites.transformation: Retain fuel, boiler, residual type, dry or wet basis, control device, mass method, storage or disposal unit, reuse, chemistry where measured, and uncertainty.
industrial_boiler_ash_sites.uncertainty: Fuel ash content, moisture, mixed residuals, stock changes, internal reuse, and incomplete facility records affect totals.
industrial_boiler_ash_sites.threshold_provenance: Use site mass balance and the applicable waste or beneficial-use classification.
industrial_boiler_ash_sites.failure_behavior: Do not infer contamination or exposure from ash generation, or combine coal, biomass and other-fuel residues without fuel and chemistry context.

geothermal_gas_outflow.unit: kilograms of each gas per megawatt-hour and tonnes per reporting period with plant technology stated
geothermal_gas_outflow.geography: named geothermal wellfield, power plant, reservoir, or reporting jurisdiction
geothermal_gas_outflow.cadence: stack or process measurement with monthly and annual summaries
geothermal_gas_outflow.transformation: Retain plant technology, reservoir, steam or brine flow, gas species, abatement, reinjection, generation, operating hours, method, detection limit, and uncertainty.
geothermal_gas_outflow.uncertainty: Reservoir chemistry, plant design, steam fraction, abatement, reinjection, operating conditions, and sparse testing affect rates.
geothermal_gas_outflow.threshold_provenance: Use measured species-specific mass flow divided by net generation for the same period.
geothermal_gas_outflow.failure_behavior: Do not assume binary plants release reservoir gases, combine H2S and CO2, or infer emissions from geothermal capacity alone.

atmospheric_heat_domers.unit: geopotential-height anomaly, ridge-area, residence time, and near-surface temperature anomaly reported separately
atmospheric_heat_domers.geography: named synoptic region and pressure level with an explicit climatological baseline
atmospheric_heat_domers.cadence: six-hourly analysis with event-duration and seasonal summaries
atmospheric_heat_domers.transformation: Retain pressure level, ridge boundary, anomaly baseline, duration, subsidence, surface temperature, soil moisture, cloud, wind, event dates, and analysis system.
atmospheric_heat_domers.uncertainty: Ridge definition, reanalysis choice, baseline, terrain, soil moisture, advection, cloud and event-boundary choices affect attribution and severity.
atmospheric_heat_domers.threshold_provenance: Use a declared geopotential-height and persistence definition; heat dome is informal wording, not a universal threshold.
atmospheric_heat_domers.failure_behavior: Do not infer surface heat intensity from ridge presence alone or treat every hot event as persistent atmospheric blocking.

thermal_air_column_shifts.unit: degrees Celsius anomaly at a stated pressure level or layer, with baseline and aggregation stated
thermal_air_column_shifts.geography: named radiosonde station, latitude band, pressure layer, or global RATPAC aggregation
thermal_air_column_shifts.cadence: twice-daily soundings with monthly anomaly products
thermal_air_column_shifts.transformation: Retain pressure level, station set, observation time, homogenization version, baseline period, spatial weighting, missing-data treatment, and confidence interval.
thermal_air_column_shifts.uncertainty: Station coverage, instrument changes, homogenization, sparse upper-air sampling, baseline choice and layer aggregation affect trends.
thermal_air_column_shifts.threshold_provenance: Use the named RATPAC product and baseline; shift is not a defined physical threshold.
thermal_air_column_shifts.failure_behavior: Do not combine surface and upper-air temperatures or infer circulation causes from a layer anomaly alone.

polar_jet_stream_anchors.metric_name: Northern Hemisphere jet-stream position and extent
polar_jet_stream_anchors.unit: latitude, longitude, metres per second, geopotential-height pattern, or standardized teleconnection index with level stated
polar_jet_stream_anchors.geography: Northern Hemisphere circulation domain or named Pacific-Atlantic sector
polar_jet_stream_anchors.cadence: daily analysis with monthly and seasonal index summaries
polar_jet_stream_anchors.transformation: Retain pressure level, wind threshold, jet latitude and extent, teleconnection definition, season, analysis system, climatology, and uncertainty.
polar_jet_stream_anchors.uncertainty: Pressure level, jet-identification algorithm, reanalysis, seasonality, multiple jet branches and teleconnection choice affect the result.
polar_jet_stream_anchors.threshold_provenance: Use a documented wind or teleconnection definition; anchor is informal wording and does not establish persistence.
polar_jet_stream_anchors.failure_behavior: Do not infer local weather, blocking, or causation from one jet-position or teleconnection index.

monsoonal_wind_shear.unit: metres per second vector difference between declared pressure levels with direction and averaging window stated
monsoonal_wind_shear.geography: named monsoon region, reanalysis grid, sounding network, or forecast domain
monsoonal_wind_shear.cadence: daily during the monsoon season with pentad and seasonal summaries
monsoonal_wind_shear.transformation: Retain upper and lower pressure levels, vector components, spatial domain, onset and withdrawal dates, reanalysis or sounding source, climatology, rainfall separately, and uncertainty.
monsoonal_wind_shear.uncertainty: Pressure-level choice, domain, reanalysis, sparse soundings, intraseasonal variability, terrain and onset definition affect comparisons.
monsoonal_wind_shear.threshold_provenance: Use a named meteorological service or study definition; shear alone is not monsoon strength or rainfall.
monsoonal_wind_shear.failure_behavior: Do not infer rainfall change, cyclone development, or a causal shift from shear without circulation and moisture evidence.

nitrogen_oxide_saturation.metric_name: Ambient nitrogen-oxide concentration and ozone-precursor context
nitrogen_oxide_saturation.unit: parts per billion of NO, NO2 or NOx with averaging period, method and species definition stated
nitrogen_oxide_saturation.geography: named AQS monitor, airshed, nonattainment area, or modeled grid
nitrogen_oxide_saturation.cadence: hourly observations with daily, seasonal and annual summaries
nitrogen_oxide_saturation.transformation: Retain chemical species, monitor, averaging period, instrument, quality flags, VOC context, sunlight, temperature, transport, ozone response regime, and uncertainty.
nitrogen_oxide_saturation.uncertainty: Monitor siting, instrument response, NOx definition, photochemistry, VOC limitation, titration, transport and weather affect ozone interpretation.
nitrogen_oxide_saturation.threshold_provenance: Use the applicable NO2 standard or a declared photochemical analysis; saturation is not a universal NOx threshold.
nitrogen_oxide_saturation.failure_behavior: Do not infer that more NOx always raises ozone, combine NO2 and total NOx without definition, or treat concentration as an emission rate.

hydrofluorocarbon_output.unit: kilograms by HFC species and tonnes CO2-equivalent per reporting period, or parts per trillion dry mole fraction, reported separately
hydrofluorocarbon_output.geography: named facility, equipment population, country inventory, monitoring station, latitude band, or global aggregation
hydrofluorocarbon_output.cadence: event or annual emissions inventory with monthly atmospheric observations
hydrofluorocarbon_output.transformation: Retain HFC species, source sector, mass method, equipment stock, charge, recovery and destruction, GWP basis, station, instrument, dry-air basis, aggregation, and uncertainty.
hydrofluorocarbon_output.uncertainty: Species coverage, equipment stocks, leakage timing, inventory factors, imports and exports, atmospheric transport, station coverage and GWP basis affect estimates.
hydrofluorocarbon_output.threshold_provenance: Use species-specific inventory methods or the NOAA measurement product; output is not a scientifically bounded aggregate without species and method.
hydrofluorocarbon_output.failure_behavior: Do not combine emission mass, CO2-equivalent and atmospheric concentration or treat all HFC species as interchangeable.

secondary_organic_aerosol_burden.unit: micrograms of organic carbon per cubic metre with sampling, blank correction, conversion and averaging period stated
secondary_organic_aerosol_burden.geography: named Chemical Speciation Network or IMPROVE monitor and airshed
secondary_organic_aerosol_burden.cadence: scheduled filter sample with seasonal and annual summaries
secondary_organic_aerosol_burden.transformation: Retain total organic carbon, elemental carbon, sampling schedule, filter and thermal-optical method, blank and artifact corrections, detection limits, site class, meteorology, and source-apportionment method separately.
secondary_organic_aerosol_burden.uncertainty: Sampling artifacts, blank correction, thermal-optical protocol, sparse cadence, volatility, conversion from carbon to organic matter and source apportionment affect estimates.
secondary_organic_aerosol_burden.threshold_provenance: Use the named CSN or IMPROVE method; measured organic carbon does not by itself identify secondary formation.
secondary_organic_aerosol_burden.failure_behavior: Do not label all organic aerosol as secondary, infer precursor sources without apportionment, or add carbon-component mass to total PM2.5 again.

brown_carbon_loading.unit: organic-carbon mass concentration plus wavelength-specific absorption coefficient or aerosol optical depth, reported separately
brown_carbon_loading.geography: named filter monitor, optical instrument, aircraft profile, satellite column, or study domain
brown_carbon_loading.cadence: sample or overpass with event, monthly and seasonal summaries
brown_carbon_loading.transformation: Retain organic and elemental carbon methods, wavelength, absorption model, particle size, source-apportionment assumptions, mixing state, relative humidity, vertical domain, and uncertainty.
brown_carbon_loading.uncertainty: Operational definitions, wavelength dependence, filter artifacts, mixing state, source overlap, humidity and optical-model assumptions strongly affect inferred loading.
brown_carbon_loading.threshold_provenance: Use the named chemical and optical methods; color terminology alone is not a mass or forcing threshold.
brown_carbon_loading.failure_behavior: Do not equate all organic carbon with light-absorbing material, convert optical depth directly to surface mass, or infer radiative forcing without a model.

carrier_interconnection_bottleneck.unit: gigabits per second of measured or provisioned IP-layer capacity, utilization percent, loss, delay, and constrained duration reported separately
carrier_interconnection_bottleneck.geography: named interconnection, exchange, autonomous-system pair, metro, or carrier boundary
carrier_interconnection_bottleneck.cadence: five-minute telemetry with daily and monthly engineering summaries
carrier_interconnection_bottleneck.transformation: Retain measurement layer, direction, interface, provisioned capacity, achieved capacity, utilization, packet loss, delay, test method, maintenance, traffic shifts, and uncertainty.
carrier_interconnection_bottleneck.uncertainty: Encryption, traffic engineering, route changes, burstiness, test endpoints, layer mismatch, private peering and incomplete operator coverage affect interpretation.
carrier_interconnection_bottleneck.threshold_provenance: Use the ITU IP-layer capacity method and an operator-declared engineering threshold; high utilization alone is not a bottleneck.
carrier_interconnection_bottleneck.failure_behavior: Do not infer congestion from demand growth, combine physical and IP-layer capacity, or treat an advertised port speed as measured throughput.

fiber_route_outage_risk.unit: outage events, affected route-kilometres, user-hours, service minutes, and restoration duration reported separately
fiber_route_outage_risk.geography: named terrestrial fiber route, network segment, service area, or operator boundary
fiber_route_outage_risk.cadence: incident event with monthly and annual reliability summaries
fiber_route_outage_risk.transformation: Retain route and affected facilities, cause, start, detection, service impact, redundancy, traffic restoration, repair completion, users affected, reporting threshold, and uncertainty.
fiber_route_outage_risk.uncertainty: Confidential route maps, shared infrastructure, incomplete cause coding, overlapping incidents, rerouting, reporting thresholds and affected-user estimates limit comparability.
fiber_route_outage_risk.threshold_provenance: Use the applicable outage-reporting rule and operator incident definition; mapped exposure is not observed failure risk.
fiber_route_outage_risk.failure_behavior: Do not infer an outage from hazard exposure or convert one incident count into a forward probability without a declared model.

network_operations_center_dependence.unit: critical functions, staffed hours, failover time, recovery time, and service impact minutes with control boundary stated
network_operations_center_dependence.geography: named operator, network operations center, redundant control site, or service domain
network_operations_center_dependence.cadence: configuration review with incident and exercise updates
network_operations_center_dependence.transformation: Retain controlled services, primary and backup sites, remote operations, staff coverage, power and connectivity dependencies, failover tests, incident history, recovery objectives, and uncertainty.
network_operations_center_dependence.uncertainty: Undisclosed architecture, shared control planes, outsourcing, untested failover, human procedures, cyber controls and incident reporting affect assessment.
network_operations_center_dependence.threshold_provenance: Use an operator business-continuity and resilience assessment; center presence alone does not establish a single point of failure.
network_operations_center_dependence.failure_behavior: Do not infer fragility from central monitoring or count planned maintenance as service loss.

switching_node_fragility.unit: availability percent, failure events, affected user-hours, failover time, spare capacity, and restoration duration reported separately
switching_node_fragility.geography: named switch, router, exchange, core site, or service domain
switching_node_fragility.cadence: continuous availability telemetry with incident and annual resilience summaries
switching_node_fragility.transformation: Retain node role, hardware and software version, redundancy, traffic load, power, dependencies, failure cause, affected services, rerouting, repair, maintenance, and uncertainty.
switching_node_fragility.uncertainty: Hidden redundancy, correlated failures, software dependencies, traffic engineering, reporting thresholds, maintenance and affected-user estimates limit comparisons.
switching_node_fragility.threshold_provenance: Use a declared availability and resilience objective; fragility is not established by topology centrality alone.
switching_node_fragility.failure_behavior: Do not infer failure probability from node degree, load, or a single incident without architecture and observation history.

chip_packaging_throughput.unit: packages, wafers, dies, substrate area, or good units per reporting period with product and yield stated
chip_packaging_throughput.geography: named packaging line, facility, company, or manufacturing jurisdiction
chip_packaging_throughput.cadence: shift or daily operations with monthly capacity summaries
chip_packaging_throughput.transformation: Retain package architecture, product, wafer or die inputs, line and tool boundary, starts, completed units, yield, rework, utilization, cycle time, qualification state, and uncertainty.
chip_packaging_throughput.uncertainty: Product mix, yield learning, rework, outsourced steps, line sharing, confidential capacity, qualification and inventory timing affect throughput.
chip_packaging_throughput.threshold_provenance: Use measured good-unit output for the declared process boundary; announced capacity and tool count are not throughput.
chip_packaging_throughput.failure_behavior: Do not infer energy, material use, emissions or supply security from package count alone.

cloud_campus_water_stress.metric_name: Data-center water use and local scarcity context
cloud_campus_water_stress.unit: cubic metres withdrawn and consumed, litres per kilowatt-hour, and basin scarcity indicator reported separately
cloud_campus_water_stress.geography: named data-center campus, water utility, watershed, basin, and source
cloud_campus_water_stress.cadence: hourly or daily metering with monthly water balance and annual basin context
cloud_campus_water_stress.transformation: Separate withdrawal, consumption, blowdown, discharge, reuse and source; retain IT energy, heat load, cooling system, weather, meter coverage, WUE, basin period, competing demand, and uncertainty.
cloud_campus_water_stress.uncertainty: Shared campuses, meter coverage, cooling technology, weather, reused water, source accounting, basin scale, seasonal scarcity and indirect electricity water use affect results.
cloud_campus_water_stress.threshold_provenance: Use metered facility water balance plus a named basin scarcity method; WUE alone is not water stress.
cloud_campus_water_stress.failure_behavior: Do not infer basin stress from campus water use without local availability and timing, or equate withdrawal with consumption.

metropolitan_gridlock_emissions.unit: kilograms or tonnes of named pollutant, vehicle-kilometres, vehicle-hours, speed distribution, and fuel use reported separately
metropolitan_gridlock_emissions.geography: named urban road network, corridor, county, or project domain
metropolitan_gridlock_emissions.cadence: hourly traffic conditions with daily, seasonal, and annual emission inventories
metropolitan_gridlock_emissions.transformation: Retain pollutant, fleet, fuel, model year, operating mode, road type, speed distribution, starts, idling, temperature, inspection and maintenance, geography, MOVES version, inputs, and uncertainty.
metropolitan_gridlock_emissions.uncertainty: Traffic counts, fleet composition, speed, starts, temperature, fuel, model defaults, road grade, induced demand and boundary choice affect estimates.
metropolitan_gridlock_emissions.threshold_provenance: Use a documented MOVES run and inventory boundary; delay or low speed alone is not an emission quantity.
metropolitan_gridlock_emissions.failure_behavior: Do not infer emissions from congestion rank, combine pollutants, or count upstream fuel emissions as tailpipe output.

e_commerce_delivery_vehicle_miles.unit: vehicle-kilometres or vehicle-miles by vehicle class and reporting period, with parcels and stops reported separately
e_commerce_delivery_vehicle_miles.geography: named carrier fleet, delivery zone, urban area, road network, or reporting jurisdiction
e_commerce_delivery_vehicle_miles.cadence: trip or daily operations with monthly and annual summaries
e_commerce_delivery_vehicle_miles.transformation: Retain vehicle class, route, distance, stops, parcels, load, failed deliveries, depot legs, empty travel, fuel, fleet coverage, urban boundary, allocation method, and uncertainty.
e_commerce_delivery_vehicle_miles.uncertainty: Proprietary routes, subcontractors, personal vehicles, failed deliveries, returns, route optimization, boundary choice and incomplete fleet coverage affect totals.
e_commerce_delivery_vehicle_miles.threshold_provenance: Use observed fleet activity or a declared travel-demand method; order count is not vehicle distance.
e_commerce_delivery_vehicle_miles.failure_behavior: Do not convert parcel volume directly to travel or emissions without fleet, routing, load and fuel data.

urban_commuting_time_traps.unit: minutes one way with estimate, margin of error, mode, worker universe, geography, and survey year stated
urban_commuting_time_traps.geography: named Census geography, metropolitan area, city, tract, or commuting flow
urban_commuting_time_traps.cadence: annual American Community Survey estimate with five-year products where required
urban_commuting_time_traps.transformation: Retain worker universe, work-from-home treatment, transport mode, departure time, travel-time bins, estimate, margin of error, survey product, geography, year, allocation flags, and comparability notes.
urban_commuting_time_traps.uncertainty: Sampling error, self-report, nonresponse, allocation, open-ended bins, changing work-from-home prevalence, geography and one-year versus five-year products affect comparisons.
urban_commuting_time_traps.threshold_provenance: Use the named ACS table and margin of error; trap is not a Census category or universal duration threshold.
urban_commuting_time_traps.failure_behavior: Do not infer congestion, emissions, wellbeing or access from mean travel time alone.

boreal_insect_infestations.unit: hectares affected, host mortality percent, defoliation class, and insect abundance reported separately
boreal_insect_infestations.geography: named boreal forest unit, host species, insect taxon, survey year, and disturbance perimeter
boreal_insect_infestations.cadence: annual aerial or field survey with outbreak follow-up
boreal_insect_infestations.transformation: Retain insect and host, outbreak definition, damage class, mortality, drought and heat, stand structure, fire, management, survey coverage, and uncertainty.
boreal_insect_infestations.uncertainty: Detection, host distribution, overlapping drought and fire, lagged mortality, survey methods, and natural outbreak cycles affect attribution.
boreal_insect_infestations.threshold_provenance: Use the named forest-health survey and taxon-specific outbreak definition.
boreal_insect_infestations.failure_behavior: Do not generalize bark beetles or defoliators to all insects or infer a climate trend from one outbreak.

chemical_factory_acid_spills.unit: kilograms or litres by named substance, concentration, affected medium, and response duration
chemical_factory_acid_spills.geography: named facility, process unit, release location, affected area, and reporting jurisdiction
chemical_factory_acid_spills.cadence: incident event with response and closure updates
chemical_factory_acid_spills.transformation: Retain substance, concentration, quantity, source, cause, land-water-air pathway, injuries, evacuation, containment, recovery, cleanup, reportable threshold, and uncertainty.
chemical_factory_acid_spills.uncertainty: Initial estimates, unknown mixtures, unreported releases, evaporation, neutralization, recovery, and changing incident boundaries affect totals.
chemical_factory_acid_spills.threshold_provenance: Use the applicable reportable quantity, incident record, and substance-specific method.
chemical_factory_acid_spills.failure_behavior: Do not infer ecosystem or health outcomes from a reported quantity alone or treat all chemical facilities and acids as interchangeable.

deciduous_leaf_drop_offsets.unit: day of year or days relative to a fixed phenology baseline with vegetation class and method stated
deciduous_leaf_drop_offsets.geography: named plot, species, satellite pixel, ecosystem, and phenology product
deciduous_leaf_drop_offsets.transformation: Retain species or vegetation class, phenophase or reflectance metric, sensor, algorithm, observation density, baseline, weather, disturbance, and uncertainty.
deciduous_leaf_drop_offsets.uncertainty: Clouds, mixed pixels, sensor change, species composition, drought, frost, disturbance, and the difference between canopy reflectance and plant phenophases affect estimates.
deciduous_leaf_drop_offsets.threshold_provenance: Use a fixed land-surface or field-phenology definition and baseline.
deciduous_leaf_drop_offsets.failure_behavior: Do not interpret satellite browning as leaf fall for an individual species or infer cause from timing alone.

edge_effect_intensifications.unit: edge-to-interior ratio, distance from edge, microclimate difference, occupancy, survival, or reproduction with focal response stated
edge_effect_intensifications.geography: named habitat patch, edge type, landscape, focal taxon, and comparison interior
edge_effect_intensifications.cadence: land-cover update with seasonal or annual ecological sampling
edge_effect_intensifications.transformation: Retain edge origin, age, orientation, adjacent cover, patch size, interior definition, focal species, response, sampling design, confounders, and uncertainty.
edge_effect_intensifications.uncertainty: Edge age and type, matrix habitat, patch loss, species traits, scale, land use, predation, and sampling influence measured effects.
edge_effect_intensifications.threshold_provenance: Use a declared edge and interior definition plus a measured response gradient.
edge_effect_intensifications.failure_behavior: Do not assume every boundary has a negative effect or separate edge influence from habitat loss without analysis.

endemic_species_isolations.unit: occupied patches, dispersal probability, genetic differentiation, effective population size, or distance with method stated
endemic_species_isolations.geography: named endemic taxon, islands or habitat patches, range, and sampling design
endemic_species_isolations.transformation: Retain taxon, endemic range, patch occupancy, barriers, movement or genetic method, sample size, generation time, habitat, historical structure, and uncertainty.
endemic_species_isolations.uncertainty: Natural geographic isolation, incomplete sampling, marker choice, generation time, dispersal, range knowledge, and historical demography affect inference.
endemic_species_isolations.threshold_provenance: Use a species-specific connectivity or genetic-isolation method.
endemic_species_isolations.failure_behavior: Do not infer recent fragmentation or extinction risk merely because a species is endemic or geographically restricted.

exotic_pathogen_outbreaks.unit: confirmed cases, affected hosts, incidence, mortality, and geographic extent by named pathogen
exotic_pathogen_outbreaks.geography: named pathogen, host population, outbreak area, surveillance system, and introduction-status assessment
exotic_pathogen_outbreaks.cadence: case event with weekly outbreak updates and closure review
exotic_pathogen_outbreaks.transformation: Retain pathogen and strain, host, case definition, diagnostic confirmation, origin and introduction evidence, transmission route, geography, denominator, surveillance, controls, and uncertainty.
exotic_pathogen_outbreaks.uncertainty: Under-detection, diagnostic changes, wildlife surveillance, incomplete origin evidence, host range, and reporting delays affect classification.
exotic_pathogen_outbreaks.threshold_provenance: Require a named pathogen-host outbreak definition and evidence supporting non-native or newly introduced status.
exotic_pathogen_outbreaks.failure_behavior: Do not use exotic as a synonym for zoonotic, emerging, severe, or geographically distant.

flame_retardant_runoff.unit: nanograms or micrograms per litre by named compound, dissolved or particulate fraction, and event load
flame_retardant_runoff.geography: named catchment, land-use source, outfall, storm event, and receiving water
flame_retardant_runoff.transformation: Retain compound, product-use evidence, matrix and fraction, rainfall, runoff volume, outfall, source area, sample timing, method, detection limit, blank, and uncertainty.
flame_retardant_runoff.uncertainty: Unknown product sources, indoor dust, wastewater, atmospheric deposition, sediment, mixtures, event sampling, and analytical blanks affect attribution.
flame_retardant_runoff.threshold_provenance: Use a compound-specific analytical method and declared stormwater load calculation.
flame_retardant_runoff.failure_behavior: Do not infer source, toxicity, or ecological effect from a detected concentration without product, pathway, exposure, and benchmark evidence.

illegal_wildlife_poaching.metric_name: Illegal wildlife take and trafficking record
illegal_wildlife_poaching.unit: animals, plants, specimens, mass, incidents, prosecutions, or estimated take by named taxon and period
illegal_wildlife_poaching.geography: named taxon, protected area, trade route, jurisdiction, and enforcement coverage
illegal_wildlife_poaching.cadence: incident reporting with annual enforcement and population review
illegal_wildlife_poaching.transformation: Retain taxon, legal status, incident type, take versus seizure, live or dead state, mass or count, route, enforcement effort, duplication, population context, and uncertainty.
illegal_wildlife_poaching.uncertainty: Detection and enforcement effort, clandestine trade, seizure-to-flow ratios, species identification, duplicate records, and population denominators affect trends.
illegal_wildlife_poaching.threshold_provenance: Use the applicable law and documented incident or modeled estimate with enforcement coverage.
illegal_wildlife_poaching.failure_behavior: Do not equate seizures with total trade or infer a population decline without demographic evidence.

keystone_species_deficits.unit: abundance, biomass, occupancy, interaction rate, or experimentally estimated ecosystem effect with taxon and function stated
keystone_species_deficits.geography: named ecosystem, focal taxon, interaction network, and study boundary
keystone_species_deficits.cadence: seasonal or annual population monitoring with multi-year functional study
keystone_species_deficits.transformation: Retain taxon, claimed function, population metric, prey or resource observations, interaction evidence, experiment or model, alternatives, and uncertainty.
keystone_species_deficits.uncertainty: Functional redundancy, context dependence, alternate predators or engineers, food-web complexity, scale, and weak causal identification affect claims.
keystone_species_deficits.threshold_provenance: Require a named taxon and evidence of disproportionate functional effect; deficit has no universal abundance threshold.
keystone_species_deficits.failure_behavior: Do not label a rare, charismatic, top-predator, or declining species keystone without functional evidence.

lichen_layer_degradations.unit: species richness, cover, frequency, tissue concentration, or community index with substrate and protocol stated
lichen_layer_degradations.geography: named monitoring plot, forest, airshed, substrate, and lichen assemblage
lichen_layer_degradations.cadence: multi-year biological survey with pollution-monitoring context
lichen_layer_degradations.transformation: Retain taxa, substrate, plot design, cover and frequency method, tissue analyte, deposition, climate, forest structure, disturbance, observer, and uncertainty.
lichen_layer_degradations.uncertainty: Substrate, moisture, temperature, canopy, succession, observer effects, deposition mixtures, and species-specific sensitivity affect condition.
lichen_layer_degradations.threshold_provenance: Use the named lichen biomonitoring protocol and reference condition.
lichen_layer_degradations.failure_behavior: Do not attribute community change to air pollution or climate from lichen condition alone.

top_predator_extinctions.unit: abundance, density, biomass, occupancy, survival, recruitment, or extinction status by named taxon and area
top_predator_extinctions.geography: named ecosystem, predator population, assessment unit, and monitoring period
top_predator_extinctions.transformation: Retain taxon, trophic role, population unit, method, detection, harvest, prey, habitat, disease, protection, extinction criterion, and uncertainty.
top_predator_extinctions.uncertainty: Detection, movement, taxonomic scope, prey shifts, harvest reporting, habitat, alternate predators, and assessment intervals affect status.
top_predator_extinctions.threshold_provenance: Use a named population assessment or IUCN extinction criterion; local absence is not species extinction.
top_predator_extinctions.failure_behavior: Do not infer a trophic cascade from predator decline without measured predator-prey links and downstream response.

airport_runway_canopy_clearance.unit: hectares by land-cover class and management action
airport_runway_canopy_clearance.geography: named airport movement area, runway safety area, or wildlife-hazard management boundary
airport_runway_canopy_clearance.cadence: project event with annual land-cover review
airport_runway_canopy_clearance.transformation: Retain mapped boundary, baseline cover, action, safety rationale, wildlife-hazard assessment, permits, replacement habitat, and uncertainty.
airport_runway_canopy_clearance.uncertainty: Land-cover classification, undocumented maintenance, seasonal vegetation, and off-airport habitat limit comparison.
airport_runway_canopy_clearance.threshold_provenance: Use the airport wildlife-hazard plan and dated land-cover inventory.
airport_runway_canopy_clearance.failure_behavior: Do not call all vegetation management canopy clearance or infer biodiversity loss without habitat and species evidence.

aquaculture_pond_anti_parasitics.unit: kilograms active ingredient, treatment concentration, and residue concentration reported separately
aquaculture_pond_anti_parasitics.geography: named farm, pond, cage, treatment area, receiving water, or residue-monitoring programme
aquaculture_pond_anti_parasitics.cadence: treatment event with harvest and environmental follow-up
aquaculture_pond_anti_parasitics.transformation: Retain active ingredient, species, dose, route, duration, withdrawal period, treated biomass, receiving pathway, sample matrix, method, and detection limit.
aquaculture_pond_anti_parasitics.uncertainty: Treatment records, dilution, degradation, sediment binding, withdrawal compliance, and sparse environmental sampling affect exposure estimates.
aquaculture_pond_anti_parasitics.threshold_provenance: Use the authorized product label, residue limit, and named environmental method.
aquaculture_pond_anti_parasitics.failure_behavior: Do not treat medicine use as environmental harm or combine different active ingredients without exposure and effect evidence.

aviation_sulphate_particle_layer.metric_name: Aviation sulfur emission and sulfate forcing component
aviation_sulphate_particle_layer.unit: kilograms sulfur oxides or sulfate aerosol and watts per square metre reported separately
aviation_sulphate_particle_layer.geography: named aircraft fleet and route domain or declared global aviation assessment
aviation_sulphate_particle_layer.cadence: flight or annual inventory with assessment-period forcing estimate
aviation_sulphate_particle_layer.transformation: Retain fuel sulfur, engine and fleet activity, altitude, emitted precursor versus formed aerosol, model, cloud interaction, assessment year, and uncertainty.
aviation_sulphate_particle_layer.uncertainty: Fuel sulfur, plume chemistry, particle microphysics, cloud interactions, traffic distribution, and model structure dominate the forcing estimate.
aviation_sulphate_particle_layer.threshold_provenance: Use the IPCC short-lived-climate-forcer assessment or a documented aviation inventory and chemistry model.
aviation_sulphate_particle_layer.failure_behavior: Do not describe a persistent atmospheric layer, combine sulfate cooling with soot or contrail warming, or infer net aviation forcing from this component.

biofuel_crop_land_grab.unit: hectares by prior land cover and feedstock, with direct and modeled indirect change reported separately
biofuel_crop_land_grab.geography: named project, supply shed, jurisdiction, or model region
biofuel_crop_land_grab.transformation: Retain feedstock, prior cover, conversion date, spatial overlap, yield, co-products, trade boundary, attribution method, and uncertainty.
biofuel_crop_land_grab.uncertainty: Commodity substitution, trade, yield, co-products, counterfactual land use, and indirect-change modeling affect attribution.
biofuel_crop_land_grab.threshold_provenance: Require mapped direct conversion or a declared indirect-land-use-change model.
biofuel_crop_land_grab.failure_behavior: Do not label all feedstock acreage a land grab or infer deforestation without prior-cover evidence.

broiler_chicken_litter_ash.unit: tonnes dry ash and nutrient or contaminant concentration by fraction
broiler_chicken_litter_ash.geography: named poultry-litter combustion facility, storage site, land-application area, or destination
broiler_chicken_litter_ash.cadence: production batch with annual material-flow summary
broiler_chicken_litter_ash.transformation: Retain litter source, combustion process, moisture basis, size fraction, phosphorus, potassium, metals, mass, destination, application rate, and uncertainty.
broiler_chicken_litter_ash.uncertainty: Feed, bedding, soil contamination, burn temperature, particle-size separation, moisture, and sampling affect composition.
broiler_chicken_litter_ash.threshold_provenance: Use facility mass balance and laboratory characterization for the named ash batch.
broiler_chicken_litter_ash.failure_behavior: Do not treat raw litter as ash, infer leaching from stored mass, or classify all ash as waste when documented beneficial use applies.

consumer_product_obsolescence.metric_name: Consumer-product service life and end-of-use flow
consumer_product_obsolescence.unit: median years in service, units or tonnes leaving use, and reuse, repair, refurbishment, recycling, or disposal shares reported separately
consumer_product_obsolescence.geography: named product class, cohort, market, jurisdiction, or material-flow boundary
consumer_product_obsolescence.transformation: Retain product class, cohort, sale and activation dates, service life, reason leaving use, ownership transfer, repair, reuse, storage, end destination, mass, and uncertainty.
consumer_product_obsolescence.uncertainty: Cohort survival, second-hand use, storage, undocumented repair, exports, product mix, and survey coverage affect lifetime estimates.
consumer_product_obsolescence.threshold_provenance: Use cohort survival or documented end-of-use material flow; obsolescence is not inferred from sales or warranty length.
consumer_product_obsolescence.failure_behavior: Do not infer planned obsolescence, technical failure, or resource extraction from a short observed lifetime without causal evidence.

agricultural_crop_insurance_hikes.metric_name: Crop-insurance premium rate and loss ratio
agricultural_crop_insurance_hikes.unit: currency, premium rate, subsidy share, indemnity, and loss ratio reported separately
agricultural_crop_insurance_hikes.geography: named crop, county, state, insurance plan, and commodity year
agricultural_crop_insurance_hikes.transformation: Retain insured acreage, liability, coverage, plan, premium, producer share, subsidy, indemnity, cause of loss, rate method, and policy changes.
agricultural_crop_insurance_hikes.uncertainty: Coverage, crop values, participation, subsidies, rating changes, weather, and portfolio composition affect totals and rates.
agricultural_crop_insurance_hikes.threshold_provenance: Use USDA Risk Management Agency policy and Summary of Business definitions.
agricultural_crop_insurance_hikes.failure_behavior: Do not attribute a premium increase to climate from aggregate cost alone or equate subsidy growth with producer-paid price.

desert_boundary_grazing.metric_name: Dryland grazing pressure and vegetation condition
desert_boundary_grazing.unit: animal-unit months, stocking rate, utilization, bare-ground share, and vegetation cover reported separately
desert_boundary_grazing.geography: named dryland rangeland unit, grazing allotment, pastoral territory, or monitoring plot
desert_boundary_grazing.cadence: seasonal grazing records with annual vegetation review
desert_boundary_grazing.transformation: Retain livestock class, density, timing, duration, forage production, carrying-capacity method, drought, water points, vegetation, soil condition, and uncertainty.
desert_boundary_grazing.uncertainty: Rainfall, mobility, wildlife grazing, fire, land conversion, monitoring coverage, and carrying-capacity assumptions affect attribution.
desert_boundary_grazing.threshold_provenance: Use a named rangeland condition and stocking method; a desert boundary is not a fixed ecological threshold.
desert_boundary_grazing.failure_behavior: Do not equate livestock presence with overgrazing or attribute degradation without pressure, recovery, and alternative-driver evidence.

disease_surveillance_gaps.unit: reporting completeness percent, detection delay, laboratory turnaround, and covered population or facilities reported separately
disease_surveillance_gaps.geography: named disease, surveillance system, jurisdiction, facility network, and reporting period
disease_surveillance_gaps.cadence: weekly or event reporting with annual capability review
disease_surveillance_gaps.transformation: Retain disease and case definition, expected and received reports, population and facility denominator, specimen and laboratory pathway, alert threshold, detection time, verification, response, and uncertainty.
disease_surveillance_gaps.uncertainty: Changing case definitions, underdiagnosis, care seeking, reporting delays, laboratory access, system upgrades, and denominator quality affect gap estimates.
disease_surveillance_gaps.threshold_provenance: Use the named surveillance protocol and reporting expectation.
disease_surveillance_gaps.failure_behavior: Do not infer outbreak absence from no alerts or claim a climate cause from surveillance performance.

e_waste_lead_soil_bleeding.unit: milligrams lead per kilogram dry soil with depth, fraction, and method stated
e_waste_lead_soil_bleeding.geography: named electronics treatment site, disposal area, comparison site, or monitoring grid
e_waste_lead_soil_bleeding.cadence: site investigation with periodic remediation follow-up
e_waste_lead_soil_bleeding.transformation: Retain device and process evidence, sample coordinates and depth, total or bioavailable lead, method, detection limit, background, other sources, land use, and uncertainty.
e_waste_lead_soil_bleeding.uncertainty: Legacy paint, batteries, industry, traffic, soil heterogeneity, informal processing, and sparse samples confound source attribution.
e_waste_lead_soil_bleeding.threshold_provenance: Use a named soil method and applicable risk or cleanup criterion.
e_waste_lead_soil_bleeding.failure_behavior: Do not call all soil lead e-waste-derived or infer leaching, exposure, or health outcome without pathway evidence.

freeway_acoustic_walls_deficit.unit: A-weighted decibels with averaging period, receptor, modeled or measured status, and barrier insertion loss stated
freeway_acoustic_walls_deficit.geography: named highway project, receptor set, barrier segment, and analysis boundary
freeway_acoustic_walls_deficit.cadence: project analysis with post-construction validation where available
freeway_acoustic_walls_deficit.transformation: Retain traffic, fleet, speed, pavement, terrain, receptor, baseline, model, barrier geometry, openings, predicted and measured levels, feasibility, and uncertainty.
freeway_acoustic_walls_deficit.uncertainty: Traffic mix, weather, terrain, reflections, receptor position, barrier gaps, model assumptions, and future traffic affect estimates.
freeway_acoustic_walls_deficit.threshold_provenance: Use the applicable highway-agency noise policy and FHWA analysis method.
freeway_acoustic_walls_deficit.failure_behavior: Do not infer harm from missing wall length alone or assume every barrier is feasible, reasonable, or equally effective.

invertebrate_biomass_crash.unit: grams dry mass, ash-free dry mass, or standardized catch per sampling effort with taxonomic and habitat scope
invertebrate_biomass_crash.geography: named site network, habitat, taxonomic assemblage, and sampling design
invertebrate_biomass_crash.cadence: seasonal standardized sampling with annual and multi-year trend analysis
invertebrate_biomass_crash.transformation: Retain taxa, life stage, trap or collection method, effort, body-size correction, dry-mass method, season, habitat, land use, weather, detection, and uncertainty.
invertebrate_biomass_crash.uncertainty: Sampling method, phenology, weather, body size, taxonomic coverage, habitat, effort, and short baselines strongly affect biomass trends.
invertebrate_biomass_crash.threshold_provenance: Use a fixed sampling protocol and trend interval; crash has no universal magnitude or duration.
invertebrate_biomass_crash.failure_behavior: Do not generalize insects to all invertebrates or infer cause from an unreplicated abundance or biomass decline.

monoculture_encroachments.unit: hectares, crop-richness count, rotation diversity, and landscape heterogeneity reported separately
monoculture_encroachments.geography: named field, farm, agricultural landscape, or jurisdiction
monoculture_encroachments.cadence: crop season with annual and multi-year rotation review
monoculture_encroachments.transformation: Retain crop and variety, field boundaries, rotation history, non-crop habitat, pesticide and fertilizer context, prior land cover, classification method, and uncertainty.
monoculture_encroachments.uncertainty: Crop maps, intercropping, rotations, fallow, field boundaries, management intensity, and non-crop habitat affect diversity measures.
monoculture_encroachments.threshold_provenance: Use a declared crop-diversity or land-cover method; encroachment requires a mapped prior state.
monoculture_encroachments.failure_behavior: Do not equate one crop in one season with persistent monoculture or infer biodiversity loss without ecological observations.

orchard_fungicide_drenching.metric_name: Orchard fungicide application and water residue
orchard_fungicide_drenching.unit: kilograms active ingredient per hectare and micrograms per litre by compound reported separately
orchard_fungicide_drenching.geography: named orchard block, application event, drainage area, and receiving-water station
orchard_fungicide_drenching.cadence: application event with storm-event and seasonal water sampling
orchard_fungicide_drenching.transformation: Retain active ingredient, formulation, crop, rate, method, treated area, weather, runoff pathway, sample matrix, concentration, detection limit, and quality flags.
orchard_fungicide_drenching.uncertainty: Application records, degradation, rainfall, soil, drainage, spray drift, upstream uses, mixtures, and sampling timing affect linkage.
orchard_fungicide_drenching.threshold_provenance: Use the product label and compound-specific water-quality or ecological benchmark.
orchard_fungicide_drenching.failure_behavior: Do not call all orchard treatment drenching or infer aquatic harm from application without transport, exposure, and effect evidence.

slash_and_burn_ash_cover.metric_name: Agricultural burned area and ash cover
slash_and_burn_ash_cover.unit: hectares burned and surface ash-cover percent with land-use transition stated
slash_and_burn_ash_cover.geography: named burn perimeter, field, forest conversion area, or monitoring grid
slash_and_burn_ash_cover.cadence: fire event with seasonal land-cover follow-up
slash_and_burn_ash_cover.transformation: Retain ignition purpose, pre- and post-burn cover, perimeter, severity, ash mapping method, subsequent crop or vegetation, erosion, repeat burning, and uncertainty.
slash_and_burn_ash_cover.uncertainty: Wildfire overlap, cloud and smoke, burn severity, mixed pixels, ash persistence, shifting cultivation, and later regrowth affect classification.
slash_and_burn_ash_cover.threshold_provenance: Require a dated perimeter and land-use evidence; ash alone does not establish slash-and-burn agriculture.
slash_and_burn_ash_cover.failure_behavior: Do not infer permanent deforestation, soil fertility change, or emissions from a single ash-covered image.

subsea_methane_hydrate_venting.metric_name: Seafloor methane-seep flux and water-column fate
subsea_methane_hydrate_venting.unit: moles or kilograms methane per area or time with dissolved concentration and oxidation reported separately
subsea_methane_hydrate_venting.geography: named seep field, continental-margin survey, water column, and sediment domain
subsea_methane_hydrate_venting.cadence: survey event with repeat observatory or multi-year synthesis
subsea_methane_hydrate_venting.transformation: Retain hydrate evidence, seep location and depth, bubble and dissolved flux method, sediment source, oxidation, water-column transport, sea-air exchange, and uncertainty.
subsea_methane_hydrate_venting.uncertainty: Hydrate attribution, episodic flow, bubble dissolution, microbial oxidation, currents, survey coverage, geological sources, and flux scaling affect estimates.
subsea_methane_hydrate_venting.threshold_provenance: Use direct geochemical or geophysical source evidence and a declared flux method.
subsea_methane_hydrate_venting.failure_behavior: Do not assume every seep is hydrate-derived or that seafloor methane reaches the atmosphere.

tropospheric_gas_oxidation.unit: hydroxyl-radical concentration or proxy, methane lifetime, and species-specific reaction loss reported separately
tropospheric_gas_oxidation.geography: named atmospheric model domain, observation network, latitude band, or global assessment
tropospheric_gas_oxidation.cadence: monthly model or proxy analysis with annual assessment
tropospheric_gas_oxidation.transformation: Retain oxidant, precursor gases, humidity, sunlight, temperature, chemical mechanism, observational constraint, model version, methane lifetime definition, and uncertainty.
tropospheric_gas_oxidation.uncertainty: OH is sparsely observed; precursor emissions, photolysis, water vapour, lightning, transport, chemistry, and inverse-model assumptions affect estimates.
tropospheric_gas_oxidation.threshold_provenance: Use a named chemistry model or observational proxy and fixed methane-lifetime definition.
tropospheric_gas_oxidation.failure_behavior: Do not treat oxidation as a gas layer, equate one precursor with global OH, or infer methane removal from ozone alone.

ungulate_grazing_path_corridors.unit: GPS locations, utilization probability, passage count, corridor width, and stopover duration reported separately
ungulate_grazing_path_corridors.geography: named herd, seasonal ranges, migration route, corridor, and monitoring period
ungulate_grazing_path_corridors.cadence: GPS fix with annual migration-season synthesis
ungulate_grazing_path_corridors.transformation: Retain species and herd, collar sample, fix rate, migration phase, route and corridor method, stopovers, forage phenology, topography, disturbance, barriers, and uncertainty.
ungulate_grazing_path_corridors.uncertainty: Collar sample, fix rate, interannual route change, migration participation, weather, forage, disturbance, and corridor algorithm affect mapped use.
ungulate_grazing_path_corridors.threshold_provenance: Use a declared movement model and herd-specific route; a path is not a grazing-pressure measure.
ungulate_grazing_path_corridors.failure_behavior: Do not infer overgrazing, habitat damage, or corridor importance from visual trails or isolated locations.

copper_smelter_acid_rainfall.unit: parts per million dry stack gas, kilograms per hour, tonnes per reporting period, and control efficiency percent reported separately
copper_smelter_acid_rainfall.geography: named roaster, smelting furnace, converter, acid plant, stack, facility, permit, and emissions-inventory jurisdiction
copper_smelter_acid_rainfall.cadence: continuous or source-test stack monitoring with six-hour standard comparison and annual inventory reporting
copper_smelter_acid_rainfall.transformation: Retain process unit, concentrate sulfur, gas flow, dry basis, oxygen correction where applicable, concentration, mass rate, operating hours, acid-plant capture, control device, test method, averaging period, permit limit, inventory method, and uncertainty.
copper_smelter_acid_rainfall.uncertainty: Ore sulfur, furnace route, batch converter cycles, gas capture, acid-plant availability, dilution, test timing, operating load, flow measurement, and inventory factors affect emissions.
copper_smelter_acid_rainfall.threshold_provenance: Use the applicable primary-copper-smelting performance standard, permit, source test, or facility inventory for the named process and averaging period.
copper_smelter_acid_rainfall.failure_behavior: Do not infer wet or dry acid deposition from stack emissions alone, combine sulfur dioxide with particulate or trace metals, call sulfuric-acid production a release, or attribute receptor acidity without transport, chemistry, deposition, and source-apportionment evidence.

stratospheric_water_vapor.unit: parts per million by volume on a dry-air basis by altitude or pressure level, with retrieval version and uncertainty stated
stratospheric_water_vapor.geography: named satellite occultation, balloon, aircraft, station, latitude band, altitude range, or global aggregation
stratospheric_water_vapor.cadence: profile observation with monthly zonal and annual anomaly summaries
stratospheric_water_vapor.transformation: Retain instrument, retrieval version, tangent altitude or pressure, dry-air basis, quality flags, cloud and aerosol screening, vertical resolution, sampling geometry, latitude, season, baseline, methane and tropopause context, and uncertainty.
stratospheric_water_vapor.uncertainty: Sparse sampling, vertical resolution, retrieval changes, aerosol interference, tropopause variability, circulation, methane oxidation, volcanic injection, and baseline choice affect profiles and trends.
stratospheric_water_vapor.threshold_provenance: Use a named NASA SAGE or independently validated profile product; there is no universal concentration threshold defining a separate phenomenon.
stratospheric_water_vapor.failure_behavior: Do not combine tropospheric and stratospheric humidity, infer radiative forcing directly from one profile, or attribute a trend to methane, temperature, circulation, or volcanism without a bounded attribution analysis.

textile_microfiber_shedding.metric_name: Textile-microfiber release per use and wash
textile_microfiber_shedding.unit: polymer-confirmed particles or milligrams released per garment, kilogram of textile, wear interval, or wash cycle with size range stated
textile_microfiber_shedding.geography: named textile product, laboratory or household washing system, wastewater pathway, and receiving jurisdiction
textile_microfiber_shedding.cadence: standardized wear or wash test with product-cohort and annual material-flow summaries
textile_microfiber_shedding.transformation: Retain fibre polymer, yarn and fabric construction, finishing, garment age, mass, wash programme, detergent, temperature, mechanical action, filter and wastewater capture, size cutoff, blank correction, chemical confirmation, recovery, and uncertainty.
textile_microfiber_shedding.uncertainty: Fabric construction, garment age, washing machine, protocol, filter size, laboratory contamination, polymer confirmation, wastewater capture, and conversion from particle count to mass affect comparisons.
textile_microfiber_shedding.threshold_provenance: Use a declared standardized release test and chemically confirmed particles; there is no universal shedding threshold defining a separate system phenomenon.
textile_microfiber_shedding.failure_behavior: Do not classify visual fibres as plastic, convert counts to mass without particle evidence, extrapolate one garment to a market, or infer environmental concentration or harm from release alone.

unsold_apparel_incineration.metric_name: Returned and unsold textile destruction flow
unsold_apparel_incineration.unit: units and tonnes destroyed with reuse, resale, recycling, incineration, landfill, and other treatment shares reported separately
unsold_apparel_incineration.geography: named retailer, producer, product category, market, waste jurisdiction, and reporting boundary
unsold_apparel_incineration.cadence: inventory disposition event with quarterly and annual material-flow summaries
unsold_apparel_incineration.transformation: Retain product category, returned versus never-sold status, reason, units, mass, resale and donation attempts, destruction route, energy recovery, export, contractor, reporting coverage, lifecycle method, and uncertainty.
unsold_apparel_incineration.uncertainty: Commercial confidentiality, scattered records, unit-to-mass conversion, mixed waste, exports, reuse after transfer, and treatment classification limit estimates.
unsold_apparel_incineration.threshold_provenance: Use documented inventory and treatment records; unsold status does not by itself establish destruction or incineration.
unsold_apparel_incineration.failure_behavior: Do not treat all returned stock as waste, all destroyed stock as incinerated, or infer lifecycle emissions without material composition and treatment data.

microplastic_suspensions.metric_name: Aquatic microplastic concentration and particle profile
microplastic_suspensions.unit: polymer-confirmed particles per cubic metre or litre and mass per volume reported separately, stratified by size, shape, and polymer
microplastic_suspensions.geography: named river, lake, estuary, coastal water, ocean station, depth interval, and sampling transect
microplastic_suspensions.cadence: survey or event sampling with seasonal and multi-year method-matched review
microplastic_suspensions.transformation: Retain matrix, depth, sampler and mesh, filtered volume, particle-size bounds, morphology, polymer-confirmation method and coverage, blanks, recovery, contamination control, hydrodynamics, weather, nearby sources, sediment resuspension, detection limits, and uncertainty.
microplastic_suspensions.uncertainty: Mesh and filter size, sampling depth, episodic mixing, particle density, visual misidentification, polymer-confirmation coverage, laboratory contamination, blanks, and count-to-mass conversion dominate comparability.
microplastic_suspensions.threshold_provenance: Use a declared matrix-specific method with chemical confirmation and blank correction; suspension is a sampled state, not a universal phenomenon threshold.
microplastic_suspensions.failure_behavior: Do not infer source, residence time, ecological harm, or trend from detection alone, combine unmatched size ranges or matrices, or convert particle count to mass without particle-specific evidence.

storm_surge_floods.unit: metres above predicted astronomical tide, total water level relative to a named datum, and inundation depth or area reported separately
storm_surge_floods.geography: named storm, tide gauge, coastline, estuary, community, and digital-elevation boundary
storm_surge_floods.cadence: event observation and forecast cycle with seasonal and multi-year return-level review
storm_surge_floods.transformation: Retain storm track, wind, pressure, size, speed, coast angle, bathymetry, predicted tide, observed water level, datum, waves, rainfall, river flow, elevation model, model version, and uncertainty.
storm_surge_floods.uncertainty: Gauge failure, datum conversion, wave runup, local bathymetry, track error, elevation error, rainfall, river flow, and model resolution affect attribution and mapped depth.
storm_surge_floods.threshold_provenance: Use NOAA definitions that subtract predicted astronomical tide for surge and distinguish total water level from inundation on normally dry land.
storm_surge_floods.failure_behavior: Do not combine surge, tide, waves and rainfall into one unlabelled height or infer parcel-scale flooding from planning maps.

winter_ice_road_collapses.metric_name: Winter-road operating season and load capacity
winter_ice_road_collapses.unit: opening and closure dates, operating days, centimetres of ice or frozen-ground depth, and tonnes permitted load reported separately
winter_ice_road_collapses.geography: named winter-road segment, lake or river crossing, community connection, and operating authority
winter_ice_road_collapses.cadence: daily during construction and operation with annual season review
winter_ice_road_collapses.transformation: Retain air and surface temperature, freezing-degree days, snow, ice thickness and quality, frozen-ground depth, route, inspection, maintenance, load class, closure cause, alternate access, and uncertainty.
winter_ice_road_collapses.uncertainty: Snow insulation, currents, springs, water depth, ice quality, vehicle loads, maintenance, local rules, and sparse observations affect safe operation.
winter_ice_road_collapses.threshold_provenance: Use the responsible authority’s measured thickness, frozen-ground and load standard; collapse wording is not a universal failure threshold.
winter_ice_road_collapses.failure_behavior: Do not infer structural failure from a shorter season, attribute every closure to warming, or apply one ice-thickness rule across routes and vehicle classes.

urban_smog_health_expenses.unit: cases, hospital or emergency visits, lost work or school days, and currency by valuation year reported separately
urban_smog_health_expenses.geography: named airshed, monitor network, exposed population, health system, and valuation jurisdiction
urban_smog_health_expenses.cadence: daily exposure and outcome analysis with annual burden assessment
urban_smog_health_expenses.transformation: Retain concentration and averaging period, population, baseline incidence, concentration-response function, lag, co-pollutants, temperature, health endpoint, medical cost versus willingness-to-pay valuation, price year, and uncertainty.
urban_smog_health_expenses.uncertainty: Exposure error, monitor coverage, co-pollutants, baseline health, lag choice, causal function, valuation method, adaptation, and inflation affect estimates.
urban_smog_health_expenses.threshold_provenance: Use EPA health-impact and valuation methods for named endpoints; aggregate asthma cost is not wholly attributable to ambient ozone.
urban_smog_health_expenses.failure_behavior: Do not infer cost from concentration alone, combine medical spending with welfare valuation, or attribute all urban smog illness to one pollutant.

subglacial_lake_drainages.unit: cubic metres of water, metres lake-surface or ice-surface elevation change, cubic metres per second peak discharge, and event duration reported separately
subglacial_lake_drainages.geography: named subglacial or glacier-dammed lake, glacier or ice-sheet basin, drainage route, and downstream catchment
subglacial_lake_drainages.cadence: event detection with seasonal hydrologic and multi-year recurrence review
subglacial_lake_drainages.transformation: Retain lake type and geometry, storage change, tunnel or failure route, ice thickness, basal conditions, glacier change, discharge hydrograph, sediment, downstream observations, detection method, and uncertainty.
subglacial_lake_drainages.uncertainty: Unobserved basal geometry, altimetry conversion, storage estimation, tunnel evolution, event timing, sediment, and sparse gauges affect volume and attribution.
subglacial_lake_drainages.threshold_provenance: Require a documented lake-storage decrease and drainage pathway; ice-sheet mass change alone does not establish an event.
subglacial_lake_drainages.failure_behavior: Do not equate all elevation change with water loss, assume every event reaches the surface or ocean, or infer long-term mass loss without a separate ice-budget analysis.

railroad_chemical_car_derailments.metric_name: Rail derailment and hazardous-material release record
railroad_chemical_car_derailments.unit: derailed cars, hazardous-material cars, released mass or volume by substance, injuries, evacuations, and damage currency reported separately
railroad_chemical_car_derailments.geography: named train, track segment, incident site, response perimeter, and investigation jurisdiction
railroad_chemical_car_derailments.cadence: incident record with investigation updates and annual safety summary
railroad_chemical_car_derailments.transformation: Retain probable cause, track and equipment condition, rail temperature, train consist, car specification, substance, breach, fire, release quantity, exposure, response, evacuation, damage, investigation status, and uncertainty.
railroad_chemical_car_derailments.uncertainty: Preliminary findings, cause revision, unmeasured release, mixed cargo, fire consumption, evacuation counts, damage estimates, and reporting thresholds affect records.
railroad_chemical_car_derailments.threshold_provenance: Use the final FRA or NTSB probable-cause and hazardous-material investigation; a tank car in the consist is not a release.
railroad_chemical_car_derailments.failure_behavior: Do not attribute every derailment to heat, infer chemical release from derailed-car count, or combine substances and consequences without incident-specific evidence.

glacial_meltwater_acidification.unit: pH, alkalinity or acid-neutralizing capacity, dissolved inorganic carbon, and major-ion concentration reported separately
glacial_meltwater_acidification.geography: named glacier, proglacial stream, hyporheic zone, lake, fjord, or downstream receiving water
glacial_meltwater_acidification.cadence: event and seasonal sampling with multi-year method-matched review
glacial_meltwater_acidification.transformation: Retain glacier and bedrock setting, sample matrix, pH scale and temperature, alkalinity method, discharge, weathering ions, dissolved carbon, residence time, hyporheic exchange, atmospheric and precipitation inputs, receiving-water mixing, and uncertainty.
glacial_meltwater_acidification.uncertainty: Bedrock, residence time, weathering, dilution, gas exchange, organic matter, sampling temperature, pH method, season, and receiving-water mixing control chemistry.
glacial_meltwater_acidification.threshold_provenance: Use measured pH together with alkalinity or acid-neutralizing capacity and a local baseline; melt alone does not establish acidification.
glacial_meltwater_acidification.failure_behavior: Do not infer a universal direction from glacier loss, equate low ionic strength with acidity, or merge freshwater pH change with ocean acidification.

extreme_weather_infrastructure_costs.metric_name: Hazard-attributed infrastructure damage and disruption cost
extreme_weather_infrastructure_costs.unit: currency by price year for direct asset damage, repair, replacement, service interruption, and user losses reported separately
extreme_weather_infrastructure_costs.geography: named hazard event, infrastructure network, service area, sector, owner, and affected user population
extreme_weather_infrastructure_costs.cadence: event damage assessment with annual loss and resilience-investment review
extreme_weather_infrastructure_costs.transformation: Retain hazard, exposure, asset class, pre-event condition, design standard, direct damage, service outage, repair, replacement, user and firm losses, price year, attribution method, insurance or aid recovery, and uncertainty.
extreme_weather_infrastructure_costs.uncertainty: Baseline maintenance, asset valuation, indirect losses, price inflation, overlapping hazards, service interdependencies, underreporting, and counterfactual recovery affect totals.
extreme_weather_infrastructure_costs.threshold_provenance: Use a declared post-disaster damage and service-loss methodology; total infrastructure spending is not weather-attributable cost.
extreme_weather_infrastructure_costs.failure_behavior: Do not combine direct damage with economic disruption, attribute all fragility costs to climate, or compare currencies and price years without conversion.

commuter_rail_transit_gaps.metric_name: Rail-transit service restriction and access gap
commuter_rail_transit_gaps.unit: percent of track under performance restriction, cancelled trips, delay minutes, service frequency, and population access reported separately
commuter_rail_transit_gaps.geography: named rail fixed-guideway system, track segment, route, station catchment, service day, and reporting agency
commuter_rail_transit_gaps.cadence: daily operations with monthly asset-performance and annual access review
commuter_rail_transit_gaps.transformation: Retain track miles, restriction reason, permitted and full speed, signals, power, construction, weather, trip schedule, cancellation, delay, station access, population denominator, observation time, and uncertainty.
commuter_rail_transit_gaps.uncertainty: Cause coding, planned work, temporary orders, schedule change, missed trips, rider data, catchment definition, and reporting coverage affect interpretation.
commuter_rail_transit_gaps.threshold_provenance: Use FTA performance-restriction definitions and a separately declared service-access measure; a slow zone is not automatically a transit gap.
commuter_rail_transit_gaps.failure_behavior: Do not attribute all service loss to heat, combine asset condition with geographic access, or infer rider exclusion from track restriction alone.

climate_refugee_camp_densities.unit: people, hectares, square metres per person, occupancy, and covered living area reported separately
climate_refugee_camp_densities.geography: named displacement event, settlement or collective site, host area, management authority, and reporting boundary
climate_refugee_camp_densities.cadence: site registration and monthly planning review with event-level displacement reconciliation
climate_refugee_camp_densities.transformation: Retain displacement trigger and date, legal and protection category, new movements versus stock, registered population, site boundary, service and household land, covered living area, expansion, host population, source reconciliation, and uncertainty.
climate_refugee_camp_densities.uncertainty: Registration lag, repeated movements, spontaneous settlements, boundary change, unregistered residents, host populations, site closure, and differing displacement definitions affect density.
climate_refugee_camp_densities.threshold_provenance: Use UNHCR settlement-space standards and IDMC event methodology; climate-related hazard does not by itself establish refugee legal status.
climate_refugee_camp_densities.failure_behavior: Do not call all disaster displacement refugee movement, infer crowding from arrivals alone, or compare camp density without site-area and service-boundary definitions.
