gulf_stream_slowdown.failure_behavior: Do not equate one section with the entire current or AMOC, combine path displacement with transport change, compare uncorrected instrument generations, infer a collapse from short-term variability, or use coastal sea level alone as proof of circulation change.

subpolar_gyre_weakening.unit: square metres per second squared of wind-stress curl, centimetres of sea-surface-height anomaly or gradient, metres per second of geostrophic velocity, and Sverdrups of named boundary or gyre transport reported separately
subpolar_gyre_weakening.geography: declared Labrador, Irminger, Iceland, Rockall, eastern or full North Atlantic subpolar-gyre domain with contour, depth, section, and basin boundary stated
subpolar_gyre_weakening.cadence: daily to monthly reanalysis and altimetry with seasonal hydrography and multi-year method-consistent trend review
subpolar_gyre_weakening.transformation: Retain gyre boundary, section and depth, sea-surface-height reference, geostrophic calculation, wind-stress-curl product, temperature, salinity and density profiles, mixed-layer depth, air-sea heat flux, freshwater inputs, current meters, altimeter and reanalysis versions, spatial modes, baseline, autocorrelation, uncertainty, and whether strength, extent, position or water-mass properties are being measured.
subpolar_gyre_weakening.uncertainty: No single universal index exists; altimetric height includes steric and mass effects, horizontal circulation differs from overturning, wind and buoyancy forcing can oppose each other, and regional sectors respond differently.
subpolar_gyre_weakening.threshold_provenance: Require a named peer-reviewed index or transport section with a fixed spatial mode, reference period, sign convention, and uncertainty; weakening must refer to that exact circulation measure rather than a temperature or salinity anomaly alone.
subpolar_gyre_weakening.failure_behavior: Do not equate regional cooling with weaker circulation, use one sea-surface-height pixel as a gyre index, merge horizontal flow with AMOC, combine incompatible spatial modes, or infer a monotonic climate trend from one decadal phase.

solar_radiation_trapping.unit: watts per square metre relative to a stated preindustrial baseline, with gas contributions and uncertainty retained
solar_radiation_trapping.geography: global atmosphere, with the observing network and forcing calculation stated
solar_radiation_trapping.cadence: annual concentration update with assessment-method revision tracking
solar_radiation_trapping.transformation: Convert quality-controlled global mole fractions to gas-specific forcing using the named assessment equations; retain overlap corrections, baseline, gas coverage, uncertainty, and index normalization.
solar_radiation_trapping.uncertainty: Sparse sampling for some gases, calibration scale, atmospheric lifetime, spectral overlap, radiative efficiency, and rapid adjustments affect component and total estimates.
solar_radiation_trapping.threshold_provenance: Use NOAA AGGI or an explicitly named IPCC effective-radiative-forcing method; no generic trapping score is permitted.
solar_radiation_trapping.failure_behavior: Do not treat emitted mass, local concentration, heat flux, or surface temperature as interchangeable with effective radiative forcing.

bark_beetle_epidemics.metric_name: Bark-beetle outbreak extent and tree mortality
bark_beetle_epidemics.unit: hectares affected and trees killed per hectare by named beetle and host species, survey method, and damage year
bark_beetle_epidemics.geography: named forest stand, aerial-detection survey polygon, management unit, ecoregion, or species range
bark_beetle_epidemics.cadence: annual aerial or satellite survey with field verification and multi-year outbreak review
bark_beetle_epidemics.transformation: Retain beetle species, host species and density, mortality-agent attribution, survey platform, detection threshold, drought and temperature period, fire history, mapped area, and uncertainty.
bark_beetle_epidemics.uncertainty: Aerial surveys can miss low-severity damage, attribution becomes harder after needle loss, multiple mortality agents co-occur, and survey coverage and thresholds vary.
bark_beetle_epidemics.threshold_provenance: Use a named forest-health survey or species-specific outbreak definition; scattered attacks and background mortality do not establish an epidemic.
bark_beetle_epidemics.failure_behavior: Do not attribute all drought- or fire-associated mortality to bark beetles, combine species with different climate responses, or infer outbreak intensity from canopy colour alone.

zoonotic_disease_outbreaks.unit: laboratory-confirmed human cases, probable cases, deaths, affected administrative areas, and reproduction or growth estimate by named pathogen and case definition
zoonotic_disease_outbreaks.geography: named outbreak, country, administrative area, exposure setting, and animal-human interface
zoonotic_disease_outbreaks.cadence: daily or weekly during an outbreak with final event review
zoonotic_disease_outbreaks.transformation: Retain pathogen, case definition, onset and report dates, laboratory method, animal reservoir or bridge-host evidence, exposure route, geography, denominator, reporting delay, revisions, and uncertainty.
zoonotic_disease_outbreaks.uncertainty: Under-ascertainment, changing case definitions, diagnostic access, reporting delay, animal surveillance gaps, and uncertain reservoir attribution affect incidence and source estimates.
zoonotic_disease_outbreaks.threshold_provenance: Use the named national or WHO outbreak definition and pathogen-specific surveillance protocol; a spillover risk indicator is not a confirmed outbreak.
zoonotic_disease_outbreaks.failure_behavior: Do not aggregate unrelated pathogens into a causal trend, infer animal origin without investigation, or treat exposure potential as confirmed transmission.

trophic_cascade_collapses.unit: abundance, biomass, interaction strength, diet, and downstream vegetation or community response reported separately
trophic_cascade_collapses.geography: named food web, focal taxa, ecosystem, comparison design, and period
trophic_cascade_collapses.cadence: seasonal or annual observation with multi-year trend review
trophic_cascade_collapses.transformation: Retain predator, prey and resource taxa, abundance, diet or interaction evidence, experimental or quasi-experimental design, lags, alternate pathways, and uncertainty.
trophic_cascade_collapses.uncertainty: Food webs contain compensatory consumers, omnivory, changing diets, and context-dependent interaction strengths.
trophic_cascade_collapses.threshold_provenance: Use the named authoritative or primary study method and a declared taxonomic, spatial, temporal, and baseline boundary; no universal collapse threshold is implied.
trophic_cascade_collapses.failure_behavior: Do not infer a cascade from one declining taxon without measured intermediate and downstream responses.

deep_sea_mining_dust.unit: suspended sediment concentration, particle-size distribution, plume area or volume, settling flux, and duration
deep_sea_mining_dust.geography: named mining test or operation, discharge depth, water mass, seafloor footprint, and monitoring period
deep_sea_mining_dust.cadence: seasonal or annual observation with multi-year trend review
deep_sea_mining_dust.transformation: Retain mined material, sediment loading, discharge rate and depth, particle size, turbulence, background particles, sensor, detection threshold, model assumptions, and uncertainty.
deep_sea_mining_dust.uncertainty: Commercial-scale behavior depends strongly on discharge design, turbulence, thresholds, aggregation, and background nepheloid layers.
deep_sea_mining_dust.threshold_provenance: Use the named authoritative or primary study method and a declared taxonomic, spatial, temporal, and baseline boundary; no universal collapse threshold is implied.
deep_sea_mining_dust.failure_behavior: Do not infer ecological harm from modeled plume extent alone or call natural suspended sediment mining dust.

genetic_diversity_bottlenecks.metric_name: Population genetic diversity and effective size
genetic_diversity_bottlenecks.unit: heterozygosity, allelic richness, effective population size, inbreeding coefficient, and connectivity estimate by population
genetic_diversity_bottlenecks.geography: named taxon, population units, marker set, sampling design, generation window, and reference period
genetic_diversity_bottlenecks.cadence: seasonal or annual observation with multi-year trend review
genetic_diversity_bottlenecks.transformation: Retain census and effective size, marker or genomic method, sampling coverage, generation time, migration, translocation, kinship, historic reference, and confidence intervals.
genetic_diversity_bottlenecks.uncertainty: Marker choice, temporal sampling, population structure, immigration, selection, and small samples alter inferred diversity and effective size.
genetic_diversity_bottlenecks.threshold_provenance: Use the named authoritative or primary study method and a declared taxonomic, spatial, temporal, and baseline boundary; no universal collapse threshold is implied.
genetic_diversity_bottlenecks.failure_behavior: Do not infer a bottleneck from low census abundance or habitat fragmentation alone without population-genetic or pedigree evidence.

jellyfish_swarm_surges.metric_name: Jellyfish bloom frequency, biomass, and duration
jellyfish_swarm_surges.unit: individuals per cubic metre, biomass, occupied area, event duration, and recurrence by taxon and method
jellyfish_swarm_surges.geography: named coastal water body, taxon, life stage, depth, survey platform, season, and baseline
jellyfish_swarm_surges.cadence: seasonal or annual observation with multi-year trend review
jellyfish_swarm_surges.transformation: Retain medusa and polyp stages, taxon, sampling effort, artificial substrate, temperature, salinity, oxygen, nutrients, prey, predators, fishing, currents, and uncertainty.
jellyfish_swarm_surges.uncertainty: Patchiness, life-cycle stage, currents, observation effort, taxonomic ambiguity, and episodic recruitment complicate trend inference.
jellyfish_swarm_surges.threshold_provenance: Use the named authoritative or primary study method and a declared taxonomic, spatial, temporal, and baseline boundary; no universal collapse threshold is implied.
jellyfish_swarm_surges.failure_behavior: Do not infer a regional increase from beach strandings, intake fouling, or one survey without effort-adjusted abundance and a fixed baseline.

savannah_tree_cover_decline.unit: percent woody cover, hectares, stem density, basal area, and persistence relative to a fixed baseline
savannah_tree_cover_decline.geography: named savanna ecosystem, fixed plot or grid, land-use and fire-history boundary, and period
savannah_tree_cover_decline.cadence: seasonal or annual observation with multi-year trend review
savannah_tree_cover_decline.transformation: Retain savanna definition, woody and grass cover, sensor or plot method, rainfall, drought, fire timing and severity, herbivory, clearing, recovery, and classification uncertainty.
savannah_tree_cover_decline.uncertainty: Rainfall variability, fire exclusion, grazing, browsing, woody encroachment, clearing, and sensor definitions can produce opposite trends.
savannah_tree_cover_decline.threshold_provenance: Use the named authoritative or primary study method and a declared taxonomic, spatial, temporal, and baseline boundary; no universal collapse threshold is implied.
savannah_tree_cover_decline.failure_behavior: Do not treat all low tree cover as degradation or infer persistent decline from a single burn, dry season, or canopy observation.

heavy_metal_bioaccumulation.metric_name: Metal concentration in environment and biota
heavy_metal_bioaccumulation.unit: compound- or species-specific concentration in water, sediment, food, and tissue with wet or dry basis stated
heavy_metal_bioaccumulation.geography: named site, metal species, organism, tissue, life stage, food web, sampling period, and reference site
heavy_metal_bioaccumulation.cadence: seasonal or annual observation with multi-year trend review
heavy_metal_bioaccumulation.transformation: Retain metal and chemical species, matrix, tissue, size, age, lipid or dry-weight basis, trophic position, exposure source, detection limit, bioaccumulation factor, and uncertainty.
heavy_metal_bioaccumulation.uncertainty: Essentiality, speciation, bioavailability, metabolism, growth dilution, diet, season, and trophic structure differ strongly among metals and taxa.
heavy_metal_bioaccumulation.threshold_provenance: Use the named authoritative or primary study method and a declared taxonomic, spatial, temporal, and baseline boundary; no universal collapse threshold is implied.
heavy_metal_bioaccumulation.failure_behavior: Do not combine metals, equate detection with toxicity, or infer biomagnification without trophic-position and food-web evidence.

riparian_zone_erosion.unit: metres per year, eroded area or volume, sediment mass, and bank-failure events with reach method stated
riparian_zone_erosion.geography: named river reach, bank side, floodplain, vegetation zone, flow record, and survey period
riparian_zone_erosion.cadence: seasonal or annual observation with multi-year trend review
riparian_zone_erosion.transformation: Retain bank material, geometry, vegetation and roots, flow stage and velocity, precipitation, channel change, land use, intervention, survey control, and uncertainty.
riparian_zone_erosion.uncertainty: Bank retreat is episodic and varies with substrate, vegetation, channel geometry, floods, dams, grazing, and measurement interval.
riparian_zone_erosion.threshold_provenance: Use the named authoritative or primary study method and a declared taxonomic, spatial, temporal, and baseline boundary; no universal collapse threshold is implied.
riparian_zone_erosion.failure_behavior: Do not infer erosion from sparse vegetation or high flow alone without repeat geometry, bank-failure, or sediment evidence.

overstory_tree_mortality.metric_name: Overstory tree mortality rate and area
overstory_tree_mortality.unit: annual mortality rate, dead stems per hectare, basal-area mortality, canopy area, and cause attribution by species
overstory_tree_mortality.geography: named forest type, plot or mapped area, overstory definition, species, disturbance history, and period
overstory_tree_mortality.cadence: seasonal or annual observation with multi-year trend review
overstory_tree_mortality.transformation: Retain tree species, size and vigor, overstory threshold, drought and heat exposure, insects or disease, fire injury, competition, management, detection method, lags, and uncertainty.
overstory_tree_mortality.uncertainty: Mortality attribution is confounded by interacting drought, heat, insects, disease, fire, competition, and delayed death.
overstory_tree_mortality.threshold_provenance: Use the named authoritative or primary study method and a declared taxonomic, spatial, temporal, and baseline boundary; no universal collapse threshold is implied.
overstory_tree_mortality.failure_behavior: Do not infer cause from canopy discoloration or aggregate tree loss without field, temporal, and disturbance evidence.

freshwater_mussel_depletion.unit: density, catch per unit effort, occupancy, species richness, survival, recruitment, and size structure by survey method
freshwater_mussel_depletion.geography: named river reach, mussel taxon and host context, habitat, survey design, and assessment period
freshwater_mussel_depletion.cadence: seasonal or annual observation with multi-year trend review
freshwater_mussel_depletion.transformation: Retain taxon, life stage, host fish, detection and effort, flow, temperature, substrate, sediment, barriers, contaminants, disease, non-native species, drought, and uncertainty.
freshwater_mussel_depletion.uncertainty: Imperfect detection, patchy beds, long life spans, episodic recruitment, host dynamics, flow, pollution, and unexplained mass mortality affect trends.
freshwater_mussel_depletion.threshold_provenance: Use the named authoritative or primary study method and a declared taxonomic, spatial, temporal, and baseline boundary; no universal collapse threshold is implied.
freshwater_mussel_depletion.failure_behavior: Do not infer a cause from absence or one survey, and do not generalize a site-specific decline across taxa or basins.
